refutations.argument:
PART (a) — THE STEELMAN, AND IT IS STRONGER THAN THE PASS ALLOWS.

The pass's kill-condition text demands "the *total* description — laws plus every input actually needed for prediction." It then declares that condition fired on the six ΛCDM numbers. That declaration is false as written, and the flagship source says so in its own sentence. Planck 2018 I (arXiv:1807.06205) states: the 6-parameter ΛCDM model fits the data, "describing THE COSMOLOGICAL INFORMATION in over a billion map pixels with just six parameters." The qualifier is the collaboration's, not mine. Six parameters do not describe a billion pixels; they describe the sub-quantity the discipline admits as cosmological. That is K-II's filter, installed upstream of the datum, in the load-bearing citation.

Three filters are stacked in the pass's own §1 sentence — "six ΛCDM parameters reproduce the entire AUDITED LARGE-SCALE record" — and each is a live admission rule:
(i) the summary statistic. The datum is C_ℓ (TT/TE/EE + lensing), not the sky. The map→C_ℓ reduction is lossless only under Gaussianity + statistical isotropy; those are supplied premises, and the corpus books them as a consistency statement, not a derivation (cosmology/symmetries/0, with its own caveat "consistency statements, not derivations").
(ii) "large-scale." The corpus itself records the handoff: linear theory "hands off to N-body simulation in the nonlinear regime," with "baryonic-feedback modeling … the recorded systematic frontier" (cosmology/limits/0). Galaxies, feedback, the actual contents of the sky are excluded by the adjective.
(iii) the realization. ΛCDM predicts the variance of a_ℓm, never the a_ℓm. The specific draw — of order 10^6 measured harmonic modes at Planck's ℓ_max = 2508, ~10^9 raw pixels — is filed as "a random realization." And the record confirms the filter ran: the 48-item C-III table has entries for A_s and n_s (the spectrum) and for the cosmological principle, and NO entry for the realization. A large, measured, contingent fact about this universe sits nowhere on the priced ledger. I record that as a mismatch in the protocol's "kernel-but-not-priced" direction and do not rationalize it.

Conclusion of (a): K-II's written kill condition DID NOT FIRE. The pass banked a kill it had not earned. The concession to "partial deflator" was reached by a bad argument.

PART (b) — THE STEELMAN DIES ANYWAY, ON THREE INDEPENDENT GROUNDS.

The filter explanation is quantitative: it says apparent smallness is an artifact of exclusion. For that, the excluded residue must be (1) large AND (2) excluded by disciplinary convention rather than by measurement. Partition the residue and check the record.

KILL 1 — the certified/uncertified distribution is inverted from what K-II needs.
R1, the realization residue (~6×10^6 modes, ℓ ≤ 2508): LARGE, but its exclusion is not a convention. Planck IX measured exactly whether it carries structure beyond the spectrum: f_NL^local = −0.9 ± 5.1, f_NL^equil = −26 ± 47, f_NL^ortho = −38 ± 24. Planck VII: the statistics "are consistent with the Gaussian predictions of the ΛCDM cosmological model." Those tests could have failed and did not. Excluding a residue MEASURED to be a maximum-entropy draw given the spectrum is a derived irrelevance, not a filing habit. Note the real shape of the record's claim: a billion pixels compress to six numbers PLUS A RANDOM SEED, and "plus a random seed" is itself the most compressive falsifiable claim in the corpus. K-II reads the seed as hidden cost; the record reads it as a confirmed prediction of structurelessness — and the record wins because the test exists and was run. (This is a measurement fact, not a mechanism story; I am not borrowing K-U's contraction account to kill K-II.)
R2, the uncertified residue: Planck VII confirms anomalies "on large angular scales" — precisely where cosmic variance leaves few independent samples and the structurelessness certification is weakest. Here K-II's filter is genuinely not refuted by measurement. But that regime is ℓ ≤ 29 (the Commander low-ℓ likelihood), ~9×10^2 modes — ~0.01% of the measured modes; extended generously to ℓ ≲ 60 it is ~0.06%. K-II requires a LARGE uncertified residue. The record delivers certified-large and uncertified-small. Exactly inverted. This is the kill.

KILL 2 — widening the scope to the genuinely conventional exclusion prices out small.
Grant the steelman's best leg: "large-scale" really does exclude astronomy. Then price what re-admission costs. N-body takes a realization of the six-parameter spectrum plus known gravity; the genuinely new priced content is baryonic feedback, and current practice buys it with O(1–2) nuisance parameters (HMcode's A_bary plus halo-bloating η_b; the survey-modelling literature reports fitting all feedback models at the ~5% level with two free parameters), up to O(3–7) in baryonification schemes. So broadening from "large-scale" to "nonlinear structure" moves the total from 6 to roughly 6 + O(10). It does not move it toward 10^6. The one place where the exclusion IS conventional hides a handful of parameters, not a continent. K-II's filter is real in scope and impotent in magnitude.

KILL 3 — K-II is the one candidate that requires the global scalar the round already denied.
The pass's own inherited constraint §0(i): the C-II audit returned NOT-FORMALIZABLE-TYPE-MIXED; there is no formulation-invariant scalar measure of supplied content. K-II's thesis — "the supplied side only LOOKS small because the residue is big" — is a subtraction across types: realization-bits minus parameter-counts. That addition is exactly what §0(i) forbids. K-I, K-III and K-U can all be stated per-typed-description; K-II cannot, because its whole content is a comparison of magnitudes. It is ill-typed by the document's own binding constraint.

TWO SUPPORTING DISCONFIRMATIONS.
(A) The flavor dilemma. If the filter were a disciplinary reflex for hiding incompressible content, the SM's 19+ parameters and the flavor sector — the least compressible thing on the ledger, and the pass's own honest counter-weight — are the obvious candidates for exclusion. They were not excluded; they sit on the law ledger in full public view. K-II's escape is to say the filter only excludes initial-condition-shaped content, not coupling-shaped content — but then K-II is no longer "keep the compressible part," it is "keep the coupling-shaped part," which has no compressibility content at all. Disconfirmed on one horn, emptied on the other.
(B) The vocabulary horn, same shape as the trap that demoted C-I's existence-half. On a Mill–Ramsey–Lewis reading — and the record's own past-hypothesis row cites the Albert–Loewer Best-System promotion — "law" just IS the optimal compression of the total mosaic, so "physics keeps the compressible part" is analytic and explains nothing. On the non-analytic reading it makes the empirical claim refuted above. The pass states K-II with an empirical kill condition, so the intended reading is the refuted one; VOCABULARY-ONLY is the verdict on the other horn. Both horns are fatal.

BOTTOM LINE. Nothing survives of K-II as an explanation of smallness — not even the partial-deflator status the pass granted it, since that status was granted on an argument I have shown did not fire. What survives is smaller and different in kind: a pricing observation, not a deflation, and one already booked elsewhere on the ledger.

THREE INDEPENDENT KILLS, TWO OF THEM K-U'S OWN BIRTH CONDITIONS.

(1) THE POST-HOC KERNELIZATION SLIPS THROUGH — AND TAKES THE NEGATIVE CONTROL WITH IT. I chose the arbitrary input adversarially: delta_CP / the CKM phase, i.e. the flagship of the sector K-U declares its negative fit ("flavour sector — no strong contraction, no smallness — fits negatively") and the protocol nominates as its standing falsifiability control. Contraction: one-loop SM Yukawa RG flow toward the IR. It is maximally independently motivated — Wilson-Kogut sits in the corpus's own `formalism` field, and the top-Yukawa IR quasi-fixed point (Pendleton-Ross; Hill) has been studied since the 1980s for GUT model-building, in total innocence of K-U. It is genuinely contractive in the sense K-U needs: the documented "strong focussing ... relative insensitivity to initial values" is exactly deletion of UV Yukawa data. So the control's first conjunct, "no strong contraction," is simply false. Kernel, computed from the RGEs alone: Kielanowski & Juarez W. (hep-ph/0301098) prove lambda, rho, eta invariant and "Theorem 5: The unitarity triangle is invariant through the evolution" — i.e. the CP-phase data is an EXACT one-loop evolution invariant; Harrison-Krishnan-Scott (PRD 82, 096004 (2010), arXiv:1007.3810) independently construct a set of exact SM one-loop evolution invariants. Now run the protocol's three steps: (1) contraction identified from the physics — PASSES; (2) kernel computed without consulting the priced list — PASSES with more independence than any K-U instance can claim, since the computation was published years earlier by authors with no access to the list; (3) compare — delta is priced, delta is kernel. The discipline does not block the construction; it certifies it. The protocol's guard was drafted against "suitably chosen" contractions; the actual failure mode uses the least gerrymandered contraction available. Per the guard's own words the recorded verdict is then "unfalsifiable bookkeeping." Birth kill-condition (ii) fires.

(2) WHY IT SLIPS THROUGH: THE INDEPENDENCE CONDITION IS STRUCTURALLY UNSATISFIABLE ON THIS CORPUS. (a) Demonstrated leak: the blind strips `empirical_inputs` and `constants` but retains `domain_of_validity`, whose QFT entry enumerates the priced list verbatim — "REPRODUCTION for Lambda's value, Omega_c, all 13 flavour parameters, alpha, G; SILENCE on the initial condition, the Born rule, definite outcomes" — naming the control's parameter count and the past hypothesis in a retained field. Same pattern in cosmology/derived_objects ("given the six LCDM parameters"), stat-mech/phenomena ("carries the boundary-condition input recorded under empirical_inputs" — it names the stripped field), decoherence/derived_objects ("the interaction itself is an input (see primitives)"), gauge_theory/domain_of_validity, QG/derived_objects (SJ: "a frequency-sign selection enters (archive XVI-I residual-input list)"). Step 2 cannot be run as written either way. This is not an implementation bug — it is the substance: the contraction-defining data and the priced inventory are the same rows. K-U's right-hand side is built out of its left-hand side.

(3) WHERE K-U "WORKS" IT IS ANALYTIC. Verified Wilsonian statement: only finitely many relevant+marginal operators exist and that is WHY an EFT is predictive; irrelevant couplings "become computable functions of just the marginal and relevant couplings fixed by experiment." So across every EFT-organized description — QFT, gauge, condensed matter, hydrodynamics, gravity-as-EFT — "priced inputs = the non-contracted directions of the flow" restates the EFT predictivity theorem. K-U's "fits, corpus-verified" condensed-matter win lives entirely in this region. It absorbs these inputs post hoc because it cannot fail to.

(3b) A SPECTRAL EQUIVOCATION AT THE CORE. K-U's own kernel list — "the slow manifold, the conserved charges, the relevant couplings, the topological/superselection data, the boundary conditions of the slow modes" — spans four incompatible spectral classes of the generator: lambda=0 (conserved charges, topological/superselection: genuine kernel); lambda>0 (RELEVANT COUPLINGS — "relevant" means growing toward the IR, and a contraction semigroup with ||T_t||<=1 has no growing directions at all); small lambda<0 (slow manifold: data the contraction DOES erase, only slowly); and not spectral data at all (boundary conditions). "A contraction cannot delete its own kernel" is a theorem only for lambda=0. Stretched over the other three it becomes "a contraction does not quickly delete what it does not quickly delete." Repair the wording to "the non-decaying spectral subspace" and the sentence stays true while its theorem-content evaporates — the vocabulary trap firing at the technical core, not merely at the past hypothesis. Compounding this: every DISCRETE priced input (number of generations, gauge group, spacetime dimension, superselection labels, the past hypothesis's orientation bit) is in the kernel of every continuous flow by continuity alone. The test has zero discriminating power against them.

(4) THE PAST HYPOTHESIS IS WORSE THAN "FITS BY CONSTRUCTION" — IT IS THE COUNTEREXAMPLE KILL-CONDITION (i) NAMES. (5) C-II COMPLIANCE: A SMUGGLE BY OMISSION. No instance asserts "strict reduction" in words, so the letter of (iii) holds. An unbooked trade sold as explanation is C-II non-compliance in substance. No back-edges.

STEP 0 — THE VOCABULARY TRAP DOES NOT FIRE ON THE TYPING. I tried to kill K-I as a relabel and failed. "Relevant" is computed, not read back off the priced list: the linearized-RG eigenvalue classification (Wegner 1972; Wegner–Houghton 1973; Wilson 1971) takes as input the fixed point, cutoff scheme, d and symmetry class, and returns numbers that could have come out otherwise and are measured — 2D Ising y_t = 1, y_h = 15/8 (exactly two relevant directions, codimension-2 critical surface), 3D Ising Wegner exponent ω = 0.8303(18), and the corpus's own α_He4 = −0.0127(3) at 2 nK with no rounding. This satisfies the CHALLENGE_ROUND_01 discipline verbatim ("invariances computed independently of the explananda"). K-I is not VOCABULARY-ONLY, and saying so would be the lazy kill.

STEP 1 — THE "BOUNDARY CONDITION, NOT A COUPLING" OBJECTION FAILS AS WRITTEN. The pass's own predicted kill is too cheap. RG does type boundary and initial data: boundary conditions are RG fixed points with their own flows and a monotone (Affleck–Ludwig g-theorem, proved by Friedan–Konechny), and initial conditions carry genuine RG eigenvalues — Janssen–Schaub–Schmittmann (1989) assign the initial magnetization a scaling dimension x_0 by two-loop ε-expansion. So the kill must be sharpened or abandoned.

STEP 2 — SHARPENED, IT FIRES, AND AS PRESUPPOSITION RATHER THAN SILENCE. What the JSS/boundary-RG typing needs is: a bulk fixed point; a declared symmetry class and d; a declared fast/slow mode grading on a fixed background; and a local operator basis (hence a local factorization). Now type the three items:
• Cosmological principle (item 14) — NOT TYPABLE BY PRESUPPOSITION. It is a statistical state-symmetry deployed as framework axiom (corpus: "an assumption tested against data, not derived from dynamics"). The symmetry class is an *input slot* of K-I's own eigenvalue computation; in the cosmological description, statistical homogeneity is what defines the k-modes and hence what "scale" means. Its only relocation route on the record is inflation — an attractor/no-hair mechanism, i.e. K-III's time-contraction, not K-I's scale-contraction. The round's own recorded rule ("C-I may not borrow C-II's relocation defense to survive its own kill condition — recorded as a rule of the phase") blocks that borrowing.
• Global factorization (item 29) — NOT TYPABLE BY PRESUPPOSITION. RG flows on a space of *local* actions; locality of the operator basis is what a factorization supplies. Corpus: "which factorization is physical is input everywhere"; in type-III₁ local algebras there is no tensor factorization at all, so the object RG would need does not exist there; CPR delivers uniqueness only given k-locality.
• Past hypothesis (item 13) — NOT TYPABLE, three independent obstructions. (i) No operator basis of a local action contains "the initial macrostate had entropy ≤ S₀": RG eigenvalues attach to directions in a space of actions, and there is no coefficient here whose eigenvalue could be computed. JSS types a *scaling* perturbation (small m₀) of an already-graded critical system; the PH is not of that form. (ii) K-I's mechanism is vacuous on it: RG-irrelevance produces smallness by deleting microdata, and the PH is already maximally coarse — the pass's own §1 says it does work "precisely by not specifying details." Apply the contraction and it returns the input unchanged. (iii) In its quantum statement it is a low-entanglement-entropy condition (Al-Khalili & Chen, arXiv:2405.03418, abstract fetched), and entanglement entropy is factorization-relative by definition — so it inherits item 29's failure.
• Bonus, uninvited: item 33, the Mori–Zwanzig projector, is corpus-VERIFIED as "which variables count as slow/relevant is a declared input... not an output." That is the record's own name for the fast/slow grading K-I consumes. K-I's contraction is itself defined by a priced, WANDERS-classified describer choice.
So the birth kill condition fires on three of the seven WANDERS items — but the failure mode is worse than "regional only": for 14, 29 and 33 the items sit *inside K-I's premises*. A candidate that consumes an item cannot also explain it.

The Standard Model is the paradigm RG-organized description — renormalizability *is* the statement that only relevant and marginal couplings survive — and its supplied side is 19+ parameters (item 41, MANY-PREPARATIONS, STABLE-LAW), which the pass itself files as the place smallness fails. HEADLINE: the assigned kill did NOT fire. K-III falls instead to the REVERSE kill, which needs no new meter and which K-III's own negative control supplies.

1. THE HUNT FAILED, PARTLY FOR A BAD REASON. Gauge group + rep content, and spacetime dimension, are priced (corpus-VERIFIED) and contraction-free, but each is a single irreducible discrete datum with no audited "before" from which it was compressed. Irreducibility is not compression; counting a primitive as a smallness datum would make every primitive one, trivializing the question. Charge quantization is route (b): given group+reps it follows from anomaly cancellation, with the conditionality already corpus-recorded (Babu-Mohapatra 1989, a Dirac nu_R dequantizes hypercharge); where it is not a theorem it is inherited from the same single selection. CPT/spin-statistics are route (b): theorems, not inputs; the priced items are the Wightman-class premises, whose "smallness" is deductive fertility, a property of every axiom system, not a physical datum. Topological/superselection data are route (c) and give K-III its best confirming instance: microscopic Hamiltonian -> IQHE Chern number is massively non-injective, the survivor is one integer, and the plateau needs disorder-induced localization. BUT the hunt's failure is partly an artifact: "conspicuously small" has no type-safe meter, which is C-II's NOT-FORMALIZABLE-TYPE-MIXED verdict (inherited as PASS_02 constraint (i)) biting K-III's own kill condition. An unexecutable kill protects the candidate, so survival of this hunt is not evidence for K-III.

2. THE NEGATIVE CONTROL IS FALSE IN BOTH CLAUSES. (i) "No known contraction" in the flavor sector is wrong at read level. Yukawas run under the same renormalization group as the gauge couplings: one theory space, one flow, ~16 decades of running. Worse, the flavor sector carries a named published attractor the record does not attribute to the gauge couplings: Hill's infrared quasi-fixed point (PRD 24, 691, 1981), whose standard characterization is attractor-deletion in K-III's own vocabulary (whatever the starting value at high energy, if large enough it is drawn to the quasi-fixed-point value), plus the Pendleton-Ross infrared stable fixed point (Phys. Lett. B98, 291, 1981) locking the top Yukawa to the QCD coupling. (ii) The "consistent" reading is evidentially asymmetric: K-III banks contraction-free largeness as confirming. If that confirms, contraction-free smallness must disconfirm; K-III cannot decline the gauge-structure probe as the wrong type of smallness while keeping the flavor confirmation, which rests on the same cross-type comparison. Either both count or neither does.

contractions.name: Block-spin (Kadanoff) coarse-graining on configuration space
contractions.mathematical_form: A stochastic blocking kernel T(sigma'|sigma) >= 0 with sum_{sigma'} T(sigma'|sigma) = 1, defining the renormalized Hamiltonian by exp(-H'[sigma']) = sum_sigma T(sigma'|sigma) exp(-H[sigma]), followed by length rescaling x -> x/b. Canonical example: majority rule sigma'_I = sgn(sum_{i in I} sigma_i) on blocks I of b^d sites. Partition function is preserved exactly, Z[H'] = Z[H]; the configuration count is not: 2^N -> 2^{N b^{-d}}.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: It is operative because of a physical fact specific to this domain, not because it is convenient: near a continuous transition the correlation length diverges (xi/a -> infinity), so the degrees of freedom at the lattice scale a carry no information about the singular part of the free energy. The blocking map is the formal statement that a probe of wavelength >> a cannot in principle distinguish the summed-over microstates. Its many-to-one-ness is measured, not postulated: the He-4 lambda-point exponent alpha = -0.0127(3) is the same number as in microscopically unrelated 3D XY systems, and the quantized Hall resistance agrees between GaAs/AlGaAs and epitaxial graphene to 8.6e-11. Both are direct experimental readouts of the fiber of the map being large.
contractions.what_it_erases: All within-block microstates: the fiber over a given sigma' has size ~2^{N(1-b^{-d})}. Correlations at separations below the block scale. Caveat on the map itself: it is not always well-defined on Hamiltonian space -- van Enter, Fernandez & Sokal (1993) showed that for some blocking schemes in the low-temperature/high-field regime the block-spin measure is not Gibbsian for ANY quasi-local interaction, so H' does not exist. The contraction's domain of definition is itself a nontrivial hypothesis.

contractions.name: Momentum-shell elimination plus rescaling (Wilson RG on theory space)

This induces a map on coupling space R_b : K -> K' obeying the SEMIGROUP law R_b o R_{b'} = R_{b b'}, with no inverse element. Differential form: Lambda dK_a/dLambda = beta_a(K) (Wegner-Houghton / Polchinski exact flow equation).
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The shell modes are genuinely integrated out -- traced over, not stored in an auxiliary register. The map is a marginalization of a probability measure, hence monotone under any data-processing/relative-entropy functional and strictly irreversible unless the shell decouples. In this domain the physical content is that the theory at cutoff Lambda/b is the complete description of all experiments resolving only wavelengths > b/Lambda, which is the operating regime of every thermodynamic and transport measurement in the record (specific heat, transport coefficients, gap spectra).
contractions.what_it_erases: The functional dependence on phi_>, i.e. all information in the shell beyond its induced contribution to the low-mode effective action. On coupling space, the pre-image of K' is generically a positive-codimension-zero set of distinct K's (many microscopic theories give the same effective theory one shell down).

contractions.name: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)
contractions.mathematical_form: lim_{n -> infinity} R_b^n (K) = K* for every K in W^s(K*), the stable manifold, which has codimension r = (number of relevant directions). Linearize: M_{ab} = partial K'_a / partial K_b at K*, with eigenvalues lambda_i = b^{y_i} and left eigenvectors defining scaling fields u_i, so u_i' = b^{y_i} u_i. On W^s all |b^{y_i}| < 1, so in a suitable norm R_b is locally a strict contraction mapping in the Banach sense; K* is its unique local fixed point.

contractions.what_it_erases: All finite-size corrections (including the exponentially small topological degeneracy splitting ~exp(-L/xi)), the boundary-to-bulk ratio, and the distinction between sequences of finite systems with the same limit.

kernel_elements.element: The fixed points K* themselves (the invariant set of the RG semigroup), and the discrete list of which fixed points exist for a given (d, symmetry).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Definitional and immediate: R_b K* = K* for all b, so the fixed set is the invariant set of the semigroup. No amount of iteration moves it. The flow acts on everything else; the fixed points are precisely the locus where it acts trivially. Note the fixed point's COORDINATES are scheme-dependent (a different blocking kernel puts K* elsewhere in coupling space); what is scheme-independent is its existence and the spectrum attached to it (next item).
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The full linearized eigenvalue spectrum {y_i} at K*, relevant AND irrelevant parts together (lambda_i = b^{y_i}).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The spectrum of M = dR_b/dK at K* is a similarity invariant, hence independent of the parametrization of coupling space and of where on W^s the trajectory began: every trajectory in W^s approaches K* and is governed by the same M. The contraction acts on the position in coupling space, not on the derivative of the map at its own fixed point. This is why exponents are universal while amplitudes are not.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The relevant directions and the unstable manifold W^u, with dim W^u = r = the number of parameters that must be tuned to reach criticality (r = 1 for Ising at zero field, 2 including the field).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Because the map is NOT a contraction there. Along a relevant eigendirection u_i' = b^{y_i} u_i with y_i > 0, so a perturbation grows as b^{n y_i} under iteration: coarse-graining amplifies it rather than removing it. The relevant spectrum is exactly the obstruction to R_b being contractive on all of coupling space, so it is the one structure the contraction provably cannot reach.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The critical exponents and the scaling laws among them: nu = 1/y_t, Delta = y_h/y_t, eta, plus Widom-Kadanoff-Rushbrooke-Fisher-Josephson relations and hyperscaling 2 - alpha = d nu.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: They are algebraic functions of the spectrum in the previous item, and the singular free energy f_s(t,h) = b^{-dn} f_s(b^{n y_t} t, b^{n y_h} h) is a fixed-point identity. The brief's measured alpha = -0.0127(3) maps by hyperscaling to nu = 0.6709(1); the small, documented tension with Monte-Carlo/bootstrap nu ~ 0.6717 is a live metrology question, not a breakdown of the kernel structure.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The leading irrelevant eigenvalue omega = -y_{first irrelevant}, controlling corrections to scaling (Wegner): C ~ |t|^{-alpha}(1 + a_1 |t|^{omega nu} + ...).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Sharp distinction the contraction respects: the VALUES of irrelevant couplings are driven to zero, but their EIGENVALUES are properties of M at K* and survive as universal correction exponents. The brief's domain_of_validity entry records exactly this -- universality holds asymptotically 'with measurable corrections to scaling'. Irrelevance is erasure of a coordinate, not of a direction.
kernel_elements.contraction: Momentum-shell elimination plus rescaling (Wilson RG on theory space)

kernel_elements.element: Exactly marginal directions (y = 0) and the coordinate along a line of fixed points: the Luttinger parameter K in d = 1, the 8-vertex/Ashkin-Teller line, the c = 1 compactification radius.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Neither contracted nor expanded: u' = b^0 u = u exactly. The coordinate along a marginal direction is a strict invariant of the flow, so it is carried from the UV to the IR unchanged and shows up as continuously varying critical exponents -- the sharpest counterexample to 'coarse-graining forgets couplings'.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Universal scaling functions and universal amplitude ratios: A^+/A^- = 1.053(2) (brief's measured value), R_xi, the Binder cumulant U_4, the universal finite-size amplitude.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The scaling function f_s(t,h) = |t|^{2-alpha} Phi(h/|t|^Delta) is fixed by the global flow along W^u emanating from K*, and only TWO non-universal metric factors (the scales of the nonlinear scaling fields t and h) are free. Any dimensionless ratio in which those two factors cancel is therefore a property of K* alone and cannot depend on the microscopic starting point.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The symmetry group G acting on the degrees of freedom: R_b o g = g o R_b.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: An admissible blocking kernel is constructed G-equivariantly, T(g sigma' | g sigma) = T(sigma'|sigma); then H'[g sigma'] = H'[sigma'] identically. So symmetry is neither destroyed nor manufactured by coarse-graining. This is the hinge on which every downstream protection statement hangs.
kernel_elements.contraction: Block-spin (Kadanoff) coarse-graining on configuration space

kernel_elements.element: The universality-class labels themselves: spatial dimension d, order-parameter component count n, the symmetry-breaking pattern G -> H, interaction range/analyticity (Sak's criterion for long-range interactions), particle statistics, presence of quenched randomness, and -- for dynamics -- the conservation laws (Hohenberg-Halperin models A/B/C/...).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are discrete, superselected data, not coordinates on coupling space that the flow moves. The flow is a map on couplings AT FIXED d, fixed symmetry and fixed conservation structure; it has no matrix element between classes. This is exactly why microscopically unrelated systems (He-4, XY magnets) share exponents 'by symmetry/dimension class alone', as the brief's formalism entry states.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The choice among competing/degenerate fixed points -- i.e. which basin of attraction a given microscopic theory lies in.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The contraction destroys the trajectory but not the identity of its endpoint. Which fixed point is reached is a global property of the initial theory that no local coarse-graining step can alter; and when several fixed points coexist at the same (d, symmetry) (e.g. Gaussian vs Wilson-Fisher; clean vs random; stable vs unstable multicritical), the basin label is strictly additional data over and above the class labels.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The monotone certifying irreversibility: Zamolodchikov's c-function in 2D (dC/dl <= 0, C(fixed point) = c); the F-theorem in 3D; the a-theorem in 4D.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: c is stationary only at fixed points and strictly decreasing along flows, so it is an invariant of the fixed point and simultaneously an obstruction to inverting the contraction: no RG flow runs from smaller c to larger c. In this domain c is directly observable -- the universal O(1/L) finite-size correction to the free energy and the entanglement entropy S = (c/3) ln(l) at a 1D quantum critical point.
kernel_elements.contraction: Momentum-shell elimination plus rescaling (Wilson RG on theory space)

kernel_elements.element: 't Hooft anomalies and Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) constraints: e.g. half-integer spin per unit cell with SO(3) plus lattice translation forbids a trivial gapped symmetric ground state -- the IR must be gapless, symmetry-broken, or topologically ordered.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: An anomaly is valued in a discrete (cohomology/cobordism) group and therefore cannot flow continuously; it is matched exactly between UV and IR. Mechanically: the flux-threading argument (Oshikawa 1997; Hastings 2004 in higher d) is a momentum-balance statement that uses only U(1) charge conservation and translation -- both exactly preserved by any admissible coarse-graining. This kernel element constrains which fixed points are even reachable from a given microscopic lattice.
kernel_elements.contraction: Momentum-shell elimination plus rescaling (Wilson RG on theory space)

kernel_elements.element: Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg exclusion: no spontaneous breaking of a continuous symmetry at T > 0 in d <= 2 with short-range interactions.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A rigorous theorem about the infinite-volume Gibbs state, independent of the coarse-graining scheme; it forbids a whole class of fixed points from existing at all, so the flow cannot reach them no matter what is integrated out. It is the reason the 2D XY case terminates in a BKT fixed line rather than an ordered fixed point.
kernel_elements.contraction: Thermodynamic and scaling limits (N -> infinity, a -> 0 at fixed xi)

kernel_elements.element: Dangerously irrelevant variables: an irrelevant coupling whose amplitude nevertheless survives in observables because the scaling function is singular as that coupling -> 0 (e.g. u above d_c = 4, where hyperscaling 2 - alpha = d nu fails and beta = 1/2 requires u).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Erasure by the flow is measured by the coupling going to zero; erasure from the physics requires in addition that the limit be regular. When Phi(x, u) ~ u^{-p} g(x u^q) the two come apart, and the irrelevant coupling re-enters every exponent above the upper critical dimension. This is the domain's proof that 'irrelevant' does not entail 'erased'.
kernel_elements.contraction: Momentum-shell elimination plus rescaling (Wilson RG on theory space)

kernel_elements.element: Boundary/surface data: the boundary universality class (ordinary, extraordinary, special) and surface exponents, and in 2D the choice of conformal boundary condition (Cardy state).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The bulk RG flow acts on bulk couplings; the boundary carries its own coupling space, its own fixed points and its own relevant spectrum. The bulk fixed point constrains the allowed boundary fixed points (they must be consistent with the bulk operator content) but does not select among them. So boundary data is asymptotic data the bulk flow structurally does not touch.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The two non-universal metric factors, i.e. the location of the critical manifold in coupling space -- and therefore T_c itself -- which the flow leaves undetermined.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Undetermined rather than invariant: fixed-point data (K*, M, the scaling functions) fixes the SHAPE of the singularity but says nothing about where in coupling space the singularity sits. T_c is set by where the microscopic trajectory pierces W^s, which is global, non-universal information that must be supplied from outside the fixed-point analysis. The brief's open_problems entry is the empirical shadow of this: four decades on, cuprate T_c values 'remain underived'.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Universal jumps at marginal flows: the Nelson-Kosterlitz jump rho_s(T_c^-)/T_c = 2 m^2 k_B / (pi hbar^2) at the BKT transition.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The KT flow is marginal (vortex fugacity marginally irrelevant below T_c), so the fixed line's endpoint -- the separatrix -- carries an exact universal number even though there is no isolated fixed point and no power-law exponent. It survives because it is the value of the stiffness AT the separatrix, a geometric property of the flow diagram rather than of any trajectory.
kernel_elements.contraction: Iteration to a fixed point on the critical manifold (the universality contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The Fermi surface as the fixed-point locus, and Luttinger's theorem: the enclosed volume is fixed by the particle density, independent of interaction strength.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Pinned by two exactly preserved structures: U(1) charge conservation and lattice translation. Oshikawa's flux-threading derivation (cond-mat/0002392) is non-perturbative -- adiabatically insert 2pi flux, undo it by a large gauge transformation, and compare crystal momenta -- so it does not rely on the perturbative expansion that could have been invalidated by the coarse-graining. Its failure mode is itself diagnostic: fractionalized FL* states evade it precisely by having extra topological sectors.
kernel_elements.contraction: Fermi-surface shell RG (Shankar / Polchinski contraction onto the Fermi surface)

kernel_elements.element: The marginal coupling functions on the Fermi surface: Landau functions F^s(theta), F^a(theta) (forward scattering) and the Cooper coupling V(theta).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: They sit on the two kinematic manifolds where the tree-level scaling dimension is exactly zero, so the contraction neither drives them to zero nor amplifies them at leading order. The infinite-dimensional quartic vertex is reduced to these two functions of angle -- and no further. This is the brief's Shankar entry: the reason 'a weakly-interacting quasiparticle description emerges from a strongly-interacting substrate'.
kernel_elements.contraction: Fermi-surface shell RG (Shankar / Polchinski contraction onto the Fermi surface)

kernel_elements.element: The sign of V_l in each angular-momentum channel, and hence the identity of the relevant instability: superconductivity. Kohn-Luttinger: some finite-l channel is always attractive, so the Fermi-liquid fixed point has an unavoidable relevant direction at T = 0.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: One-loop flow dV_l/d ln(Lambda_0/Lambda) = -V_l^2 makes the marginal coupling marginally relevant for V_l < 0 and marginally irrelevant for V_l > 0 -- a sign, which is discrete and cannot be continuously deformed away by further coarse-graining. The brief names this exact structure ('superconducting pairing as the identified relevant instability'). Kohn-Luttinger then shows that even a purely repulsive bare interaction generates attraction at high l via Friedel-oscillation overscreening.
kernel_elements.contraction: Fermi-surface shell RG (Shankar / Polchinski contraction onto the Fermi surface)

kernel_elements.element: Ward-identity-protected relations: Kohn's theorem (cyclotron resonance of a translationally invariant 2DEG occurs exactly at omega_c = eB/m, unrenormalized by electron-electron interactions) and the Galilean relation m*/m = 1 + F_1^s/3.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Non-renormalization by symmetry: the centre-of-mass coordinate decouples from all relative coordinates under a translationally invariant two-body interaction, so the dipole-active mode is exactly the free cyclotron mode regardless of correlation strength. No coarse-graining that preserves translations and Galilean boosts can shift it. This is the domain's cleanest instance of an exact quantity riding through an arbitrarily strong-coupling reduction.
kernel_elements.contraction: Fermi-surface shell RG (Shankar / Polchinski contraction onto the Fermi surface)

kernel_elements.element: The coset G/H and the Nambu-Goldstone count: n_A + 2 n_B = dim(G/H), with type-B modes (quadratic dispersion) arising when <[Q_a, Q_b]> != 0.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Goldstone masslessness is exact to all orders -- it is a Ward identity of the unbroken generators, not a tuned cancellation -- so no truncation of the flow can gap the modes. The nonrelativistic counting is a theorem (Watanabe & Murayama, PRL 108, 251602 (2012)), with n_B = (1/2) rank of the commutator matrix. Since G is preserved by equivariant blocking and H is defined by the order parameter, G/H passes through the Landau reduction untouched by construction.
kernel_elements.contraction: Landau order-parameter reduction (microscopic Hamiltonian -> Ginzburg-Landau functional)

kernel_elements.element: Homotopy classification of topological defects: pi_n(G/H) -- vortices with pi_1(U(1)) = Z in superfluids and superconductors, hence flux quantization in units of Phi_0 = h/2e.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Homotopy classes are invariant under continuous deformation of any map and of the target; coarse-graining deforms the GL coefficients continuously and cannot change pi_n(G/H) unless the symmetry-breaking pattern itself changes. A defect's winding number is an integral of a total derivative over a closed surface, so it is insensitive to any local modification of the configuration in the interior.
kernel_elements.contraction: Landau order-parameter reduction (microscopic Hamiltonian -> Ginzburg-Landau functional)

kernel_elements.element: Elitzur's theorem: a local gauge symmetry cannot be spontaneously broken -- so the Landau reduction cannot produce a gauge-invariant local order parameter for a superconductor. What survives instead is the Anderson-Higgs content: the gauge-field mass / London penetration depth, and (on a lattice) Z_2 topological order.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The theorem is an exact statement about finite-volume Gibbs averages of gauge-variant observables (they vanish identically at any nonzero gauge coupling), so it is not a statement the flow can override. Its corollary constrains the kernel from the other side: by Osterwalder-Seiler / Fradkin-Shenker, Higgs and confinement regimes are analytically connected for fundamental matter, so even the PHASE LABEL is not always a kernel element -- a useful negative result. The brief's Anderson 1963 entry is the positive content: the mass generation survives and was later exported to the electroweak sector.
kernel_elements.contraction: Landau order-parameter reduction (microscopic Hamiltonian -> Ginzburg-Landau functional)

kernel_elements.element: The Chern/TKNN integer and the quantized Hall conductance sigma_xy = C e^2/h, for interacting lattice fermions with finite-range interactions and a gapped ground state.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: An integer-valued function that is continuous in the couplings on the gapped set is locally constant, hence constant on each connected component; every coarse-graining step is a continuous deformation WITHIN the gapped phase. Hastings & Michalakis (arXiv:0911.4706, the brief's own entry) prove it without averaging assumptions, with corrections decaying stretched-exponentially in system size; later short proofs via Berry curvature on the flux torus (Bachmann, Bols, De Roeck & Fraas). Hypotheses -- gap and finite range -- are load-bearing, and the brief's domain_of_validity entry states the physical scope (mobility gap, low T, sub-breakdown current).
kernel_elements.contraction: Gapped-phase equivalence / entanglement RG (quasi-local unitary circuits)

kernel_elements.element: The fractional case: sigma_xy quantized to a rational with denominator equal to the topological ground-state degeneracy p.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A many-body Fredholm-type index whose value is fractional with denominator p, defined for any charge-conserving system with a topologically ordered p-dimensional gapped ground-state sector (Bachmann-Bols-De Roeck-Fraas). Being an index it is deformation-invariant on the gapped set. The brief correctly notes that the Hastings-Michalakis theorem does not cover the fractional case; this later result does, at the price of assuming the topological degeneracy.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gapped-phase equivalence / entanglement RG (quasi-local unitary circuits)

kernel_elements.element: Topological ground-state degeneracy on a genus-g surface (q^g for the Laughlin state at nu = 1/q; 4 for the toric code on a torus).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The degeneracy is not protected by any symmetry and has no local order parameter; it is exact up to splitting ~exp(-L/xi) because the states differ by non-contractible Wilson loops, which no quasi-local unitary of finite depth can implement. The entanglement RG is built from exactly such finite-depth circuits, so it cannot connect the sectors.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gapped-phase equivalence / entanglement RG (quasi-local unitary circuits)

kernel_elements.element: The full modular tensor category data of the anyon content: fusion rules N^c_{ab}, F- and R-symbols, modular S and T matrices, topological spins theta_a, quantum dimensions d_a, total quantum dimension D.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Ocneanu rigidity (proved by Etingof, Nikshych & Ostrik, Ann. Math. 162, 581 (2005)): a fusion category admits no nontrivial infinitesimal deformations of its monoidal structure, and there are only finitely many fusion categories with a given fusion ring. So this data is literally undeformable -- there is no continuous path along which the flow could move it, independent of any physical argument. The brief supplies the measured elements: e* = e/3 (shot noise, 1997, two groups) and exchange phase phi = pi/3 (collisions and Fabry-Perot interferometry, 2020, two methods).
kernel_elements.contraction: Effective-theory representation quotient (duality; K-matrix congruence)

kernel_elements.element: The chiral central charge c_- (thermal Hall conductance kappa_xy = c_- pi^2 k_B^2 T / (3h)), quantized in units of 1/2, with Kitaev's sixteenfold-way constraint relating c_- mod 8 to the anyon content.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: c_- is the framing anomaly of the bulk TQFT and equals the chiral central charge of the edge CFT; it is the obstruction to gapping the boundary. As a discrete invariant tied to the modular data through T = exp(2 pi i c_-/24) diag(theta_a), it inherits the rigidity of the previous item and is fixed by the S,T matrices.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gapped-phase equivalence / entanglement RG (quasi-local unitary circuits)

kernel_elements.element: Topological entanglement entropy gamma = ln D in S(region) = alpha L - gamma.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The entanglement RG removes only short-range-entangled (product) degrees of freedom, which contribute to the boundary-law coefficient alpha and not to the constant subleading term; the Kitaev-Preskill and Levin-Wen linear combinations are constructed precisely to cancel all local boundary contributions, leaving a quantity determined by the total quantum dimension alone.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gapped-phase equivalence / entanglement RG (quasi-local unitary circuits)

kernel_elements.element: Bulk-boundary correspondence: the number and chirality of protected edge/surface modes, which cannot be gapped without closing the bulk gap or breaking the protecting symmetry (anomaly inflow).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: For the integer QHE this is an index theorem: the bulk Chern number of the Fermi projection equals the edge index (Kellendonk-Schulz-Baldes; Elbau-Graf), so the edge data is rigidly tied to a bulk invariant that the contraction already cannot move. Laughlin's gauge argument, in the brief's formalism entry, is the physical version: quantization follows from gauge invariance plus a mobility gap, with no microscopic input.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gapped-phase equivalence / entanglement RG (quasi-local unitary circuits)

kernel_elements.element: Superselection sectors of the quasi-local observable algebra in the thermodynamic limit, identified with the anyon types.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Sectors are inequivalent irreducible representations of the same algebra; no operation in the algebra -- and coarse-graining is built from quasi-local operations -- can map between them. Rigorous for the toric code and related models (Naaijkens, and the DHR-style superselection analysis of the toric-code sectors); the general lattice statement is on weaker footing, which is why the grade is split.
kernel_elements.contraction: Thermodynamic and scaling limits (N -> infinity, a -> 0 at fixed xi)

kernel_elements.element: The index in the classifying group determined by (d, AZ class): Z, Z_2 or 0, with Bott periodicity (period 2 for the complex classes A and AIII, period 8 for the eight real classes); and, for crystalline cases, the symmetry-indicator / topological-quantum-chemistry data at high-symmetry momenta.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: For free fermions this is Kitaev's K-theoretic classification: the index is pi_0 of a classifying space, a homotopy invariant of the map from the Brillouin zone, so it is unchanged by any continuous gap-preserving deformation of the Hamiltonian. Symmetry indicators are representation labels -- discrete characters of the little group at high-symmetry points -- and characters cannot flow continuously.
kernel_elements.contraction: Symmetry-class projection (tenfold way / SPT labelling)

kernel_elements.element: The SPT class [omega] in H^{d+1}(G, U(1)) (bosonic; cobordism-refined in general), surviving into the interacting regime.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The classification group is discrete, so no continuous flow can move the label; equivalently, two SPT states in different classes are not related by any finite-depth G-symmetric local unitary. The kernel is smaller than the free-fermion one, which is itself informative: interactions collapse Z -> Z_8 in 1D class BDI (Fidkowski-Kitaev), showing that part of the free index was not protected at all.
kernel_elements.contraction: Symmetry-class projection (tenfold way / SPT labelling)

kernel_elements.element: The Harris criterion as the condition for the clean kernel to survive weak disorder: quenched randomness is irrelevant at a clean fixed point iff d nu > 2 (equivalently alpha < 0).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: It is a statement about the scaling dimension of the disorder coupling at the CLEAN fixed point, i.e. about the linearized spectrum -- already established as non-erasable. It is what licenses using clean-system exponents in dirty samples, and it is satisfied at the He-4 lambda point (alpha = -0.0127 < 0), which is why the brief's microgravity measurement can be compared with clean-system theory.
kernel_elements.contraction: Disorder averaging and the mobility-gap reduction

kernel_elements.element: The Chayes-Chayes-Fisher-Spencer bound: at any random fixed point, the finite-size-scaling correlation-length exponent obeys nu_FS >= 2/d.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A rigorous inequality on the flow itself: the flow cannot produce a disordered critical point violating it, so it is a constraint the contraction is unable to evade. Scope note verified: the bound is proved for the finite-size-scaling exponent nu_FS; at 'unconventional' random critical points the typical exponent nu_typ can be smaller, and the bound is not a statement about nu_typ.
kernel_elements.contraction: Disorder averaging and the mobility-gap reduction

kernel_elements.element: Exactness of the quantized invariant in the presence of strong disorder, via the non-commutative Chern number of the Fermi projection defined over a mobility gap.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Bellissard-van Elst-Schulz-Baldes construct the index in a non-commutative-geometry framework that needs only a mobility gap and localization, not a spectral gap or translational invariance. The invariant is therefore defined on the disorder-averaged algebra itself, i.e. AFTER the contraction has acted -- it is constructed to be a function of the quotient. This is why von Klitzing's plateaus are 'insensitive to the geometry of the device'.
kernel_elements.contraction: Disorder averaging and the mobility-gap reduction

kernel_elements.element: The GL(N,Z)-congruence invariants of the K-matrix: |det K| (torus ground-state degeneracy), the discriminant group Z^N / K Z^N (the anyon fusion group), the quadratic form q(l) = l^T K^{-1} l mod 2 (topological spins), and the signature of K (chiral central charge).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are exactly the complete invariants of an integral symmetric bilinear form under unimodular congruence K -> W^T K W. The quotient by GL(N,Z) is the precise mathematical content of 'the choice of effective-theory presentation is unphysical', and these are, by construction, the functions constant on each fiber. The brief's alternative_formulations entry -- Laughlin wavefunction, composite fermions, Chern-Simons, edge CFT 'agreeing on the observed fractions and quasiparticle content' -- is this statement in physics language.
kernel_elements.contraction: Effective-theory representation quotient (duality; K-matrix congruence)

kernel_elements.element: Existence of sharp non-analyticity and of multiple extremal DLR/KMS states (phase coexistence) as strictly infinite-volume facts; Lee-Yang zeros pinching the real axis.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: At finite N the free energy is an analytic function of the couplings (a finite sum of exponentials with positive weights), so no phase transition exists at all -- the entire phase structure is produced by the thermodynamic limit rather than surviving it, and it cannot be undone by any further coarse-graining because it is a property of the limit state. The brief's 2 nK resolution 'with no observed rounding' is the experimental check that the limit is being approached cleanly.
kernel_elements.contraction: Thermodynamic and scaling limits (N -> infinity, a -> 0 at fixed xi)

kernel_elements.element: Undetermined-by-the-flow residue on the disorder side: the IQHE plateau-transition fixed point exists and its localization-length exponent nu is a well-defined universal number, but that number is not delivered by any controlled analytic treatment.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Listed as kernel in the 'undetermined by the flow' sense the task allows: the contraction does not erase the existence or universality of the plateau-transition exponent, yet the fixed point is at strong coupling with no small parameter, and numerical values (nu ~ 2.4) remain unreconciled with proposed conformal field theories. Graded PLAUSIBLE because the claim that the fixed point is a single conventional critical point is itself contested in the literature.
kernel_elements.contraction: Disorder averaging and the mobility-gap reduction

kernel_elements.element: Deducibility is not a kernel element: substrate-level exactness of the Hamiltonian does not survive as computational access to the emergent level.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The inverse statement is the one being made -- and it is the brief's own known_disconnects entry. The 'Theory of Everything' Hamiltonian is exactly known for every material, direct solution fails beyond ~10 particles, and superconductivity and the FQHE fractions were found by experiment plus effective-level reasoning. So what the contraction leaves invariant (exponents, indices, anyon data) is systematically NOT what a bottom-up calculation can reach. Noted here to prevent the kernel list from being read as a derivation route; the brief marks this a deducibility-in-practice statement, not an in-principle underivability theorem, and BCS shows post-hoc derivation can succeed.
kernel_elements.contraction: Block-spin (Kadanoff) coarse-graining on configuration space

things_erased_completely: Within-block microstates. The blocking map has fibers of size ~2^{N(1 - b^{-d})}; the joint microscopic configuration is not recoverable from the block variables at any finite b, and the loss compounds multiplicatively under iteration.

All correlations at separations below the running cutoff. After n steps, G(r) for r << b^n a is unrecoverable; only the long-wavelength tail is carried forward. Structure factors, local bonding, and short-range order are gone.

The numerical values of all irrelevant couplings at the microscopic scale: they decay as b^{-n|y_i|}. (Their EIGENVALUES survive as correction-to-scaling exponents, and dangerously irrelevant couplings survive through the scaling function -- but the bare values themselves do not.)

The identity of the substrate. Chemical composition, band structure, lattice constant, bandwidth, phonon spectrum. The brief's 8.6e-11 GaAs-vs-graphene agreement is the direct measurement that the substrate label has been destroyed inside R_K.

Non-universal amplitudes and every dimensionful scale in the universal sector: T_c, T_lambda, the gap magnitude, xi_0, the individual amplitudes C^+ and C^- (only their ratio survives), the cutoff Lambda, and the numerical coordinates of K* itself (these are blocking-scheme dependent, unlike the spectrum at K*).

The RG trajectory. The entire codimension-r critical manifold W^s maps to the single point K*; where on W^s the system started, and by what route it arrived, are unrecoverable in principle, not merely in practice.

The microscopic mechanism behind an ordered phase. Phonon-mediated pairing is invisible in the Ginzburg-Landau functional; by Gor'kov's derivation the only surviving trace is the numerical values of a, r, u -- and any other mechanism producing those same three numbers is, at GL level, the identical theory.

Single-particle content in strongly correlated phases. The FQHE liquid retains no single-particle explanation (the discovery paper's own Wigner-solid/CDW proposal was superseded); the constituents' integer charge e and fermionic statistics are absent from the effective-level labels e* = e/3 and phi = pi/3, even though the substrate contains fermions of charge e only.

The disorder realization. The specific impurity landscape, the device geometry, and (when d*nu > 2) the disorder strength itself. Only whether disorder is relevant, plus the universality-relevant features of the distribution, survive the average.

Part of the free-fermion topological index. Switching on interactions collapses Z -> Z_8 in 1D class BDI (Fidkowski-Kitaev) -- the subgroup 8Z is destroyed -- and analogous collapses occur in other classes. Separately, all band-structure data (Bloch eigenvectors, dispersions, gap sizes) is erased by the symmetry-class projection, leaving only the index.

The choice of effective-theory presentation: the representative K-matrix within a GL(N,Z) congruence class, the number N of Chern-Simons gauge fields, the parton/flux-attachment decomposition, and the Laughlin-wavefunction vs composite-fermion vs Chern-Simons vs edge-CFT distinction. Nothing observable separates them.

Gauge-variant data. By Elitzur's theorem no local order parameter for a gauge symmetry exists in the first place, so the 'broken U(1) of a superconductor' is not merely erased -- it was never a well-defined quantity to retain. And by Osterwalder-Seiler / Fradkin-Shenker the Higgs/confinement PHASE LABEL itself can be erased, since the two regimes are analytically connected for fundamental matter.

Fermi-liquid non-universal parameters: the quasiparticle residue Z, the effective mass m*, the Fermi velocity, and the individual Landau-parameter values. The RELATIONS among them (Wilson ratio, Galilean m*/m = 1 + F_1^s/3) survive; the numbers do not.
The analytic background of thermodynamic functions. Only the singular part has a scheme-independent meaning; the regular part is redefined at each blocking step and carries no invariant content.

The inverse direction of the flow. The RG is a semigroup with no inverse, and this is certified, not merely conjectured: c(UV) > c(IR) by the c-theorem (F- and a-theorems in higher d). The ultraviolet theory is provably not reconstructible from the infrared fixed point.
kernels.method_note:
Selection method. I enumerated candidate maps by asking, for each structural reduction the domain actually performs, whether it has nontrivial fibers as a matter of physics rather than of technique -- i.e. whether two demonstrably distinct inputs are mapped to the same output and the domain's own experiments certify that they are. That yielded ten: three faces of the Wilsonian flow proper (configuration-level blocking; theory-space shell elimination; iteration to the fixed point, which are distinct maps with distinct kernels and should not be conflated), the Fermi-surface variant with a codimension-1 fixed-point locus, the Landau order-parameter reduction, the gapped-phase/quasi-local-unitary equivalence, the symmetry-class projection, disorder averaging, the effective-theory representation quotient, and the thermodynamic/scaling limit. I excluded maps that are lossy only as a matter of computational practice (mean-field decoupling, truncated perturbation series, finite-cluster diagonalization): they lose information but nothing in the domain asserts their fibers are physically indistinguishable.

Kernel method. For each contraction I asked what obstructs its inversion, and required one of four kinds of argument rather than an appeal to robustness: (i) the map acts trivially there by construction (fixed points, equivariance, marginal directions); (ii) the quantity is valued in a discrete set and depends continuously on the couplings, so it is locally constant (Chern number, SPT class, anyon data via Ocneanu rigidity, chiral central charge, symmetry indicators); (iii) the map is expanding rather than contracting there (relevant directions, and the spectrum at the fixed point, which is a similarity invariant); (iv) the quantity is fixed by an exactly preserved symmetry or Ward identity (Goldstone count, Luttinger's theorem via flux threading, Kohn's theorem, LSM/anomaly matching). I also deliberately included two categories that a naive reading of 'contraction' would misclassify: irrelevant-direction EIGENVALUES (universal, though their couplings are erased) and dangerously irrelevant variables (erased by the flow yet present in every observable above d_c).

Brief influence. The briefs supplied the domain's empirical anchors and several specific kernel elements: the He-4 alpha = -0.0127(3) and A+/A- = 1.053(2) (universal exponent and amplitude ratio), the graphene-vs-GaAs 8.6e-11 test (the measured statement that the substrate is in the fiber), e* = e/3 and phi = pi/3 (measured modular data), the Hastings-Michalakis theorem with its gap-plus-finite-range hypotheses, the Shankar Fermi-liquid fixed point with pairing as the identified relevant instability, the Gor'kov BCS-to-GL limit, the Elitzur-adjacent Anderson 1963 mass-generation item, and the domain_of_validity entry establishing that the topological kernel is conditional (mobility gap, low T, sub-breakdown current) rather than exact simpliciter. The briefs also supplied two negative constraints I built into the kernel list: the high-Tc entry, which I used as the empirical face of 'T_c is undetermined by fixed-point data', and the Laughlin-Pines known_disconnect, which I recorded explicitly so the kernel list is not misread as a bottom-up derivation route.

What did NOT come from the briefs. Ocneanu rigidity, the c-/F-/a-theorems, LSM and flux-threading anomaly matching, Oshikawa's topological Luttinger derivation, Watanabe-Murayama Goldstone counting, Kohn's theorem, the Harris criterion and the Chayes-Chayes-Fisher-Spencer bound, Bellissard-van Elst-Schulz-Baldes, Kellendonk-Schulz-Baldes bulk-edge, the Bachmann-Bols-De Roeck-Fraas fractional many-body index, the Fidkowski-Kitaev Z -> Z_8 collapse, Elitzur and Fradkin-Shenker, van Enter-Fernandez-Sokal on RG-map ill-definedness, Wegner corrections to scaling, and the Nelson-Kosterlitz jump are all from my own physics knowledge. I verified four load-bearing items by search before grading them THEOREM: Ocneanu rigidity (Etingof-Nikshych-Ostrik, Ann. Math. 162, 581 (2005) -- fusion categories admit no nontrivial deformations, finitely many per fusion ring); the CCFS bound (confirmed, and confirmed to apply to the finite-size-scaling exponent nu_FS, with nu_typ able to be smaller at unconventional random critical points -- I narrowed the claim accordingly); Watanabe-Murayama (PRL 108, 251602 (2012)); and Oshikawa's non-perturbative Luttinger argument (cond-mat/0002392). I also checked that a rigorous fractional-conductance index exists, since the brief explicitly says Hastings-Michalakis does not cover the fractional case; it does (Bachmann-Bols-De Roeck-Fraas many-body Fredholm index, fractional with denominator equal to the degeneracy), which is why that element is graded THEOREM rather than STANDARD. Confidence grading is deliberately conservative: THEOREM only where I can name the theorem and its hypotheses, STANDARD for textbook-level results whose general formulation carries scope conditions, PLAUSIBLE for the two items (general lattice superselection sectors; the plateau-transition fixed point's status) where the literature is genuinely unsettled. I read only condensed_matter_emergence.json in the blinded directory and no file outside it.

contractions.name: Macrostate coarse-graining (Boltzmann partition / conditional expectation onto macrovariables)
contractions.mathematical_form: A partition of phase space by a chosen set of macrovariables: pi: Gamma -> M, x |-> M(x), with fibers Gamma_M = pi^{-1}(M) of Liouville measure |Gamma_M| and S_B(M) = k_B ln |Gamma_M|. On measures it is the idempotent conditional expectation E[.|sigma(M)]: rho |-> rho-bar = sum_M ( int_{Gamma_M} rho dmu / |Gamma_M| ) 1_{Gamma_M}, i.e. rho-bar is constant on each fiber. Composition with the Hamiltonian flow gives the coarse-grained evolution rho_t-bar = E[Phi_t rho | sigma(M)], which is NOT a semigroup and is not invertible.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The domain's central quantity is defined by the degeneracy of this map, not merely computed with its help: entropy IS the log of the fiber volume (the brief records 'entropy = state-counting over coarse-grainings' and 'thermodynamics EMERGES_FROM coarse-graining -- CLOSED at the effective layer'). The underlying flow is exactly measure-preserving and one-to-one (the brief carries Carcassi-Aidala: Hamiltonian evolution is 'exactly a one-to-one map between past and future states'), so entropy increase can only live in the projection step. Remove the many-to-oneness and there is no thermodynamics left to derive. This is the operative contraction because the second law is a statement about how fibers of pi deform under an invertible flow.
contractions.what_it_erases: The microstate coordinate inside the fiber -- of order exp(S_B/k_B) distinctions -- and with it the ability to retrodict the past microstate or to run the coarse description backwards.

contractions.name: Boltzmann-Grad limit with molecular-chaos closure (BBGKY truncation at the one-particle marginal)
contractions.mathematical_form: N -> infinity, hard-sphere diameter a -> 0 with N a^{d-1} = const (mean free path ell fixed) and N a^d -> 0 (vanishing volume fraction). The map sends the N-particle measure to its first marginal, mu_N |-> f_1 = int mu_N dx_2...dx_N, and closes the BBGKY hierarchy by imposing factorization on the INCOMING half of the collision sphere: f_2(x,v,x + a n, v_*) = f_1(x,v) f_1(x,v_*) for (v - v_*).n < 0 (Stosszahlansatz), i.e. all connected correlation functions g_s, s >= 2, are set to zero pre-collision. Result: df/dt + v.grad f = Q(f,f). Lanford (1975) proves convergence for |t| < t_0 of order one fifth of a mean free time.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The BBGKY hierarchy is exactly as time-reversal symmetric as Newton's equations; the H-theorem appears only after the pre-collisional factorization is imposed. The brief records precisely that this closure is not a dynamical consequence: Partovi (PRE 77, 021110) constructs entangled high-correlation initial states -- the opposite of molecular chaos -- for which heat flows cold to hot at unchanged dynamics. So the erasure of pre-collisional correlations is not a computational convenience layered onto an already-irreversible dynamics; it is the entire source of the irreversibility of the kinetic equation. The limit is also many-to-one on models: every interaction with the same differential cross-section gives the same Boltzmann equation.
contractions.what_it_erases: All pre-collisional two- and higher-particle correlations, recollision and ring-diagram sequences, particle labels, the entire hierarchy above f_1, the sphere diameter a, and (in the image of the map) the velocity-reversed solution branch.

contractions.name: Hydrodynamic limit / Chapman-Enskog projection onto the null space of the linearized collision operator
contractions.mathematical_form: Knudsen number Kn = ell/L -> 0 under hyperbolic (x -> eps x, t -> eps t) or diffusive (t -> eps^2 t) scaling. Write f = M[n,u,T](1 + h); linearize the collision operator about the Maxwellian, L h = 2 Q(M, M h)/M, self-adjoint and negative semidefinite in L^2(M^{-1} dv). The contraction is the orthogonal projector P_hyd onto N(L) = span{1, v, |v|^2}, dim = d + 2: f |-> (rho, rho u, E) = <(1, v, |v|^2/2) f>_v. The complement is slaved order by order, (1 - P)h = -L^{-1}(1 - P)(d_t + v.grad)M/M + O(Kn^2), producing Euler at O(1) and Navier-Stokes-Fourier at O(Kn) with eta, zeta, kappa read off from L^{-1}.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The many-to-oneness is enforced by a spectral fact about L, not by a modelling choice: L has a spectral gap on N(L)^perp for hard spheres and hard potentials (Carleman; Grad; constructive estimates by Baranger-Mouhot), so every component outside N(L) decays at rate >= 1/tau while components inside N(L) have relaxation rates that vanish as k -> 0. After a few collision times, distinct kinetic distributions sharing the same d+2 moments are dynamically indistinguishable. That is a genuine collapse of the state space from a function of v to d+2 numbers per point, and it is what 'slow modes vs fast modes' names in this domain.
contractions.what_it_erases: The entire gapped spectrum of L (all non-hydrodynamic kinetic modes), the initial Knudsen layer discarded in Chapman-Enskog matching, and all microscopic data except the equation of state and a finite list of transport coefficients.

contractions.name: Local-equilibrium (MaxEnt / Zubarev-Robertson) relevant-density map
contractions.mathematical_form: Given a declared list of relevant observables {A_a}, the map rho |-> rho_rel = exp[-sum_a lambda_a(t) A_a]/Z[lambda], with the Lagrange multipliers lambda_a(t) fixed uniquely by the constraints Tr(rho_rel A_a) = Tr(rho A_a). It is an idempotent (nonlinear) projection whose fibers are the convex sets of all states sharing the same relevant moments. In the hydrodynamic instance A_a = (n(x), p(x), e(x)) and lambda_a = (-beta mu, beta u, beta)(x,t).
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The brief lists local equilibrium as a PRIMITIVE of the hydrodynamic-level description -- 'separation of time scales between fast microscopic relaxation and slow hydrodynamic variables ... assumed rather than derived' -- and the corresponding microscopic-derivation gap (Fourier's law) is recorded as an open problem. So this map is the point at which the domain's own accounting says information is put in by hand rather than extracted. Its contractiveness is exact and quantifiable: S[rho_rel] - S[rho] = D(rho || rho_rel) is literally the discarded information.
contractions.what_it_erases: Every correlation and moment not in the declared relevant list; the distinction between any two states with identical relevant moments; all memory of how the state arrived at those moments.

contractions.name: Mori-Zwanzig projection and its Markov-Gaussian closure
contractions.mathematical_form: Mori inner product (X,Y) = <X Y*>_eq; projector P X = (X, A).(A,A)^{-1}.A, P^2 = P, P^dagger = P, Q = 1 - P. Exact generalized Langevin equation: dA/dt = i Omega.A - int_0^t K(s) A(t-s) ds + F(t), with Omega = (LA, A)(A,A)^{-1}, F(t) = e^{i Q L t} Q i L A, and the second FDT K(t) = (F(t), F)(A,A)^{-1}. Two nested maps: (i) the linear projection P, with kernel ran Q; (ii) the physical closure F -> Gaussian white noise, K(t) -> 2 gamma delta(t) with gamma = K-tilde(0) = int_0^infinity K(s) ds.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Stage (i) is a bona fide idempotent projection -- any two microscopic observables differing by an element of ran Q have the same image -- but it loses nothing if the orthogonal dynamics is kept: the identity is exact. The brief states the operative point exactly: the construction is 'exact but not by itself predictive: the kernel is defined through projected dynamics whose evaluation is generally as hard as the original problem.' The real contraction is therefore stage (ii), where the deterministic orthogonal dynamics is relabelled as noise and the memory kernel is collapsed to its zero-frequency value. The brief's primitive -- 'the choice of projection operator ... is a declared input of the construction, not an output of it; different choices redistribute content between systematic, memory, and noise terms' -- says that the fibration itself is exogenous, which is what makes this a contraction with a chosen, not a discovered, kernel.
contractions.what_it_erases: At the closure step: the whole frequency dependence of K-tilde(omega) beyond K-tilde(0); all cumulants of F above the second; and the deterministic identity of e^{iQLt} Q iLA, which is rewritten as randomness.

contractions.name: Relaxation semigroup / approach to equilibrium (t -> infinity limit of a dissipative flow)
contractions.mathematical_form: Lambda_t = e^{L t}, a Markov (Fokker-Planck, master-equation, or GKLS) semigroup. Contractive in relative entropy by the data-processing inequality, D(Lambda_t rho || Lambda_t sigma) <= D(rho || sigma). For an ergodic generator with stationary state rho_eq, lim_{t->infinity} Lambda_t = rho_eq Tr(.), a rank-one map: the entire basin collapses to a single point. Equivalent statements in the domain: dH/dt <= 0 (Boltzmann), <Delta s_tot> >= 0 by Jensen applied to Seifert's integral fluctuation theorem <exp(-Delta s_tot)> = 1.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: This is not a reduction imposed on the physics -- it is the phenomenon the description group names. The brief carries it at observation level (isolated quantum many-body systems relax to equilibrium-statistical-mechanics states, with ETH as the mechanism) and at formalism level (Lieb-Yngvason second law, Seifert IFT). Its non-invertibility is the physical content: infinitely many preparations become one equilibrium state, distinguishable afterwards only by their conserved charges.
contractions.what_it_erases: All initial-condition information within a basin of attraction except the conserved-charge labels; for non-integrable systems, per ETH, even the eigenstate-to-eigenstate variation of few-body observables.

contractions.name: Thermodynamic (many-mode / continuum) limit
contractions.mathematical_form: N, V -> infinity at fixed N/V; the net of finite-volume Gibbs states omega_{Lambda, beta} converges (weak-*) to a KMS state omega_beta on the quasi-local algebra. Spectrally: the discrete mode set {omega_k} is replaced by a continuous spectral density J(omega) = sum_k g_k^2 delta(omega - omega_k) -> continuous, which converts the quasi-periodic dephasing function Gamma(t) into a genuinely decaying one and sends the Poincare recurrence time t_rec -> infinity.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The brief's own limits entry states it: 'Strict irreversibility exists only in the many-mode/thermodynamic (continuum) limit: finite closed systems recur (Poincare), with recurrence time growing with mode number.' Every other contraction in this group inherits its strictness from this one -- at finite N the coarse-grained entropy eventually comes back down. It is also many-to-one on theories: microscopically distinct finite sequences with the same free-energy density have the same limit, and the limit algebra supports disjoint representations that no finite-volume state distinguishes.
contractions.what_it_erases: Poincare recurrences, the discrete spectrum and its quasi-periodicity, all subextensive and surface contributions to bulk densities, and the differences among finite systems sharing a limit.

contractions.name: Near-equilibrium linearization to the transport matrix (Kubo / Green-Kubo / Onsager)
contractions.mathematical_form: J_i = sum_j L_ij X_j, with L_ij = (1/k_B V) int_0^infinity dt <J_i(t) J_j(0)>_eq (Green-Kubo), equivalently chi_AB(t) = (i/hbar) theta(t) <[A(t), B]>_eq (Kubo). The map sends the pair (microscopic Hamiltonian, equilibrium reference state) to a finite list: equation of state plus the matrix {L_ij}.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The entire predictive content of the domain at macroscopic scale is that finite list. Two microscopic models with the same conservation laws, symmetry group, dimension and the same Green-Kubo integrals are macroscopically identical -- an infinite-dimensional space of Hamiltonians maps onto a finite-dimensional space of transport matrices. The brief's domain_of_validity entry fixes the map's scope (near-equilibrium linear regime around an equilibrium reference state, with field-reversal completion), which is exactly the statement that the map is defined only on a neighbourhood of the fiber's basepoint.
contractions.what_it_erases: Everything about the microscopic interaction except the zero-frequency flux autocorrelation integrals and the static thermodynamics; all nonlinear response; and the manifest time-reversal symmetry of the parent dynamics (which survives only as a constraint on the coefficients).

contractions.name: Dynamic renormalization-group flow to a nonequilibrium universality class
contractions.mathematical_form: R_b: x -> b x, t -> b^z t, h -> b^alpha h, inducing a flow on couplings {g}; fixed point R_b g* = g*, with linearization dg/dl = M (g - g*) whose eigenvalues split into relevant (positive), marginal, and irrelevant (negative) directions. For KPZ: d_t h = nu grad^2 h + (lambda/2)(grad h)^2 + eta, with exponents in 1+1 D alpha = 1/2, z = 3/2, beta = alpha/z = 1/3.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The contraction is experimentally demonstrated in this domain rather than assumed. The brief's VERIFIED phenomenon entry (Takeuchi-Sano, PRL 104, 230601) reports that growing interfaces in nematic liquid-crystal electroconvection -- a system sharing essentially no microscopic structure with a polymer-growth or exclusion-process model -- reproduce the same exponents AND the same random-matrix (Tracy-Widom) height-fluctuation distributions. Distinct theories have literally become identical under the flow, which is the definition demanded. The kernel-versus-erased split here is the sharpest in the whole group: irrelevant directions are provably erased, relevant ones provably not.
contractions.what_it_erases: The entire infinite-dimensional space of irrelevant couplings, all non-universal amplitudes and short-distance cutoffs, and the microscopic realization of the growth rule.

contractions.name: Partial observation / state lumping in stochastic thermodynamics
contractions.mathematical_form: A lumping map Phi from microstates (or full trajectories) to observed states/trajectories. The apparent entropy production is sigma_cg = D(P[Phi omega] || P-dagger[Phi omega-tilde]) computed on the observed path measure, versus the true sigma = D(P || P-dagger) on the full one. Monotonicity of relative entropy under the (stochastic) map Phi gives sigma_cg <= sigma (Esposito, PRE 85, 041125 (2012), and the subsequent bound literature).
