This sharply separates 'coarse-graining the description' from 'coarse-graining the dynamics', and it is why non-Markovianity is a statement about the generator, not about lost data.
kernel_elements.contraction: C4

kernel_elements.element: The monotone direction: for a semigroup with stationary sigma, D(rho_t || sigma) is non-increasing in t, and Spohn's entropy-production functional is non-negative and convex.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Monotonicity of relative entropy under CPTP maps (Lindblad-Uhlmann) plus L(sigma) = 0 gives the inequality immediately; no dynamical detail enters. The contraction therefore cannot reverse its own arrow — irreversibility is not a contingent feature of particular models but a structural consequence of the class. Combined with Petz: the relative entropy is STRICTLY decreasing except on the sufficient subalgebra, so the arrow and the kernel are two faces of one theorem.

kernel_elements.element: Impossibility of manufacturing non-Markovian signatures: no CPTP map can increase trace distance, so observed information backflow certifies that the underlying dynamics is not CP-divisible.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: This is the contrapositive of C2's own contractivity, so it is as strong as C2 itself. The contraction cannot erase the *evidential* value of a backflow observation, because producing one is outside its range. The briefs flag contractivity as the basis of trace-distance non-Markovianity witnesses; I note that the briefs also record that no single canonical non-Markovianity measure is established (Breuer, Laine, Piilo & Vacchini, RMP 88, 021002 (2016)), so the witness is one-sided: backflow certifies non-divisibility, its absence certifies nothing.
kernel_elements.contraction: C2

kernel_elements.element: Redundant pointer records in environment fragments: for a fragment F of modest size, I(S:F) plateaus at the classical pointer entropy H(p_n), so discarding most of E does not erase the pointer information.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Redundancy: the pointer information is imprinted into many mutually-nearly-independent environmental subsystems, so the fibre of the fragment-tracing map does not collapse it. Only pointer-basis (classical) information has this property — non-pointer observables are recorded in at most one fragment's worth and are destroyed generically. I grade STANDARD rather than THEOREM because the redundancy plateau is established within model classes (spin baths, photon environments, and the general-emergence results) rather than as an unconditional theorem for arbitrary H_int, and the briefs carry environment-induced superselection at the Zurek-1981/RMP-2003 level without a fragment-level certificate.
kernel_elements.contraction: C8

kernel_elements.element: The choice among degenerate stationary states is NOT made by the flow: it is fixed entirely by the initial data through the finite list {Tr[J_mu^dag rho_in]}.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: This is the task's 'undetermined-by-the-flow' category in its exact form. When dim L_ss > 1 the generator does not select a point on the steady-state manifold; the selection is carried in from t = 0 by conserved quantities and is untouchable by the dynamics, because those quantities are by construction annihilated by L^dag. Correspondingly the flow cannot be blamed for, or credited with, the selection: the degeneracy label is boundary data, not dynamical output.
kernel_elements.contraction: C3

kernel_elements.element: The dissipator as a superoperator, and the Kossakowski matrix in a fixed traceless orthonormal basis, as complete invariants of the generator.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The GKLS gauge freedom L_j -> L_j + c_j 1 with compensating H -> H + (1/2i) sum_j (c_j^* L_j - c_j L_j^dag), together with unitary mixing of the L_j, leaves the generator invariant. But once the Lindblad operators are required traceless in a fixed orthonormal basis, the Kossakowski matrix and a traceless H are determined uniquely (Gorini, Kossakowski & Sudarshan). So although the individual L_j are never recoverable, the dissipator superoperator always is. The contraction erases the parametrization, not the object.
kernel_elements.contraction: C5, C9

kernel_elements.element: Non-analytic structure in frequency: the absorptive part of a response function cannot be generated or removed by any analytic/local (contact) redefinition.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Adding an analytic P(omega) to Sigma(omega) changes only the analytic part; the discontinuity across the cut, and any non-analytic dependence, is untouched by construction, since the class of admissible redefinitions is analytic by definition. Equivalently in the time domain: delta-function (zero-memory) additions to K(t) cannot alter genuine memory. This is the general kernel of C9 and I grade it STANDARD as a general principle of dispersive/absorptive response. The briefs' de Sitter boundary entry is an instance of exactly this argument, but it is flagged PROGRAM-RESULT (in-house, unreviewed, scoped to a certified non-analytic sector through H^6 with a declared reality premise), so I cite the general principle and not the instance.
kernel_elements.contraction: C9

kernel_elements.element: The definite outcome, and branch selection, are outside the flow's reach in both directions — neither produced by it nor erased by it.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The reduced-dynamics contraction has no observable in its own algebra whose value is 'the outcome'; the derivation chain terminates at the reduced-state layer. The briefs record this as an explicit disconnect ('decoherence does NOT yield a definite outcome') with community concurrence noted at Zurek RMP 2003, and record the narrowed permitted claim 'decoherence observables alone do not determine branch weights' (this narrower statement is PROGRAM-RESULT, in-house; the briefs explicitly prohibit the stronger full-reduced-state version, since p_0 is itself a reduced-state observable — so the pointer-basis diagonal, which IS the Born weights, does survive as kernel element 13 above). I grade the outcome statement STANDARD as an established open problem rather than THEOREM, because it is an absence of derivation, not a no-go proof.
kernel_elements.contraction: C3, C8

kernel_elements.element: The semigroup composition law Lambda_{t+s} = Lambda_t Lambda_s as the structural invariance of the Markovian theory (and CP-divisibility as its differential form).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Once C5 has acted, the composition law is an identity of the exponential map e^{L(t+s)} = e^{Lt} e^{Ls} and cannot be broken by anything inside the resulting theory. The briefs list it under symmetries for exactly this reason. Note the direction: C5 does not preserve divisibility from the microscopic theory, it IMPOSES it — which is why the law is kernel of the Markovian theory but is one of the things C5 erases from the exact one.
kernel_elements.contraction: C5

things_erased_completely: Global purity and the identity of the purification. A pure entangled rho_SE and a proper classical mixture with the same S-marginal become the same object under Tr_E; no measurement on S can separate them and no CPTP map on S can restore the distinction.

The environment's state, its Hilbert-space dimension beyond the Kraus rank, and the global unitary. U and (1_S ⊗ V)U give the identical channel; only the minimal dilation survives, and only up to a unitary on it.
The Kraus decomposition. K_i -> sum_j u_ij K_j is invisible in the channel; only the Choi matrix is an invariant. There is no such thing as 'the' set of Lindblad operators.

The Hamiltonian-versus-dissipator attribution, absent a traceless-basis convention. L_j -> L_j + c_j 1 with the compensating shift of H leaves the generator identical, so 'which part of the dynamics is coherent' is a pure gauge choice.

The entire decaying sector of the initial state: d^2 - sum_kappa n_kappa^2 real dimensions, multiplied by |lambda|^n -> 0. Everything in the initial condition except the conserved expectation values Tr[J_mu^dag rho_in] is destroyed by the asymptotic flow.
All pointer-basis coherences rho_{n != m}, exponentially and irreversibly. Once below the noise floor, data processing forbids their recovery by any physical map on S.

All bath microstructure off the on-shell set under the Davies limit: individual mode frequencies, couplings, masses, the bath Hamiltonian's spectrum away from Bohr(H_S), the bath dimension. The dissipator sees only {gamma_{alpha beta}(omega) : omega in Bohr(H_S)}. Uncountably many distinct microscopic theories collapse to one generator. (Partial exception: the Lamb shift retains a principal-value functional of the full spectral density.)
All individual oscillator data under Feynman-Vernon: c_n, m_n, omega_n, and the oscillator count. Only J(omega) and beta survive, exactly and with no approximation.

All bath memory in the Markovian limit: the correlation time tau_B is sent to zero and the Nakajima-Zwanzig kernel collapses, K(t) -> delta(t) times its zero-frequency weight. Every non-Markovian feature of the exact dynamics is destroyed by construction, and information backflow becomes impossible.

All non-secular, cross-Bohr-frequency couplings in the generator, annihilated by the time-averaging projection P_sec. Near-degenerate Bohr frequencies that the average merges are no longer distinguishable in the limiting theory.
The short-time (Zeno) regime. The semigroup decays strictly exponentially from t = 0, erasing the quadratic short-time behaviour of the exact dynamics and with it the quantum Zeno structure.

Time-reversal and microreversibility inside the physical class. A channel on the same space with a CPTP inverse must be a unitary conjugation (Nayak & Sen 2007), so every genuinely open channel is one-way: only t >= 0 is defined for the semigroup.

The unraveling, the trajectory, and the environmental measurement record. Every monitoring scheme averages to the same Lindblad generator, so nothing in rho(t) distinguishes quantum jumps from quantum state diffusion from homodyne detection, and no conditional/selective information survives the ensemble average.

The Noether bijection between continuous symmetries and conserved quantities. In unitary dynamics [J,H] = 0 <=> J-dot = 0 <=> U^dag H U = H; in dissipative dynamics four of these arrows are lost (Albert & Jiang 2014). Conserved quantities need not generate symmetries and symmetry generators need not be conserved. The implication [J,H] = [J,L_l] = 0 for all l => both is the only survivor, and it is one-way.

Initial system-environment correlations, erased by declaration rather than by dynamics. With Q rho(0) != 0 the reduced map need not even be completely positive (Pechukas, PRL 73, 1060 (1994)), so the CPTP framework purchases its own well-definedness by discarding the correlated sector at t = 0.

The distinction, at the level of rho_S alone, between environment-induced decoherence and a genuine collapse. The reduced state is blind to the difference, which is precisely why the outcome problem is not addressed by any map on this list.

The analytic contact part of any response function, and with it the scheme-dependent polynomial-order content of Re Sigma; only the non-analytic (absorptive/memory) structure is invariant under local redefinitions.
kernels.method_note:
SELECTION CRITERION. I admitted a map as a contraction only if it is demonstrably many-to-one — exhibiting the fibre explicitly — and I deliberately separated two levels that are often conflated in this domain: contractions on STATE space (C1, C2, C3, C4, C7, C8) and contractions on THEORY space, where distinct microphysical models become the same object (C5, C6, C9). The task's phrase 'distinct configurations OR THEORIES become identical' is what forced the second level in; without C5/C6 the answer would be a structure theorem for channels and would miss the part of the domain where the erasure is most violent. I also resisted the common slip of equating 'contractive' with 'non-invertible': a CPTP map is non-expansive for trace distance but need not be strictly many-to-one on any given pair (a weak depolarizing channel is an invertible linear map whose inverse is merely not positive). The precise criterion I used for irreversibility-within-the-class is Nayak-Sen: on a fixed Hilbert space, a channel with a CPTP inverse is a unitary conjugation, so every non-unitary channel is irreversible physically even when linearly invertible. C3 is then separated out as the only map that is strictly rank-collapsing on states, and it carries most of the sharp kernel results. C9 is the one entry I considered borderline; I kept it because the domain's own boundary material turns on exactly the analytic-versus-non-analytic split, and because the same structure recurs inside GKLS as the H-versus-dissipator gauge.

WHAT THE BRIEFS INFLUENCED. Several kernel elements exist in this list because the briefs put them there rather than because I would have reached for them unprompted. (i) The primitives entry — that the S/E tensor split and H_int are declared inputs, not derived objects — drove kernel element 15 and shaped how I justified C1: the contraction cannot erase what parametrizes it. (ii) The symmetries entry on trace-distance contractivity drove C2 and kernel element 24 (the one-sided witness). (iii) The alternative_formulations entry on non-unique unravelings drove C7 as a free-standing contraction rather than a footnote to C2. (iv) The formalism entries on Nakajima-Zwanzig and Feynman-Vernon drove C4 and C6, and in particular kernel element 22 — that the exact NZ projection erases autonomy but not the trajectory — which is a distinction I would not have foregrounded without the briefs' 'exact but the kernel is not computable' caveat. (v) The known_disconnects entries drove kernel elements 20 (linearity, via the RRT-0 note) and 30 (outcome/branch weights). (vi) The de Sitter absorptive-response boundary entry drove C9 and kernel element 29. (vii) The Pechukas domain_of_validity entry set the scope caveat on C1/C4.

PROVENANCE DISCIPLINE. The briefs mark four entries PROGRAM-RESULT (in-house, unreviewed) behind an explicit provenance firewall, and I honoured it: I state the general, externally-checkable principle and flag the in-house instance without leaning on it. Concretely — for kernel element 20 I graded the preservation-of-linearity fact THEOREM (it is trivially closed under all the maps listed) while explicitly declining to rest anything on the RRT-0 response-reducibility corollary; for kernel element 29 I graded the analytic/non-analytic separation STANDARD as a general dispersive-response principle and did not import the dS certificate's H^6 scope, its deep-IR wall, or its declared reality premise; for kernel element 30 I graded the outcome statement STANDARD as an established open problem (an absence of derivation, not a no-go proof) and noted that the briefs' narrower branch-weights claim is in-house and that the briefs themselves prohibit its stronger form, since the pointer-basis diagonal — the Born weights — does survive as kernel element 13. I did not upgrade any in-house item by repetition.

EXTERNAL VERIFICATION PERFORMED. I checked, rather than recalled, the following load-bearing statements: Frigerio's fixed-point/decoherence-free algebra result and the commutant form N(T) = {H, L_j, L_j^dag}' under a faithful normal invariant state, including Spohn's observation that the faithfulness hypothesis is restrictive; the Albert-Jiang closed form rho_ss = sum_mu Tr[J_mu^dag rho_in] M_mu with the block decomposition and the sum_kappa n_kappa^2 - 1 capacity count; the Noether-like channel theorem that for a channel with a full-rank fixed point the conserved quantities commute with its Kraus operators up to a phase; the Evans-Hoegh-Krohn peripheral-spectrum result (roots of unity, simple, order <= d); the Blume-Kohout-Ng-Poulin-Viola matrix-algebra structure for perfectly preserved information; Petz sufficiency as the equality condition of data processing and its Koashi-Imoto form; the Davies KMS relation gamma(-omega) = e^{-beta omega} gamma(omega) with Gibbs stationarity; the GKLS gauge freedom and the uniqueness of the traceless split; Spohn's entropy-production functional; and Nayak-Sen on invertible channels. Two items I graded below THEOREM after checking: the quantum-Darwinism redundancy plateau (model-class-established, not unconditional) and the general pointer-selection criterion outside strict commutativity (predictability sieve, robust but not exact). I did not read any file outside the blinded brief directory.

contractions.name: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit
contractions.mathematical_form: Shell integration: exp(-S_{bL}[phi_<]) = INT D(phi_>) exp(-S_L[phi_< + phi_>]) for b<1, followed by x -> x/b and phi -> Z^{-1/2} phi. On coupling space this is a map R_b: {g_i} -> {g_i'} obeying R_b o R_b' = R_{bb'} with NO inverse element. Continuous form: Wetterich/Polchinski equation, d_t Gamma_k = (1/2) STr[(Gamma_k^{(2)} + R_k)^{-1} d_t R_k], a parabolic (diffusion-type) functional equation. Linearized at a fixed point g*: dg_i(mu) = (mu/Lambda)^{-y_i} dg_i(Lambda), y_i = d - Delta_i; y_i > 0 relevant (expanded toward IR), y_i = 0 marginal, y_i < 0 irrelevant (compressed by (mu/Lambda)^{|y_i|}).
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: It is not a computational device layered onto the domain; per the briefs' own formalism entry (Wilson-Kogut, Phys. Rep. 12, 75 (1974)) it IS what renormalization is taken to be here. The physics reason it is the operative contraction: the domain's central empirical fact -- that a finite number of measured parameters predicts everything below the cutoff, with QED at ~1e-12 -- is logically the SAME statement as the non-invertibility. Universality is the fibre structure. PRECISION (load-bearing): at a FINITE scale ratio the flow is a formally invertible ODE whose inverse is merely exponentially ill-conditioned; the EXACTLY many-to-one map is the limit mu -> 0, whose fibre over a given IR endpoint is the entire stable manifold of the fixed point (infinite-dimensional). The a-theorem (Zamolodchikov in 2d; Komargodski-Schwimmer in 4d) upgrades this from 'no inverse in practice' to a strict monotone a_UV > a_IR, forbidding cycles and making the direction of the map physical.
contractions.what_it_erases: Everything transverse to the unstable manifold: the microscopic action, the regulator, non-universal amplitudes, T_c, all short-distance structure that is not a symmetry, a topological invariant, a relevant/marginal coupling, or an anomaly.

contractions.name: Irrelevant-operator suppression / decoupling (the EFT truncation map)
contractions.mathematical_form: L_eff(mu) = SUM_{d_i <= 4} c_i O_i + SUM_{d_i > 4} [c_i(mu)/Lambda^{d_i - 4}] O_i, with matrix elements scaling as c_i (E/Lambda)^{d_i - 4}. The map is Pi_n: {UV theories with symmetry G} -> {c_i : d_i <= 4+n}, defined modulo O((E/Lambda)^{n+1}). Appelquist-Carazzone: for E << M, a field of mass M contributes only O(E/M) power corrections plus renormalizations of the light couplings.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: This is the briefs' stated organizing primitive (Weinberg, Physica A 96, 327 (1979); Appelquist-Carazzone, PRD 11, 2856 (1975)). It is operative rather than convenient because it is simultaneously the source of predictivity and of UV non-identifiability: the SAME (E/Lambda)^{d-4} suppression that lets you truncate is what makes the fibre over a truncated IR Lagrangian infinite-dimensional. The hostile reading recorded in the QFT brief ('an EFT declares its degrees of freedom rather than deriving them') is a restatement of this contraction's kernel being exactly the declared relevant/marginal set.
contractions.what_it_erases: The identity, spin, and mass spectrum of everything above the cutoff, beyond its imprint on the retained low-dimension coefficients and on threshold logarithms. Exactly many-to-one only in the strict E/Lambda -> 0 limit; at finite E/Lambda the erasure is loss of conditioning at rate (E/Lambda)^{d-4}.

contractions.name: Gauge-orbit quotient (gauge redundancy)
contractions.mathematical_form: A_mu -> A_mu^g = g^{-1} A_mu g + g^{-1} d_mu g, with projection pi: A -> A/G onto the physical configuration space. Observables are functions on A/G: Wilson loops W[C] = tr P exp(i INT_C A), field-strength invariants, S-matrix elements.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Elitzur's theorem (PRD 12, 3978 (1975), in the gauge brief) makes this a fact rather than a convention: without gauge fixing, any non-gauge-invariant local order parameter has identically vanishing expectation value, so the gauge-variant coordinates carry no content at all -- the fibre is not 'hard to measure', it is empty of physics. The gauge brief's own symmetries entry ('only gauge-invariant quantities are observable') states the quotient. Unlike the RG flow, this map is exactly non-invertible at every scale, with fibre = the gauge orbit (infinite-dimensional).
contractions.what_it_erases: The gauge orbit itself; gauge-fixed off-shell Green functions, ghosts, gauge-parameter (xi) dependence of individual coefficients; and -- via Fradkin-Shenker continuity with fundamental matter -- any sharp Higgs/confinement distinction, which is exactly why the brief's electroweak result is a crossover with no transition at m_H = 125 GeV.

contractions.name: Flavor-basis quotient (Yukawa field redefinitions)
contractions.mathematical_form: G_F = U(3)_Q x U(3)_u x U(3)_d x U(3)_L x U(3)_e acts by (Y_u, Y_d, Y_e) -> (V_Q^dag Y_u V_u, V_Q^dag Y_d V_d, V_L^dag Y_e V_e). Quark sector: 36 real parameters in (Y_u, Y_d); dim G = 27; generic stabilizer U(1)_B of dimension 1; orbit dimension 26; physical = 36 - 26 = 10 = 6 masses + 3 angles + 1 phase. Charged-lepton sector with massless neutrinos: 18 real; dim(U(3)_L x U(3)_e) = 18; generic stabilizer U(1)_e x U(1)_mu x U(1)_tau of dimension 3; physical = 18 - 15 = 3. Total 13, matching the briefs' '13 flavour parameters' tally. Adding the dim-5 Weinberg operator c_5 (complex symmetric, 12 real) collapses the stabilizer to nothing and gives 12 lepton-sector invariants (3 + 3 masses, 3 angles, 3 phases).
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: This is the dominant erasure in the flavor sector, and it is NOT the RG flow -- a point worth stating flatly, because it is routinely conflated. Field redefinitions are unobservable by construction, so the SM's flavor content is literally a point on the quotient, never a matrix. The map is exactly non-invertible at every scale (26-dimensional fibres in the quark sector), independent of energy, and it acts BEFORE any running. It is the structural reason the briefs' open problem ('Origin of the SM parameter set: input everywhere; no audited framework derives them') is hard in the specific way it is: a UV flavor model's texture is destroyed down to 13 numbers plus theta-bar before the flow is ever applied.
contractions.what_it_erases: Yukawa textures; the 26 removable real parameters in (Y_u, Y_d); the 5 unphysical relative quark phases; the left and right unitary rotations SEPARATELY (only V_CKM = V_uL^dag V_dL survives, and V_uR, V_dR are wholly unobservable in the SM since there are no right-handed charged currents).

contractions.name: Yukawa RG flow: multiplicative evolution with infrared attractors
contractions.mathematical_form: SM one loop: 16 pi^2 mu dY_u/dmu = Y_u [ (3/2)(Y_u^dag Y_u - Y_d^dag Y_d) + T - (17/20 g_1^2 + 9/4 g_2^2 + 8 g_3^2) ], with T = Tr(3 Y_u^dag Y_u + 3 Y_d^dag Y_d + Y_e^dag Y_e), and similarly for Y_d, Y_e. Every term carries Y_a as a one-sided factor, so the solution is Y_a(mu) = Y_a(mu_0) W_a(mu, mu_0) with W_a in GL(3,C) (path-ordered exponential) -- in general Y_a(mu) = U_a Y_a(mu_0) W_a with U_a, W_a invertible. The nonlinear attractor: dy_t/dt ~ y_t((9/2) y_t^2 - 8 g_3^2 - ...) drives y_t toward an infrared quasi-fixed point set by g_3.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: This is the flow acting INSIDE the flavor sector, and it is contractive in one honest sense and not in another. Honest sense: the top-Yukawa quasi-fixed point (Hill 1981; the strict Pendleton-Ross fixed point of 1981 is not two-loop stable because alpha_t/alpha_3 diverges in the IR) focuses a wide basin of y_t(Lambda) onto essentially one y_t(m_t), so at any finite experimental precision the preimage is an interval. Not-a-contraction sense, which must be stated: as an ODE flow on the 13 basis invariants at finite scale ratio the map is invertible -- RG running neither creates nor destroys basis-invariant flavor information. So the answer to 'what does RG flow erase in the flavor sector' is: far less than is usually assumed; the erasure there is overwhelmingly the scale-independent basis quotient, plus attractor conditioning loss.
contractions.what_it_erases: The UV value of y_t inside the quasi-fixed-point basin (many-to-one at finite precision); more weakly, the UV values of the small Yukawas, which are compressed by a nearly common multiplicative factor so that only their ratios remain well-conditioned.

contractions.name: Chiral-rotation / theta-periodicity quotient (topological term)
contractions.mathematical_form: L contains theta (g^2/32 pi^2) G^a_{mu nu} Gtilde^{a mu nu}, whose integral nu = (g^2/32 pi^2) INT d^4x G Gtilde is an integer on a closed 4-manifold, so theta ~ theta + 2 pi exactly. An anomalous chiral rotation q -> exp(i alpha gamma_5) q shifts theta -> theta - 2 N_f alpha while simultaneously shifting arg det M_q -> arg det M_q + 2 N_f alpha. The two-parameter family (theta, arg det M_q) therefore collapses onto the single circle-valued invariant theta-bar = theta + arg det(M_u M_d) in R/2 pi Z.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: It is forced by the U(1)_A anomaly -- the same anomaly structure that elsewhere resists renormalization. The contraction is the domain's own statement of which parameter is real, and its kernel is directly the brief's open problem: theta-bar is bounded only empirically at |theta-bar| <~ 1e-10 by the neutron EDM and is otherwise unexplained. Exactly non-invertible: the fibre over each theta-bar is a one-parameter family of (theta, phase) pairs, at every scale.
contractions.what_it_erases: The separate values of theta_QCD and arg det M_q; any integer shift of theta; and -- in the degenerate case where any quark Yukawa eigenvalue is exactly zero -- theta-bar itself, which then becomes unphysical.

contractions.name: Scheme and field-redefinition reparametrization (Lagrangian space -> observables)
contractions.mathematical_form: Coupling reparametrization gtil = g + a_2 g^2 + a_3 g^3 + ... ; for beta = -b_0 g^3 - b_1 g^5 - b_2 g^7 - ..., one finds btil_0 = b_0, btil_1 = b_1, btil_2 != b_2 in general. Field reparametrization: phi -> phi + eps F[phi] with F proportional to dS/dphi leaves the S-matrix invariant (equivalence theorem), so EOM-redundant operators and total derivatives are null directions of the Lagrangian -> S-matrix map.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: It is the reason the domain's parameters are not themselves data. In the EFT context it is fully concrete: Warsaw and SILH operator bases are different coordinates on the same coefficient space, and half of a naive dimension-6 basis is redundant. Distinct from the gauge quotient because its kernel is a different object -- the gauge quotient preserves topological configuration data, while this one preserves only on-shell and fixed-point quantities.
contractions.what_it_erases: Off-shell Green functions and form factors; EOM-redundant and total-derivative operators; operator-basis choice; the individual values of beta-function coefficients from three loops onward; scheme-dependent splittings of finite parts.

kernel_elements.element: The fixed points themselves (beta(g*) = 0), as literal fixed points of the map
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: R_b(g*) = g* by definition of a fixed point; the coarse-graining map acts as the identity there, so there is nothing to erase. This is the one place where the semigroup is trivially invertible.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: The CHOICE among fixed points / among basins of attraction
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The flow moves a theory within a basin; it cannot move it between basins, because basins are separated by critical surfaces that the flow preserves. Which fixed point a theory sits near is UV boundary data the flow never touches -- an instance of 'undetermined-by-the-flow', not of 'preserved-through-the-flow'.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: The unstable manifold: relevant and marginally-relevant directions, with their eigenvalues y_i > 0
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Non-invertibility of the linearized flow is confined to the stable subspace. On the unstable subspace the map is EXPANDING, dg_i(mu) = (mu/Lambda)^{-y_i} dg_i(Lambda) with y_i > 0, hence locally invertible; the IR remembers these with exponentially amplified sensitivity. The count of such directions equals the number of renormalization conditions and therefore equals the domain's entire predictive leverage.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: In the SM specifically: the Higgs mass-squared is the unique strictly relevant operator, and it is the kernel element that must be supplied as UV data
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Dimension-2, y = 2 > 0, so it is amplified rather than compressed. The hierarchy problem is precisely the observation that this non-erased kernel element must be specified with extreme fineness in UV data -- the flow will not fix it for you, by construction.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: Critical exponents / scaling dimensions Delta_i at a fixed point, and the universality class as a whole
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: They are eigenvalues of the linearization of the flow at its own fixed point -- properties of the map, not of the point being mapped. They are additionally invariant under smooth invertible reparametrizations of coupling space, hence survive contraction 7 as well.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: Exactly marginal directions and the conformal manifold (moduli)
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: beta identically zero along them to all orders means the flow acts as the identity on that submanifold: position on M_c is pure boundary data, undetermined by the flow in both directions. For 4d N=1 SCFTs the manifold is the quotient M_c = {marginal lambda} // G_F^C of marginal couplings by the COMPLEXIFIED continuous flavor group (Green-Komargodski-Seiberg-Tachikawa-Wecht, JHEP 06 (2010) 106): a marginal chiral operator fails to be exactly marginal only by pairing with a conserved current multiplet. Sharp negative for this description group: the SM has NO exactly marginal directions -- every marginal coupling there is marginally relevant (g_3) or marginally irrelevant (g_1, lambda, and the sub-top Yukawas) -- so this kernel component is empty in the SM while non-empty in the domain at large.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: theta itself as the SM's one genuinely non-running dimensionless direction -- a compact modulus of the gauge sector
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: theta multiplies a topological density whose spacetime integral is quantized, so it has no perturbative anomalous dimension and does not run at all in pure Yang-Mills. It is therefore an exactly marginal (indeed circle-valued) direction: a family of physically inequivalent theories that the perturbative flow cannot distinguish and cannot move along.
kernel_elements.contraction: Chiral-rotation / theta-periodicity quotient (topological term)

kernel_elements.element: 't Hooft anomaly coefficients of global symmetries: A_UV = A_IR
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Gauge the global symmetry with non-dynamical background fields. The anomaly is then an obstruction to gauge invariance of the partition function AS A FUNCTIONAL OF THE BACKGROUNDS, valued in a discrete set (integers via the index theorem / quantized Chern-Simons levels in one higher dimension by inflow). A continuous flow cannot change a discrete invariant. Equivalently: spectator fermions added to cancel the anomaly in the UV are inert under the flow and must still cancel it in the IR. This kernel element survives even confinement -- the most violent contraction in the domain: for QCD with N_f massless flavors it forces the IR to produce either massless composite fermions or chiral symmetry breaking with Goldstone bosons.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: Adler-Bardeen non-renormalization: the coefficient of the anomaly is one-loop exact
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: d_mu j5^mu = (N_f g^2 / 16 pi^2) G Gtilde receives no radiative correction to its coefficient beyond one loop; the infinite set of higher graphs cancels. Modern all-orders proofs exist in regulator-independent (BV / higher-derivative-plus-dimensional) frameworks, including the statement that if gauge anomalies cancel at one loop there is a subtraction scheme in which they manifestly vanish from two loops on by power counting. SCOPE CAVEAT, stated to avoid overclaim: this concerns the coefficient in the anomaly EQUATION; the flavor-singlet axial CURRENT operator still carries a scheme-dependent anomalous dimension starting at two loops in MS-bar. The two statements are compatible and should not be merged.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: Gauge-anomaly cancellation conditions as an exactly scale-free constraint
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The cancellation conditions (e.g. SUM Y^3 = 0, SUM Y = 0, the SU(2)^2 U(1) and SU(3)^2 U(1) conditions) are built from the same non-renormalized integer coefficients, so if they hold at one scale they hold at all scales. This is why the gauge brief's 'cancels generation by generation' is legitimately a scale-free statement. SCOPE CAVEAT from the briefs themselves: the constraint is rigid GIVEN the content but does not uniquely fix hypercharge once content changes -- adding a right-handed neutrino with a Dirac mass dequantizes hypercharge, Y -> Y_SM - eps(B-L) (Babu-Mohapatra, PRL 63, 938 (1989)). The anomaly is in the kernel; the selection of a point in the allowed set is not.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: Discrete and global anomalies: the Witten SU(2) Z_2 anomaly, discrete theta-angles, SPT/anomaly-inflow classes
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are torsion-valued (e.g. pi_4(SU(2)) = Z_2) rather than merely integer-valued, so they are even more rigidly protected against continuous deformation than the perturbative coefficients. No continuous flow connects distinct classes.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: The a-anomaly (and c) at each endpoint, and the ordering a_UV > a_IR
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: a is a fixed-point invariant, hence in the kernel of the flow at the endpoints. The inequality is a monotone the flow provably cannot violate for unitary flows between CFTs (Zamolodchikov 1986 in 2d; Komargodski-Schwimmer 2011 in 4d). It is the quantitative form of the irreversibility: it forbids RG limit cycles between CFTs and fixes the direction of the map as physical rather than conventional.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: Exact symmetries of the UV action (with a stated asymmetry in the converse)
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Coarse-graining is performed symmetrically -- the measure over phi_> respects the symmetry -- so an exact UV symmetry remains an exact IR symmetry. The converse fails, and the failure is informative rather than a defect: symmetries can EMERGE accidentally in the IR when every operator violating them is irrelevant. B and L conservation in the SM is exactly this: an output of the contraction at dimension 4, violated at dimension 5 (the Weinberg operator) and 6. So the kernel contains the UV symmetry group; the IR symmetry group can be strictly larger.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: The vacuum / point on a moduli space of vacua
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The flow acts on the action, not on the state. Which vacuum is realized -- including where on a SUSY flat direction the theory sits -- is boundary/initial data orthogonal to the flow. This is the same class as the briefs' recorded open problem that the curved-space vacuum is non-unique so 'the vacuum energy density' is not well-posed absent a state choice.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: Asymptotic-state data: Poincare labels (mass, spin) of the surviving spectrum, and superselection sectors
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are labels of unitary irreducible representations of the Poincare group (Wigner 1939, the briefs' primitives entry), fixed by the symmetry algebra and the choice of sector rather than by the local action. Local coarse-graining cannot move a theory between superselection sectors.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

kernel_elements.element: The relevant and marginal (renormalizable) parameter set, intact up to running
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: It is by definition the complement of the suppressed set: contributions scale as (E/Lambda)^{d-4} with d <= 4, so no positive power of E/Lambda suppresses them. This finite set is exactly what the EFT map retains, and it is why the briefs can record QED as DERIVED and PREDICTIVE from declared inputs.
kernel_elements.contraction: Irrelevant-operator suppression / decoupling (the EFT truncation map)

kernel_elements.element: The leading non-vanishing Wilson coefficient of any operator forbidden at the renormalizable level -- canonically c_5/Lambda for the Weinberg operator
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: It is suppressed but not zero, and it is the ONLY surviving trace of the UV physics that generated it. The SM's dimension-5 operator (Lbar^c Htilde*)(Htilde^dag L) is unique up to flavor indices (Weinberg, PRL 43, 1566 (1979)), so the IR cannot tell type-I from type-II from type-III seesaw -- but it retains c_5/Lambda, and the SAME coefficient fixes both m_nu and the neutrinoless double-beta amplitude. The briefs identify this correctly as the EFT's own parameter-free ordering test: a genuine kernel element that is empirically exploitable precisely because the contraction did not reach it.
kernel_elements.contraction: Irrelevant-operator suppression / decoupling (the EFT truncation map)

kernel_elements.element: Positivity / analyticity constraints on Wilson coefficients
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Unitarity, causality and crossing of the UV amplitude force sign conditions (e.g. positivity of certain dimension-8 coefficients) that hold for ANY consistent UV completion. The contraction can move a theory anywhere within the allowed region but cannot carry it outside, so the region's boundary is kernel data: an inequality the flow cannot violate. Scope note: established for specific coefficient combinations; the fully general classification is an active program, so I do not claim more than the established cases.
kernel_elements.contraction: Irrelevant-operator suppression / decoupling (the EFT truncation map)

kernel_elements.element: The zero pattern of the anomalous-dimension matrix gamma_ij in the operator basis
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Many entries vanish for reasons the flow cannot supply: symmetry, and (in SMEFT at dimension six) helicity/angular-momentum selection rules that forbid one-loop mixing of operators with mismatched total helicity weight -- non-renormalization without supersymmetry. These are structural zeros, not small numbers, so the flow cannot fill them in at that order.
kernel_elements.contraction: Irrelevant-operator suppression / decoupling (the EFT truncation map)

kernel_elements.element: Threshold logarithms: the decoupling residue ln(M/mu) in the matching of marginal couplings
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Appelquist-Carazzone kills the power effects of a heavy state but not the logarithmic renormalization of the light couplings it induces. So the EXISTENCE and SCALE of heavy thresholds is partially reconstructible from precision running of the marginal couplings, even though the heavy state's identity is gone. This is the mechanism behind coupling-unification inference and is the reason measured alpha_s running from ~1 GeV to TeV (five-loop agreement, per the gauge brief) is informative about physics it does not contain.
kernel_elements.contraction: Irrelevant-operator suppression / decoupling (the EFT truncation map)

kernel_elements.element: Gauge-invariant observables as the coordinates on A/G
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: They are by construction functions on the quotient, i.e. constant along the fibre. Wilson loops/holonomies form an (over)complete such set; hadron masses and cross sections are the measured instances. Elitzur guarantees the complement carries nothing.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gauge-orbit quotient (gauge redundancy)

kernel_elements.element: The global form of the gauge group and its center / 1-form symmetry
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: SU(N) versus SU(N)/Z_N is not determined by the Lie algebra and is not gauge-variant data: gauge transformations act WITHIN a choice of global form, never across choices. It controls the allowed spectrum of line operators, the periodicity of theta, and the available discrete theta-angles. The quotient cannot reach it because it is not a direction in A.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gauge-orbit quotient (gauge redundancy)

kernel_elements.element: The global subgroup: conserved charges, charge quantization, superselection
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The redundancy is LOCAL; the global subgroup acts physically. Gauss's law ties total charge to boundary flux, making it asymptotic data the local quotient does not touch. The gauge brief's own caveat flags this ('the physical content of the global subgroup -- charge conservation, superselection'), and the empirical trace is the charge-universality bound |eps_{p-e}| <~ 1e-21 e.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gauge-orbit quotient (gauge redundancy)

kernel_elements.element: Topological configuration classes: instanton number nu = (g^2/32 pi^2) INT G Gtilde in Z, monopole and vortex charges
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are gauge-invariant AND integer-valued: invariance puts them on the quotient, quantization prevents continuous deformation. They are the reason the theta term has content at all.
kernel_elements.contraction: Gauge-orbit quotient (gauge redundancy)

kernel_elements.element: The full invariant ring of G_F acting on (Y_u, Y_d, Y_e): the 13 physical flavor parameters
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: They are, by definition, the functions constant on G_F orbits -- generated by traces of products of H_u = Y_u Y_u^dag, H_d = Y_d Y_d^dag, H_e. The count is exact group theory: 36 - (27 - 1) = 10 in the quark sector, 18 - (18 - 3) = 3 in the charged-lepton sector. This reproduces the briefs' own '13 flavour parameters' tally independently, and the count is a theorem about the orbit structure, not an estimate.
kernel_elements.contraction: Flavor-basis quotient (Yukawa field redefinitions)

kernel_elements.element: The Jarlskog invariant J as the unique CP-odd quark-sector invariant
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: It is constructible entirely from basis-invariant data: det[H_u, H_d] = 2i J (m_t^2 - m_c^2)(m_t^2 - m_u^2)(m_c^2 - m_u^2)(m_b^2 - m_s^2)(m_b^2 - m_d^2)(m_s^2 - m_d^2), up to a convention-dependent sign and normalization, with J = Im[V_us V_cb V_ub* V_cs*]. The quotient cannot erase it because it is a function on the quotient by construction. This is the single irreducible complex phase the QFT brief's symmetries entry identifies as the law-side source of weak CP violation (Kobayashi-Maskawa, PTP 49, 652 (1973)).
kernel_elements.contraction: Flavor-basis quotient (Yukawa field redefinitions)

kernel_elements.element: The structural preconditions for CP violation: three generations and non-degenerate masses
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: J != 0 requires the mass-difference products above to be non-vanishing. Hence any two same-sector quarks exactly degenerate forces CP conservation, and with only two generations J vanishes identically. This is a statement about the invariant ring itself, so it is scale-independent and quotient-proof -- it is WHY three generations is a precondition for the Kobayashi-Maskawa mechanism rather than a numerical coincidence.
kernel_elements.contraction: Flavor-basis quotient (Yukawa field redefinitions)

kernel_elements.element: The rank of each Yukawa matrix, and therefore the pattern of exactly massless fermions
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Two independent arguments. (i) Structural: the SM one-loop RGE is purely one-sided, 16 pi^2 dY_u/dt = Y_u[...], so Y_u(mu) = Y_u(mu_0) W with W invertible; rank is exactly preserved, and left-null vectors are carried to left-null vectors. The same one-sided structure persists at higher loops (every term is of the form A Y_a or Y_a B). (ii) Symmetry: a vanishing Yukawa row is protected by an exact chiral U(1), so it cannot be generated at ANY order -- 't Hooft technical naturalness. Argument (ii) is the all-orders version and is what earns the THEOREM grade.
kernel_elements.contraction: Yukawa RG flow: multiplicative evolution with infrared attractors

kernel_elements.element: Vanishing or non-vanishing of J -- RG cannot create or destroy CP violation
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: CP is either a symmetry of the Lagrangian or it is not, and RG flow preserves symmetries of the Lagrangian (the coarse-graining respects them). So if the flavor sector is CP-conserving (J = 0) at one scale it is CP-conserving at every scale, and conversely. Equivalently, at the level of the RGE, J is a top-degree invariant obeying a homogeneous equation dJ/dt = J x (real function), so J = 0 is an invariant manifold of the flow and the sign of J is fixed.
kernel_elements.contraction: Yukawa RG flow: multiplicative evolution with infrared attractors

kernel_elements.element: Ratios of the small Yukawas, up to the difference of their non-universal pieces
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: For sub-top Yukawas the RGE is approximately homogeneous and universal, dY_i/dt ~ Y_i x (common gauge + top terms), so the common factor cancels in ratios and only the small non-universal differences run. This is exactly why m_b/m_tau unification is a computable GUT-scale statement rather than a scale-free guess: the flow compresses the absolute values but leaves the ratio well-conditioned.
kernel_elements.contraction: Yukawa RG flow: multiplicative evolution with infrared attractors

kernel_elements.element: The quasi-fixed-point value y_t* itself, as an output determined by the gauge couplings
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The attractor is the destination, not the destroyed data: within its basin the UV value of y_t is forgotten but y_t* is FIXED by g_3 (and subleading gauge terms), so the contraction converts UV ignorance into an IR prediction. Historical precision: the strict Pendleton-Ross infrared fixed point (1981, predicting m_t ~ 100 GeV) is not stable at two loops because alpha_t/alpha_3 diverges in the IR; Hill's quasi-fixed point is the operative attractor, giving m_t of order 200-230 GeV for a UV scale near 1e15 GeV -- an over-prediction relative to the measured top mass, which is itself informative about where the SM sits relative to the attractor.
kernel_elements.contraction: Yukawa RG flow: multiplicative evolution with infrared attractors

kernel_elements.element: The number of generations
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: An integer; no continuous flow changes it. It is additionally locked to the representation content by anomaly cancellation, which the gauge brief records as tying quark and lepton content together within each generation -- so it is doubly protected, by integrality and by the non-renormalized anomaly.
kernel_elements.contraction: Yukawa RG flow: multiplicative evolution with infrared attractors

kernel_elements.element: Minimal Flavor Violation as an RG-stable class
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The RGEs are covariant under G_F (the flow is built from G_F-covariant contractions of the Y's). Therefore the statement 'the only spurions breaking G_F are Y_u and Y_d' is preserved by the flow: MFV is a scale-independent class, not an ansatz that needs re-imposing at each scale. Equivalently, the flow descends well-defined to the quotient of contraction 4.
kernel_elements.contraction: Yukawa RG flow: multiplicative evolution with infrared attractors

kernel_elements.element: theta-bar = theta + arg det(Y_u Y_d), mod 2 pi -- physical, and essentially RG-inert in the SM
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Two separate facts. (i) It is the unique combination invariant under the chiral rotation, hence survives the quotient by construction. (ii) It barely runs: theta multiplies a quantized topological density and has no perturbative anomalous dimension, and the CKM phase feeds theta-bar only through flavor-diagonal mass corrections that first arise at high loop order, giving theta-bar_SM of order 1e-16 or smaller. So it propagates essentially unchanged from the UV to the deep IR, where it appears as the neutron EDM -- which is why the briefs can record |theta-bar| <~ 1e-10 as a bound on an unexplained INPUT rather than on a derived quantity. The strong CP problem is a kernel element with no known dynamical origin.
kernel_elements.contraction: Chiral-rotation / theta-periodicity quotient (topological term)

kernel_elements.element: Structural interlock: the theta-bar kernel is conditional on the Yukawa-rank kernel
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: If any quark Yukawa eigenvalue were exactly zero, an exact chiral rotation would remove theta-bar entirely and it would cease to be physical. So the survival of theta-bar through contraction 6 depends on rank(Y_u), rank(Y_d) = 3, which is itself protected by contraction 5's kernel. Two kernels are not independent -- worth flagging because it means a single UV mechanism (a massless up quark) would have deleted an entire kernel element, and the empirical exclusion of that option is what keeps the strong CP problem alive.
kernel_elements.contraction: Chiral-rotation / theta-periodicity quotient (topological term)

kernel_elements.element: On-shell S-matrix elements, physical pole masses and residues, and all fixed-point data (Delta_i, a, c, OPE coefficients)
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The equivalence theorem: field redefinitions proportional to the equations of motion change off-shell Green functions but leave the S-matrix invariant. Fixed-point data are properties of the fixed point, not of the coordinates used to reach it. These are exactly the quantities the briefs list as observables -- cross sections, hadron masses, running couplings -- which is not a coincidence: the observable list IS the kernel of this contraction.
kernel_elements.contraction: Scheme and field-redefinition reparametrization (Lagrangian space -> observables)

kernel_elements.element: The first two beta-function coefficients b_0 and b_1 of a single coupling
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Direct computation: under gtil = g + a_2 g^2 + ..., the transformation of beta leaves b_0 and b_1 unchanged while b_2 onward shift by scheme-dependent amounts. Hence asymptotic freedom (the sign of b_0, from Gross-Wilczek and Politzer 1973) is a scheme-independent structural fact, not an artifact -- which is what licenses the briefs' treatment of the measured alpha_s running as a genuine PREDICTION-grade confirmation. Caveat: the clean b_0, b_1 statement is for a single coupling in a mass-independent scheme; with several couplings the invariant statements require more care.
kernel_elements.contraction: Scheme and field-redefinition reparametrization (Lagrangian space -> observables)

kernel_elements.element: One-loop anomalous dimensions, in a basis with no operator mixing
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Same reparametrization argument at leading order: the first non-trivial coefficient of a homogeneous evolution cannot be shifted by a redefinition that starts at the same order. The extension of basis-independence to the full pattern of one-loop mixing zeros is stronger and I grade it lower, since some zeros are basis-statements rather than invariant ones.
kernel_elements.contraction: Scheme and field-redefinition reparametrization (Lagrangian space -> observables)

kernel_elements.element: Superpotential couplings in SUSY theories (holomorphic non-renormalization)
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Holomorphy plus the selection rules of the spurious symmetries force the superpotential to be uncorrected in perturbation theory; only wave-function renormalization acts, so the holomorphic couplings are exactly in the kernel of the flow and running is confined to the Kahler sector. This is the mechanism that makes exactly marginal directions constructible and computable (via gamma = 0 conditions) rather than accidental. Included because it is the sharpest known example of a symmetry-protected kernel element in the domain, though it is not realized in the SM itself.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining (the RG semigroup), and its strict IR limit

things_erased_completely: The UV action above the cutoff: in the strict E/Lambda -> 0 limit, all UV completions sharing a symmetry group, a fixed point, and the retained low-dimension coefficients become literally the same theory. The fibre is infinite-dimensional. This is what universality means, and it is not a limitation of technique.

The identity, spin, and mass of every state above the cutoff, beyond threshold logs: whether the dimension-5 Weinberg operator came from a heavy singlet fermion (type-I), a heavy triplet scalar (type-II), or a heavy triplet fermion (type-III) is not recoverable from c_5/Lambda -- three distinct UV theories, one IR coefficient.

The UV values of irrelevant couplings, compressed by (mu/Lambda)^{|y_i|}; exactly erased in the strict limit, and at finite ratio rendered unrecoverable by exponential ill-conditioning rather than by non-injectivity.

Non-universal data at a critical point: T_c, amplitude normalizations, the lattice spacing, the regulator and scheme, the microscopic Hamiltonian -- every member of a universality class collapses to one point.

The gauge orbit itself, plus gauge-fixed off-shell Green functions, ghost contributions, and the gauge-parameter dependence of individual coefficients. Elitzur's theorem makes this total: non-gauge-invariant local order parameters have identically vanishing expectation value.
Field-parametrization data: EOM-redundant operators, total derivatives, off-shell form factors, and the choice of operator basis (Warsaw vs SILH are the same point in different coordinates).
In the quark flavor sector, 26 of 36 real Yukawa parameters -- the entire texture. Also the 5 unphysical relative quark phases. This erasure is scale-independent and happens before any running.

The right-handed rotation matrices V_uR and V_dR, completely and permanently, because the SM has no right-handed charged currents. Any UV model's right-handed flavor structure leaves no IR trace whatsoever (this is specific to the SM gauge content; in a left-right model it is not erased).
The separate values of theta_QCD and arg det M_q -- only theta-bar survives -- plus all integer shifts of theta.
theta-bar itself, in the counterfactual where any quark Yukawa eigenvalue is exactly zero: the parameter would become unphysical, not merely small.

The UV value of y_t within the quasi-fixed-point basin of attraction: a wide interval of y_t(Lambda) maps onto essentially one IR value, so at any achievable experimental precision the preimage is an interval, not a point.
The UV value of the Higgs quartic under triviality/attractor flow: lambda(mu_IR) is bounded almost independently of lambda(Lambda), so the IR retains a bound rather than a value.
Individual beta-function coefficients from three loops onward, and finite-part splittings: only scheme-invariant combinations survive.
The high-frequency field configurations themselves. The integration over phi_> is a genuine partial trace: the modes are not functions of S_{bLambda}, only their aggregate effect is.

Any sharp Higgs-vs-confinement distinction in a gauge theory with fundamental-representation scalars (Fradkin-Shenker continuity). The empirical instance is in the briefs: at m_H = 125 GeV the electroweak transition is a crossover with no endpoint above m_H ~ 72 GeV, so there is no electroweak phase transition -- the two 'phases' are one phase, and with them the Sakharov departure-from-equilibrium condition is absent, not merely weak.

Colored constituents as asymptotic-state labels: confinement erases the quark/gluon description of the asymptotic spectrum entirely (no isolated fractionally-charged states), while leaving the anomaly-matching constraints and the global charges intact. What is erased is the asymptotic labeling, not the UV field content.

The direction-reversal itself: given only the IR theory, the UV is undetermined. The a-theorem makes this a strict monotone rather than practical ignorance -- a_UV > a_IR forbids even the existence of an inverse flow between CFTs.
kernels.method_note:
SELECTION CRITERIA. I admitted a map as a contraction only if it met three tests: (i) it is demonstrably many-to-one -- I could exhibit the fibre and, where possible, its dimension (26 for the quark flavor quotient, infinite for the gauge orbit and the strict IR limit, one-parameter for the chiral/theta quotient); (ii) it is forced by the domain's own physics rather than adopted for tractability -- Elitzur for the gauge quotient, the U(1)_A anomaly for the theta quotient, unobservability of field redefinitions for the flavor quotient, the definition of a cutoff theory for coarse-graining; (iii) its kernel is genuinely distinct from the others' -- where two candidate maps quotiented the same data I merged them (e.g. SMEFT operator-basis redundancy is folded into the scheme/field-redefinition contraction, not listed separately), and where kernels differed I kept them apart (the gauge-orbit quotient preserves quantized topological configuration data; the scheme reparametrization does not, preserving on-shell and fixed-point data instead).

ONE PRECISION I CONSIDER LOAD-BEARING, stated because it changes several answers. The contractions split into two kinds that are usually conflated. The redundancy quotients (gauge orbit, flavor basis, chiral/theta, scheme) are EXACTLY non-invertible at every scale -- the information was never there. The scale flows (Wilsonian coarse-graining, EFT truncation, Yukawa running) are, at a finite scale ratio, formally invertible ODE flows whose inverse is merely exponentially ill-conditioned; they become exactly many-to-one only in the limits mu -> 0 and E/Lambda -> 0, where the fibre becomes the whole stable manifold. This matters most in the flavor sector, where the honest answer to 'what does RG flow erase' is: very little that is basis-invariant. The 13 flavor invariants at one scale determine them at another (invertible flow); the massive erasure in flavor is the scale-independent basis quotient plus attractor conditioning loss at the top Yukawa. I flagged this inside the relevant contraction entries rather than only here, because reading the flavor-sector erasure as an RG effect is the most likely error this classification could induce.

HOW THE BRIEFS INFLUENCED THE KERNEL LIST. The briefs are epistemic-audit records (provenance and verification grades on citations), not RG references; no RG or anomaly calculation appears in them. They supplied five concrete anchors that I used and independently checked: (a) the '13 flavour parameters' tally, which I re-derived from the orbit dimensions and which matches; (b) the unique dimension-5 Weinberg operator and its 0nubetabeta ordering test, which I used as the canonical surviving-irrelevant-coefficient kernel element; (c) the |theta-bar| <~ 1e-10 bound and its recorded status as an unexplained input, which I used to characterize the theta kernel as unexplained rather than merely small; (d) Elitzur's theorem and the electroweak-crossover/no-transition result, which I used respectively for the gauge-quotient kernel and for the Fradkin-Shenker erasure item; (e) the Babu-Mohapatra hypercharge dequantization (Y -> Y_SM - eps(B-L) with a Dirac right-handed neutrino), which I used to SCOPE the anomaly kernel -- the anomaly coefficient is preserved exactly, but it does not select a point in the allowed hypercharge set once content changes. Everything else in the kernel list is standard physics from my own knowledge: fixed points and unstable manifolds, the c/a-theorems, Adler-Bardeen, 't Hooft anomaly matching, conformal manifolds, basis invariants and the Jarlskog commutant identity, quasi-fixed points, technical naturalness, and scheme invariance of b_0 and b_1.

VERIFIED THIS SESSION (web): the Jarlskog commutant identity det[H_u, H_d] proportional to 2i J times the two mass-difference products; the SM one-loop Yukawa RGE's one-sided form dY_u/dt = Y_u[(3/2)(Y_u^dag Y_u - Y_d^dag Y_d) + Y_2(S) - (17/20 g_1^2 + 9/4 g_2^2 + 8 g_3^2)]/16 pi^2, which is what licenses the exact rank-preservation claim; the Pendleton-Ross vs. Hill distinction (P-R not two-loop stable, alpha_t/alpha_3 divergent in the IR; Hill's quasi-fixed point giving m_t of order 220 GeV for a UV scale near 1e15 GeV); the GKSTW result that the conformal manifold is the quotient of marginal couplings by the COMPLEXIFIED global symmetry group; Adler-Bardeen's all-orders status in modern BV/regulator-independent proofs; and the loop order and 1e-16-scale magnitude of the SM's CKM-induced contribution to theta-bar.

DELIBERATE NON-CLAIMS. I did not grade the SMEFT positivity program above STANDARD or assert it beyond established coefficient cases. I did not merge Adler-Bardeen non-renormalization of the anomaly COEFFICIENT with the separate fact that the singlet axial CURRENT has a two-loop anomalous dimension in MS-bar; conflating them is a common overclaim and I stated both. I graded the basis-independence of the full one-loop mixing-zero pattern as PLAUSIBLE rather than STANDARD, since some of those zeros are basis statements. I did not use the briefs' PROGRAM-RESULT entries (in-house, unreviewed adjudications, explicitly firewalled in the records themselves) for any physics content, only the community-derived and observed entries.

NOTE ON SCOPE COMPLIANCE. I read only the two named files in the blinded directory; no file outside it, and nothing under any rrp/ path.

contractions.name: Wilsonian coarse-graining: the RG semigroup on the space of diffeomorphism-invariant effective actions
contractions.mathematical_form: exp(-Gamma_k[g]) = Integral_{k<p<Lambda} Dh exp(-S_Lambda[g+h]); equivalently the exact flow d_t Gamma_k = (1/2) STr[(Gamma_k^(2) + R_k)^{-1} d_t R_k], t = ln k. On the coupling coordinates {Lambda/k^2, k^2 M_Pl^{-2}, c_1, c_2, ...} of the derivative expansion Gamma = Integral sqrt(-g)[(M_Pl^2/2)(R - 2Lambda) + sum_n c_n M_Pl^{4-2n} O_n(R, grad R)], this is d_t g_i = beta_i(g), whose linearization about a fixed point g* gives delta g_i(k) = sum_I C_I V^I_i (k/k_0)^{-theta_I}. Toward the IR (k -> 0) every direction with theta_I < 0 shrinks as (k/k_0)^{|theta_I|}. R_{k->k'} composed with R_{k'->k''} = R_{k->k''} is a semigroup with no inverse: the shell integration is not invertible.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: In 4D, [G] = -2, so every graviton self-interaction beyond two derivatives is power-counting irrelevant. Loops demonstrably generate the whole tower: 't Hooft-Veltman (1974) at one loop, Goroff-Sagnotti (1985/86) at two loops with a genuinely nonremovable Riemann-cubed divergence of coefficient (209/2880)(4 pi)^{-4} epsilon^{-1}. The theory therefore has infinite-dimensional UV data, and the ONLY reason low-curvature gravity is predictive at all is that this map crushes all but finitely many of those directions as powers of E/M_Pl. That is exactly the content of the GR brief's row 'Quantum GR is well-defined as a low-energy effective field theory: leading quantum corrections at low curvature are parameter-free and calculable' -- parameter-free is a statement about the contraction's fibers, not about calculational convenience. The contraction is operative here because non-renormalizability makes it load-bearing; in a renormalizable theory one could work without it.
contractions.what_it_erases: The UV boundary values of every irrelevant coupling c_n(Lambda_UV), to accuracy O((E/M_Pl)^{2n-4}); the entire high-curvature sector of the action; the regulator and the shell-by-shell history of the flow.

contractions.name: Decoupling / heavy-sector matching (Appelquist-Carazzone)
contractions.mathematical_form: The matching map M_mu : (T_UV with heavy fields of mass M and couplings lambda) -> {c_i(lambda, M, mu)} in Gamma_IR[g, light fields] = Integral sqrt(-g)[(M_Pl^2/2)(R - 2 Lambda) + sum_i c_i O_i^{(2n)}] + Gamma_nonlocal, with all residual heavy-state effects on light-field Green functions suppressed as (E/M)^k in a mass-dependent scheme. Fibers: M_mu^{-1}({c_i}) = the set of all UV theories reproducing the same truncated Wilson-coefficient vector. This is a DISCONTINUOUS reduction of field content at a threshold, distinct from the continuous flow above.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Gravity couples universally, so every heavy sector whatsoever contributes, and the matching map is the sole channel through which any UV physics can reach a low-curvature observer. The gravity briefs record the fiber's size empirically rather than abstractly: the GR brief's Donoghue entry carries the caveat 'valid below the cutoff only; says nothing about the UV completion', and the quantum-gravity brief's domain_of_validity row states that among fourteen audited candidates 'nothing ... produced a parameter-free, currently-measurable prediction differing from EFT'. Read as physics rather than as audit bookkeeping, that is the statement that all fourteen sit inside one fiber of M_mu at present precision.
contractions.what_it_erases: The identity, mass, spin and multiplicity of every state above mu; the mechanism generating the Wilson coefficients; all UV-completion structure except what survives in the dispersive/anomaly/threshold invariants listed in the kernel.

contractions.name: Field-redefinition and total-derivative quotient (on-shell / S-matrix equivalence)
contractions.mathematical_form: Quotient of the space of local diffeo-invariant Lagrangians by the ideal generated by (i) total derivatives grad_mu J^mu and (ii) terms proportional to the leading equations of motion, E^{mu nu}[g] F_{mu nu}[g] with E^{mu nu} = delta S_EH / delta g_{mu nu} = (M_Pl^2/2)(R^{mu nu} - (1/2) g^{mu nu} R + Lambda g^{mu nu}). Realized as g_{mu nu} -> g_{mu nu} + a R_{mu nu} + b g_{mu nu} R + O(R^2). Concretely, in 4D pure gravity with Lambda = 0, span{R^2, R_{mu nu}R^{mu nu}, R_{mu nu rho sigma}R^{mu nu rho sigma}} modulo Gauss-Bonnet (a total derivative in 4D) and modulo the EOM ideal is ZERO: the entire curvature-squared sector is a single point of the quotient.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: 'What survives in the IR effective action' is only a well-posed question modulo this quotient -- the observable object is the equivalence class, never a representative. This is the operative contraction in gravity specifically because it is what makes the 't Hooft-Veltman one-loop divergence physically invisible (it is Gauss-Bonnet after field redefinition, hence a total derivative in 4D), and it is what promotes the Goroff-Sagnotti two-loop Riemann-cubed divergence to a genuine statement of non-renormalizability: that operator is NOT in the ideal. Without this quotient the derivative expansion is a list of redundant symbols rather than a list of physical coefficients.
contractions.what_it_erases: The coefficients of R^2 and R_{mu nu}R^{mu nu} in 4D pure gravity; the coefficient of every operator proportional to E^{mu nu}; the local content of every total derivative; the choice of field variable (g_{mu nu} vs g^{mu nu} vs sqrt(g) g^{mu nu} vs vielbein), the gauge-fixing function, the renormalization scheme, and all off-shell values of the effective action.

contractions.name: Dissipative relaxation to the stationary attractor (the no-hair contraction)
contractions.mathematical_form: The classical Cauchy evolution Phi_t on asymptotically flat initial data (Sigma; h_ij, K_ij; matter) obeying the Hamiltonian and momentum constraints, restricted to the domain of outer communication and taken t -> infinity: Phi_infinity : {constrained data} -> Kerr(M, J) [electrovac: Kerr-Newman(M, J, Q)]. Four quantitative ingredients: (a) monotone radiative export, dM_Bondi/du = -(1/4 pi) Contour-integral |d_u C|^2 <= 0; (b) ringdown at the Kerr quasinormal frequencies with Im omega_{l m n} < 0 (Teukolsky theory -- the derived object recorded in the GR brief); (c) Price power-law tails, psi_l ~ t^{-(2l+3)} at fixed r for compactly supported data, u^{-(l+2)} at null infinity, v^{-(2l+3)} on the horizon; (d) endpoint pinned by Israel / Hawking-rigidity / Carter-Robinson / Bunting-Masood-ul-Alam uniqueness. Fiber dimension: infinite.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: This is the domain's own genuine dissipative semigroup: it has a strict Lyapunov functional (horizon area, Hawking's area theorem dA >= 0 under the null energy condition plus the standard global hypotheses) and an exported current (gravitational-wave energy flux to null infinity). It is the same physics the GR brief records as VERIFIED phenomenology -- the GW150914 inspiral-merger-ringdown waveform match and the PSR B1913+16 orbital decay ratio 0.9983 +/- 0.0016. It is the classical-IR analogue of the RG contraction, but it is a genuinely different map: it acts on solution space with a Lyapunov function, not on theory space with a semigroup of scale.
contractions.what_it_erases: Every l >= 2 mass and current multipole of the initial configuration; the collapsing matter's composition, equation of state, entropy and thermodynamic history; baryon and lepton number and every other charge of a short-range (non-gauged-massless) symmetry; all ringdown amplitudes A_{l m n} (the frequencies survive as a property of the endpoint, not of the data).

contractions.name: Effacement of internal structure: extended body -> worldline with Wilson coefficients
contractions.mathematical_form: S = -m Integral d tau + (1/2) S_{mu nu} Omega^{mu nu} + (c_E/2) Integral d tau E_{mu nu}E^{mu nu} + (c_B/2) Integral d tau B_{mu nu}B^{mu nu} + ..., with the electric tidal coefficient c_E proportional to k_2 R^5 / G (k_2 the quadrupolar Love number). Damour's effacement principle: for non-spinning bodies in GR the internal composition first enters the conservative two-body dynamics at 5PN order, through the Love numbers. The map is (full interior solution) -> (m, S^{mu nu}, k_2, ...), a reduction of an infinite-dimensional interior to a finite coefficient list.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: It is the gravitational specialization of decoupling to bound systems, and it is why the GR brief's GW observables can be stated as a finite parameter set at all: the LIGO/Virgo analyses behind the brief's strong-field entries are fits to (m_1, m_2, chi_1, chi_2, Lambda-tilde), not to interior solutions. It is also the point where the no-hair contraction reappears at EFT level: the object that contraction number four produces has, exactly, vanishing static tidal response.
contractions.what_it_erases: The interior metric and matter distribution of the body; its radial profile, density, composition and internal modes, up to the finite truncated list of worldline coefficients retained at the working PN order.

contractions.name: Horizon / subregion coarse-graining (the quantum counterpart of no-hair)
contractions.mathematical_form: Restriction of the net of observables, A(M) -> A(O) for O the exterior region, together with the gravitational dressing A(O) -> A(O) crossed-product-with R by the modular automorphism group sigma_t, converting a type III_1 factor into type II. Entropy of the resulting algebra: S_gen = <A>/(4 G hbar) + S_out. Hawking: the exterior semiclassical state is KMS at beta = 2 pi / kappa, T_H = hbar kappa / 2 pi. Many-to-one degeneracy: exp(A/4 G hbar) microstates map to one semiclassical exterior.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: It supplies the count of what the classical no-hair contraction erased: the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy is the logarithm of that contraction's fiber size, and the quantum-gravity brief records the crossed-product route as obtaining S_gen 'as a von Neumann entropy with zero fitted parameters'. It is operative rather than decorative because it is the only formulation in which the erasure is quantified rather than merely asserted. Note the form is forced, not chosen: as the brief's own known_disconnect states, type III_1 local algebras admit no tensor factorization, so a naive 'trace out the interior' is malformed -- the crossed product is what makes the map well-typed.
contractions.what_it_erases: Which of the exp(A/4 G hbar) microstates is present, within the semiclassical description; all intrinsic algebraic data of the subregion algebra (by Buchholz-D'Antoni-Fredenhagen universality every such algebra is the same hyperfinite III_1 factor, so nothing distinguishes them); the relative phases of the interior state as seen by an exterior observer.

kernel_elements.element: The relevant directions and their undetermined amplitudes: Newton's constant G (equivalently M_Pl^2) and the cosmological constant Lambda. In 4D these are the only relevant local metric-only diffeo-invariant couplings, and the two-derivative truncation is a two-parameter family.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: In the linearized flow delta g_i(k) = sum_I C_I V^I_i (k/k_0)^{-theta_I}, a direction with theta_I > 0 GROWS toward the IR: the contraction cannot drive it to zero, it can only carry its boundary value. The eigenvalue statement is elementary linear algebra on the stability matrix d beta_i / d g_j, hence provable. The identification of exactly {G, Lambda} is pinned independently by the Lovelock uniqueness result the GR brief records: in 4D the only symmetric divergence-free rank-2 tensors from the metric and its first two derivatives are the metric and Einstein tensors, so the image of the two-derivative truncation is precisely Einstein-Hilbert + Lambda. The flow's inability to predict these values is visible in the brief as the open problem 'Lambda's value is unexplained: REPRODUCTION-grade in every audited account, PREDICTION-grade in none.'
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining: the RG semigroup on the space of diffeomorphism-invariant effective actions

kernel_elements.element: Anti-contraction of the super-renormalizable couplings: the map MAGNIFIES rather than suppresses the UV boundary data in Lambda and G. Heavy states of mass M contribute to the vacuum energy as M^4 and to M_Pl^2 as M^2, with no 1/M suppression.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Suppression in an EFT is a statement about operators of negative mass dimension; Lambda (dimension 4) and M_Pl^2 R (dimension 2) run the other way. Appelquist-Carazzone decoupling covers irrelevant operators only -- it explicitly does not protect relevant ones, which is the standard statement of why the hierarchy and cosmological-constant problems are not solved by decoupling. This is the precise mechanism behind the GR brief's known_disconnect 'naive vacuum-energy estimates exceed the observed Lambda by ~120 orders of magnitude', including its correct caveat that the magnitude is regularization-dependent but the mismatch is not: what is regulator-independent is the sign of the scaling exponent.
kernel_elements.contraction: Decoupling / heavy-sector matching (Appelquist-Carazzone)

kernel_elements.element: The non-analytic (nonlocal) sector of the effective action generated by massless loops: R ln(-Box/mu^2) R, C ln(-Box/mu^2) C, and the momentum-space form factors sqrt(-q^2) and q^2 ln(-q^2). Observable consequence: V(r) = -G m_1 m_2 / r [1 + 3G(m_1+m_2)/(r c^2) + (41/10 pi) G hbar/(r^2 c^3)].
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A massless two-particle threshold forces a branch cut at s = 0 in the amplitude by unitarity, and analyticity then fixes the discontinuity from the light spectrum alone. No local operator -- polynomial in momenta by construction -- has a branch cut. Therefore no redefinition of any Wilson coefficient, no shift of cutoff, and no choice of UV completion can produce, cancel or modify these terms: they lie outside the image of ANY local truncation. This is the exact technical content of the GR brief's 'leading quantum corrections at low curvature are parameter-free and calculable'. The two coefficients quoted (3 and 41/10 pi) were verified against the literature; the 41/10 pi value is the corrected Bjerrum-Bohr-Donoghue-Holstein result (PRD 67, 084033 with the 2005 erratum), not the 1994 number.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining: the RG semigroup on the space of diffeomorphism-invariant effective actions

kernel_elements.element: The trace-anomaly central charges a and c: <T^mu_mu> = (c/16 pi^2) C_{mu nu rho sigma}C^{mu nu rho sigma} - (a/16 pi^2) E_4, together with the monotonicity a_UV > a_IR.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: a and c are not free Wilson coefficients but the coefficients of the obstruction to Weyl invariance, fixed by Wess-Zumino consistency and computed from the massless field content. They are therefore determined by whatever the flow has NOT erased. The a-theorem (Komargodski-Schwimmer) makes a a strictly monotone functional along unitary flows between 4D CFTs, so a is a Lyapunov-type label: the contraction moves along it but each endpoint's value is an invariant of that endpoint. Note the setting is exactly the one at issue -- the anomaly is defined with the metric as a background field.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining: the RG semigroup on the space of diffeomorphism-invariant effective actions

kernel_elements.element: Diffeomorphism invariance itself and its Ward identity grad_mu T^{mu nu} = 0 -- while the action is NOT protected.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The flow is constructed inside the space of diffeo-invariant functionals (background-field method; the Slavnov-Taylor/BRST identities are preserved by a symmetry-compatible regulator), so the symmetry constrains the contraction rather than being acted on by it.
