The kernel/erasure split here is stated verbatim in the GR brief's symmetries row: the Ward identity 'enforces only grad_mu T^{mu nu} = 0 ... and does not determine the action' -- Einstein-Hilbert, R^2, f(R), Lovelock and nonlocal curvature actions all satisfy it. So: symmetry survives the contraction; action selection does not. The only caveat on the grade is regulator compatibility, which is a technical matter rather than a physical one.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining: the RG semigroup on the space of diffeomorphism-invariant effective actions

kernel_elements.element: The massless spin-2 graviton with exactly two transverse-traceless helicity states.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Two independent protections. (i) Representation theory: a massless particle in 4D Minkowski carries a one-dimensional rep of the little group ISO(2), giving helicities +2 and -2 and nothing else -- this is a theorem, not a dynamical outcome. (ii) A graviton mass is a RELEVANT deformation that breaks linearized diffeo invariance; a symmetry-preserving flow cannot generate it, only a UV boundary condition can tune it in. The GR brief's observational row ('exactly two TT polarizations at c to 1e-15', GW170814/GW170817) is the measured shadow of this, and the brief correctly notes the two-mode count is itself a derived object of linearized Einstein-Hilbert dynamics rather than an independent postulate.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining: the RG semigroup on the space of diffeomorphism-invariant effective actions

kernel_elements.element: Weinberg's soft-graviton theorem and its corollary, the universality of the gravitational coupling kappa (the equivalence principle).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Lorentz invariance of the S-matrix for an exchanged massless helicity-2 particle forces the leading soft factor to be universal: every species must couple with identical strength, and at most one such particle can do so. This is a low-energy theorem -- fixed entirely by the pole structure and gauge invariance of the amplitude, therefore insensitive to every Wilson coefficient the contraction sets. The GR brief's MICROSCOPE entry (Eotvos eta = [-1.5 +/- 2.3(stat) +/- 1.5(syst)]e-15) measures this kernel element directly. I deliberately grounded this on the soft theorem rather than on the Weinberg-Witten theorem also in the brief, because Weinberg-Witten's hypotheses (a Lorentz-covariant conserved T_{mu nu}, exact Poincare invariance) are precisely what the brief's own caveat flags as the assumptions emergent-gravity schemes relax.
kernel_elements.contraction: Wilsonian coarse-graining: the RG semigroup on the space of diffeomorphism-invariant effective actions

kernel_elements.element: 't Hooft anomaly matching: the anomaly coefficients of any exact symmetry (including mixed gauge-gravitational anomalies) computed in the UV equal those computed in the IR.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: This is the canonical obstruction to erasure. The anomaly coefficient is quantized and topological in origin, so it cannot vary continuously along a flow; heavy fields decouple from the dynamics but their contribution to the anomaly must be reproduced exactly by the surviving light content or by a Wess-Zumino term. It is therefore UV data that decoupling provably cannot destroy, and it is one of the very few channels by which a low-curvature observer learns something true about the UV spectrum.
kernel_elements.contraction: Decoupling / heavy-sector matching (Appelquist-Carazzone)

kernel_elements.element: The light spectrum itself: the masses, spins and gauge representations of every state below the matching scale, recorded in the IR as the locations of branch points in the form factors.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The matching map is DEFINED relative to the light content -- it is the data with respect to which 'heavy' and 'suppressed' are meaningful, so the map cannot act on it. Operationally it is protected by the same analyticity argument as the non-analytic sector: a threshold at s = 4m^2 is a singularity of the amplitude and no local operator can move or remove a singularity.
kernel_elements.contraction: Decoupling / heavy-sector matching (Appelquist-Carazzone)

kernel_elements.element: The positivity / causality cone in which the surviving Wilson coefficients must lie, including the Camanho-Edelstein-Maldacena-Zhiboedov constraint: a nonzero higher-derivative correction alpha to the graviton three-point coupling requires an infinite tower of J > 2 states at mass of order 1/sqrt(alpha), or causality fails.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Dispersive sum rules express each IR coefficient as a spectral integral against a positive measure built from UV states; unitarity, crossing and analyticity -- which the flow respects -- therefore confine the coefficients to a convex cone. So although the contraction forgets WHICH UV completion, it cannot make the IR coefficients arbitrary: the cone is genuine UV information that survives. Scope, stated honestly: in gravity the forward limit is dominated by the t-channel graviton pole, which invalidates naive fixed-t forward dispersion relations; the rigorous gravitational version requires smeared or non-forward dispersion relations (impact-parameter wavepackets), and the technical formulation remains an active area, including one-loop corrections to the relevant beta functions. The structural statement is established; some specific numerical bounds are not settled.
kernel_elements.contraction: Decoupling / heavy-sector matching (Appelquist-Carazzone)

kernel_elements.element: On-shell S-matrix elements and gauge-invariant observables.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: This is the defining property of the quotient: by the equivalence theorem (Chisholm 1961; Kamefuchi-O'Raifeartaigh-Salam 1961; Borchers), a local invertible field redefinition leaves the S-matrix invariant. The kernel of the quotient is therefore EXACTLY the set of on-shell amplitudes -- nothing more, nothing less. The practical consequence is that cross-theory comparisons performed on off-shell, gauge-dependent coefficients are comparing representatives rather than classes, and are ill-posed by construction.
kernel_elements.contraction: Field-redefinition and total-derivative quotient (on-shell / S-matrix equivalence)

kernel_elements.element: Operators outside the EOM ideal: in 4D pure gravity the first genuinely physical higher-curvature correction is cubic in the Riemann tensor, carrying the Goroff-Sagnotti two-loop divergence with coefficient 209/2880 times (4 pi)^{-4} epsilon^{-1}.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The quotient kills only the ideal generated by grad_mu J^mu and by E^{mu nu}[g]. The Weyl-cubed structure lies in neither: it is not a total derivative and it does not vanish on Ricci-flat backgrounds. That is precisely why this divergence, unlike the one-loop one, constitutes a proof of non-renormalizability rather than a removable artifact -- the pair ('t Hooft-Veltman finite on shell, Goroff-Sagnotti not) is the cleanest demonstration that this contraction has a nontrivial kernel. Verified against the literature; the coefficient is scheme-conventionally also quoted as -209/1440 (kappa/2)^2 (4 pi)^{-4} epsilon^{-1} in MS-bar.
kernel_elements.contraction: Field-redefinition and total-derivative quotient (on-shell / S-matrix equivalence)

kernel_elements.element: Global topological data: the Gauss-Bonnet density integrates to 32 pi^2 chi(M); the Pontryagin density to the first Pontryagin number; spin structure and the underlying manifold topology.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are characteristic numbers -- integers -- attached to bundles over the manifold, while the contraction is a local functional integration over field modes at fixed topology. A local map cannot change an integer-valued global invariant. The split is sharp and worth stating precisely: Gauss-Bonnet's contribution to the 4D equations of motion is identically zero (erased), while its contribution to the partition function's topology dependence and to Wald entropy (a topological constant per horizon component) is not (kernel). The same term is therefore in the kernel and in the erasure list, under different functionals.
kernel_elements.contraction: Field-redefinition and total-derivative quotient (on-shell / S-matrix equivalence)

kernel_elements.element: The number of propagating poles below the cutoff: a local invertible field redefinition can relabel degrees of freedom but cannot delete them.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The equivalence theorem's hypotheses include invertibility and locality; under those the particle content is preserved. The instructive case is R + alpha R^2 treated non-perturbatively: the conformal transformation g -> exp(2 omega) g maps it to Einstein gravity plus a scalaron of mass^2 = M_Pl^2/6 alpha, MOVING the mode into a different variable rather than removing it. Within the EFT's own domain of validity the scalaron sits at or above the cutoff and its perturbative removal is legitimate; the invariant statement is that the count of light poles is not something the quotient can act on.
kernel_elements.contraction: Field-redefinition and total-derivative quotient (on-shell / S-matrix equivalence)

kernel_elements.element: The Gauss-law surface charges: ADM four-momentum P^mu (hence M), angular momentum J, and any unbroken long-range U(1) charge Q. Sharpened: gravitational radiation carries only l >= 2, so the multipole sectors the contraction CAN remove begin exactly at l = 2 and the sectors it must leave are exactly (l = 0, l = 1) = (M, J).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are boundary integrals over the sphere at spatial infinity determined by the Hamiltonian and momentum constraints, and they are the surface terms Regge and Teitelboim showed must be added to make the generators of asymptotic symmetries differentiable. No bulk evolution can change an integral over the boundary of the Cauchy slice. The sharpened form is the real content of no-hair: conservation of mass forbids monopole (l=0) gravitational radiation and conservation of angular momentum forbids dipole (l=1), so the two-parameter final state is the conservation-law complement of the radiative sector, not a coincidence of the uniqueness theorems. The positive mass theorem (Schoen-Yau; Witten) additionally bounds the attractor manifold: M >= 0, with M = 0 only for Minkowski.
kernel_elements.contraction: Dissipative relaxation to the stationary attractor (the no-hair contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The choice among degenerate attractors: which member of the two-parameter Kerr family (three-parameter Kerr-Newman) the flow lands on.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The stationary exterior solutions form a continuous family of fixed points; the relaxation dynamics is indifferent among them, and the selection is made entirely by the conserved charges of the initial data. This is the textbook instance of 'the contraction cannot choose among degenerate fixed points'. It also explains the GR brief's derived object: the Kerr quasinormal spectrum omega_{l m n}(M, J) from Teukolsky theory is a property of the attractor, not of what fell in -- which is exactly why it could be derived independently of the ringdown observations that later matched it. Grade held at STANDARD rather than THEOREM because the uniqueness theorems assume stationarity, asymptotic flatness, non-degeneracy and vacuum/electrovac, and Hawking's reduction of the general stationary case to the axisymmetric one invokes ANALYTICITY; that assumption has so far been removed only perturbatively, for small deformations of Kerr (Alexakis-Ionescu-Klainerman, via Carleman estimates and a smallness condition on the Mars-Simon tensor), not in general.
kernel_elements.contraction: Dissipative relaxation to the stationary attractor (the no-hair contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The geometry of the attractor manifold: horizon topology S^2 in 4D, and the extremality boundary |J| <= G M^2 / c.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Hawking's topology theorem (dominant energy condition; Galloway-Schoen's higher-dimensional generalization to positive Yamabe type) forbids any other horizon topology for a stationary asymptotically flat 4D black hole, so the contraction's image is not merely low-dimensional but topologically rigid. The extremality bound is a regularity condition on the Kerr metric: beyond a = M there is no horizon. The purely geometric statements are provable. The DYNAMICAL claim -- that the evolution can never carry data out of the cone -- is weak cosmic censorship, which remains an unproven conjecture; I have not graded that part.
kernel_elements.contraction: Dissipative relaxation to the stationary attractor (the no-hair contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The horizon area as a strictly monotone Lyapunov functional, and its terminal value A = 8 pi G^2 M^2 c^{-4} [1 + sqrt(1 - (cJ/GM^2)^2)].
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Hawking's area theorem gives delta A >= 0 given the null energy condition and the standard global hypotheses (global hyperbolicity, predictability; the modern proof, Chruiel-Delay-Galloway-Howard, does not assume horizon smoothness). The contraction does not erase A -- it maximizes it. A is therefore a permanent record THAT the contraction acted, and it bounds how much could have been radiated (Hawking's ~29 percent ceiling for an equal-mass head-on merger). This is the structural analogue of an H-theorem and is what makes the no-hair map a genuine dissipative semigroup rather than merely a non-invertible one.
kernel_elements.contraction: Dissipative relaxation to the stationary attractor (the no-hair contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Discrete gauge ('quantum') hair: a Z_N charge left by a U(1) broken to Z_N, detectable only by an Aharonov-Bohm phase around a cosmic string (Krauss-Wilczek; non-Abelian case Alford-March-Russell-Wilczek).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The charge is a holonomy -- a topological datum of the gauge bundle in the exterior region -- and topology is not a continuous dynamical variable that radiation or horizon absorption can relax. It can be written as a surface integral in states containing a shell of unbroken vacuum, so its value is unaffected by anything inside. It is invisible in the classical metric and therefore constitutes a genuine and well-established counterexample to the naive reading of no-hair: the contraction erases continuous global charges but provably not discrete gauge charges.
kernel_elements.contraction: Dissipative relaxation to the stationary attractor (the no-hair contraction)

kernel_elements.element: BMS supertranslation charges ('soft hair') and the gravitational memory effect: the final state is not a single Kerr geometry but an infinite family of supertranslated Kerr geometries carrying different supertranslation charge at identical (M, J).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The asymptotic symmetry group at null infinity is BMS, not Poincare, and supertranslations carry an infinite set of charges obeying exact flux-balance laws Q^+ = Q^- + flux. Because these are charges of an asymptotic symmetry, they are boundary data of the same kind as ADM mass, and the relaxation dynamics cannot act on them. The observable is the Christodoulou-Zel'dovich memory effect -- a permanent relative displacement of test masses after a burst, equal to a supertranslation of the vacuum. I state only this: the charges are conserved and non-erased, and the degeneracy of the final state under them is real. The stronger claim, that soft hair resolves the information problem, is NOT established and I do not rely on it.
kernel_elements.contraction: Dissipative relaxation to the stationary attractor (the no-hair contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Cross-link kernel: the Wilson coefficient of a scalar-Gauss-Bonnet operator f(phi) G is not erased by the no-hair contraction -- it produces secondary hair and shifts the quasinormal spectrum.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Bekenstein-type no-scalar-hair arguments assume minimal coupling and a convex potential; a f(phi) times Gauss-Bonnet coupling sources the scalar on the horizon and evades them, producing genuine hairy solutions: Einstein-dilaton-Gauss-Bonnet black holes (Kanti-Mavromatos-Rizos-Tamvakis), spontaneously scalarized black holes (Doneva-Yazadjiev; Silva-Sakstein-Gualtieri-Sotiriou-Berti), Bartnik-McKinnon Einstein-Yang-Mills solitons, Skyrmion hair. The structural point is a real coupling between the two contractions: exactly the higher-curvature operators the RG contraction suppresses are the ones that would ENLARGE the no-hair kernel. The no-hair contraction is therefore not universal -- it is a statement about the vacuum/electrovac Einstein sector, and its kernel grows with the EFT coefficients that survive. Grade covers the existence of these solutions; their astrophysical relevance is a separate and weaker question.
kernel_elements.contraction: Dissipative relaxation to the stationary attractor (the no-hair contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The surviving worldline coefficients: mass m, spin S^{mu nu}, and the tidal Love numbers (observationally, the combination Lambda-tilde).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are exactly the coefficients the effacement expansion retains at the working order: m and S at leading and next-to-leading order, and the Love numbers entering the conservative two-body dynamics at 5PN for non-spinning bodies. They are the finite residue the interior-to-worldline map leaves behind, and they are measured -- GW170817's tidal-deformability constraint is a direct measurement of this kernel element.
kernel_elements.contraction: Effacement of internal structure: extended body -> worldline with Wilson coefficients

kernel_elements.element: A protected zero: the static tidal Love numbers of a 4D Schwarzschild or Kerr black hole vanish identically, at all orders in the external tidal field.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: This is a kernel element rather than an erasure because it is a protected value, not an absence of information: the contraction cannot make it nonzero, and its exactness is traced to hidden symmetry structure (Love/SL(2,R) ladder symmetries, and non-linear symmetries in the Ernst-formalism treatment) rather than to numerical accident. The sharpest evidence that it is structural is its dimension-dependence: the electromagnetic and scalar static responses vanish only in four dimensions. It is also the EFT-level image of no-hair -- a black hole has no tidal hair -- and it is a falsifiable discriminator, since any material body has k_2 strictly nonzero.
kernel_elements.contraction: Effacement of internal structure: extended body -> worldline with Wilson coefficients

kernel_elements.element: The dissipative response is NOT zero: horizon absorption / tidal heating, the imaginary part of the response function proportional to (omega - m Omega_H).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The conservative structure constant vanishes but the absorptive one does not: the horizon is a one-way membrane and continues to absorb (and, for omega < m Omega_H, to superradiate) at any frequency. The contraction therefore erases the reactive response while leaving the dissipative one, which is a genuine asymmetry and the EFT-level trace of the horizon's existence. This matters because it is the one worldline channel through which a black hole remains distinguishable from a hypothetical horizonless object with matched conservative response.
kernel_elements.contraction: Effacement of internal structure: extended body -> worldline with Wilson coefficients

kernel_elements.element: The generalized entropy S_gen = A/(4 G hbar) + S_out, which counts the logarithm of the fiber size of the classical no-hair contraction.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: It is not a datum the contraction acts on but a measure OF the contraction: A/4G hbar is precisely the number of bits the no-hair map destroyed, obtained by the crossed-product construction as a von Neumann entropy with zero fitted parameters (the quantum-gravity brief's derived-objects row). Its non-erasure is structural -- an entropy that measured the erasure and were itself erased would be inconsistent. The generalized second law makes it monotone; that half is proved in restricted settings (Wall's proof for free and superrenormalizable fields on Killing horizons) rather than in full generality, which is why the grade is STANDARD.
kernel_elements.contraction: Horizon / subregion coarse-graining (the quantum counterpart of no-hair)

kernel_elements.element: The relative data survives while the intrinsic data is totally erased: the invariant is the inclusion A(O) contained in A(M) together with its modular data, NOT any property of the subregion algebra by itself.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: By Buchholz-D'Antoni-Fredenhagen universality (under their nuclearity-type assumptions) the local algebra of any reasonable Poincare-covariant QFT is the unique hyperfinite type III_1 factor, so the single algebra carries literally no distinguishing information -- the contraction has already erased everything intrinsic. What it cannot erase is the net assignment, which region gets which algebra, and the modular flow of the state. The quantum-gravity brief states both halves: local algebras admit no tensor factorization (so a naive subsystem split is malformed, not merely difficult), and the output algebra type is a function of which structure is inserted -- II_infinity where another boundary structure exists, II_1 in its absence, as in de Sitter. This is a case where identifying the kernel correctly REQUIRED getting the contraction's type right.
kernel_elements.contraction: Horizon / subregion coarse-graining (the quantum counterpart of no-hair)

kernel_elements.element: The Hawking temperature and the KMS structure: T_H = hbar kappa / 2 pi with kappa = (r_+ - M)/(r_+^2 + a^2) for Kerr -- a function of (M, J) alone.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Kay and Wald proved that on a spacetime with a bifurcate Killing horizon there is at most ONE Hadamard state invariant under the horizon Killing flow, and that it is KMS at beta = 2 pi / kappa (the flat-space precursor being Bisognano-Wichmann for the Rindler wedge). So the thermal character is not a choice the coarse-graining could have made differently: it is forced by the geometry. Note the tight consistency with the classical kernel -- kappa depends only on (M, J), the very data the no-hair contraction could not erase, so the quantum contraction inherits its label from the classical one rather than supplying a new one.
kernel_elements.contraction: Horizon / subregion coarse-graining (the quantum counterpart of no-hair)

things_erased_completely: The identity of the UV completion. All fourteen candidate frameworks enumerated in the quantum-gravity brief lie in a single fiber of the matching map at present precision -- the brief's own record that none produced a parameter-free, currently-measurable prediction differing from EFT is that statement, measured. Stated precisely: the erasure is asymptotic in E/M_Pl, not exact, so any finite-precision IR measurement leaves a residual convex cone of admissible UV completions (see the positivity kernel element) rather than literally nothing.

The UV boundary values c_n(Lambda_UV) of every irrelevant higher-curvature coupling, unrecoverable from IR data to accuracy O((E/M_Pl)^{2n-4}). At observed curvatures -- which the GR brief correctly notes remain far below Planckian even in detected mergers -- this is unrecoverable at any realistic precision.

The coefficients of every operator in the equation-of-motion ideal: R^2 and R_{mu nu}R^{mu nu} in 4D pure gravity, and every term proportional to E^{mu nu}[g]. This is why the 't Hooft-Veltman one-loop divergence of pure gravity carries no physical consequence whatsoever.

The LOCAL content of every total derivative: the Gauss-Bonnet density contributes identically zero to the 4D field equations. (Its global content survives as 32 pi^2 chi(M) and as a topological constant in Wald entropy -- the same object is erased under one functional and protected under another.)

All field-parametrization and scheme data: the choice of metric variable (g_{mu nu} vs g^{mu nu} vs sqrt(g) g^{mu nu} vs vielbein), the gauge-fixing function, the regularization scheme, the split between coupling renormalization and operator coefficient, and every off-shell value of the effective action. A consequence worth naming: comparisons of gauge-dependent off-shell coefficients across formulations are comparing representatives, not equivalence classes, and are ill-posed independently of anyone's care in performing them.

Every l >= 2 mass and current multipole of a collapsing configuration, removed by radiation to null infinity and through the horizon at the Price rates t^{-(2l+3)} at fixed radius (u^{-(l+2)} at null infinity, v^{-(2l+3)} on the horizon).
The composition, equation of state, entropy, and internal thermodynamic history of collapsing matter.

Charges of short-range and continuous global symmetries: baryon number, lepton number, and any global charge with no associated massless gauge field. There is no Gauss-law surface integral for them, so nothing outside the horizon can register them. (Discrete GAUGE charges are not erased -- see the Krauss-Wilczek kernel element -- and the distinction is exactly gauge-vs-global, not discrete-vs-continuous.)

All ringdown amplitudes A_{l m n}: the initial data determines which quasinormal modes are excited and how strongly, and every one of those amplitudes decays to zero. Only the frequencies survive, and those are properties of the endpoint (M, J), not of the data -- which is what makes ringdown a test of the attractor rather than a probe of the progenitor.
The conservative tidal structure constants of any body that becomes a black hole: k_2 -> 0 exactly in 4D.

Which of the exp(A/4 G hbar) microstates is present, WITHIN the semiclassical description. I state this with its scope: whether the information is erased in the full theory is the black-hole information problem, which is unresolved, and I do not assert the stronger claim.

Spurious poles introduced by treating a truncated higher-derivative action non-perturbatively: the Ostrogradsky ghost at mass^2 of order M_Pl^2 / c_2 in an R + c_2 C^2 truncation. This is structure the EFT contraction demonstrably destroys, and destroying it is correct -- the ghost is an artifact of exceeding the domain of validity, removed by perturbative treatment or order reduction.
kernels.method_note: SELECTION CRITERIA. I admitted a map as a contraction only if it met three tests: (a) genuinely non-invertible, with fibers of positive or infinite dimension that I could characterize; (b) OPERATIVE, meaning the domain's own predictive content depends on the map rather than merely being conveniently expressed through it -- for gravity the sharp version is that non-renormalizability makes the Wilsonian and matching contractions load-bearing, and that dissipation makes the no-hair map an attractor with a Lyapunov function rather than a mere projection; (c) distinct in MECHANISM, not merely in description. Test (c) is what forced the six apart: continuous flow in scale at fixed field content (1), discontinuous threshold reduction of field content (2), quotient by a redundancy of description with no dynamics at all (3), dissipative evolution on solution space with an H-theorem (4), reduction of an interior to worldline coefficients (5), and restriction of an algebra to a subregion (6). Several standard framings collapse into one of these and I did not double-count them: the linearized/weak-field and post-Newtonian truncations are amplitude expansions inside (1) and (5); the derivative expansion is not a separate contraction but the coordinate system in which (1) acts, and the non-analytic massless-loop sector is best stated as (1)'s kernel -- the obstruction to (1) ever landing inside the local actions -- rather than as a map of its own. I REJECTED one candidate: the finite-resolution measurement map (theory -> the vector of measured numbers with error bars: PPN gamma - 1 = (2.1 +/- 2.3)e-5, the GW speed bound, the Eotvos ratio). It is many-to-one, but it is epistemic rather than dynamical -- it makes theories indistinguishable, not identical -- so I used its data as evidence for fiber size and did not list it as a contraction.  HOW THE BRIEFS INFLUENCED THE KERNEL LIST. Five places where they changed what I wrote, not merely confirmed it. (i) The Lovelock uniqueness row gave the sharp statement of what the two-derivative truncation leaves: not 'a few couplings' but provably a two-parameter family, which is what let me grade the {G, Lambda} kernel element THEOREM rather than STANDARD. (ii) The pairing of the brief's 120-orders vacuum/Lambda mismatch with its 'Lambda's value is unexplained' open problem pushed me to state the ANTI-contraction explicitly -- that relevant couplings are magnified rather than suppressed by the flow, and that Appelquist-Carazzone protects only irrelevant operators. That is the sharpest item in the RG sector and I would likely have left it implicit otherwise. (iii) The symmetries row, that the diffeomorphism Ward identity enforces only covariant conservation and 'does not determine the action', is verbatim the kernel/erasure split for contraction (1): symmetry survives, action selection does not. I adopted its framing. (iv) The Weinberg-Witten row's own scoping caveat -- that the theorem assumes a Lorentz-covariant conserved stress tensor and exact Poincare invariance, exactly what emergent schemes relax -- is why I grounded the massless-spin-2 and universal-coupling kernel elements on the little group and Weinberg's soft theorem instead, which do not share those hypotheses. (v) The quantum-gravity brief's type III_1 entries changed the TYPE of contraction (6): its known_disconnect that local algebras admit no tensor factorization means 'trace out the interior' is malformed, so I wrote the crossed-product form and stated the kernel as the inclusion plus modular data rather than as a density matrix on a factor. The brief's Teukolsky/Kerr-quasinormal derived object similarly shaped contraction (4) as an attractor-with-a-spectrum and made the 'choice among degenerate fixed points' element concrete.  WHAT I DID NOT TAKE FROM THE BRIEFS. I used no PROGRAM-RESULT entry as a physics premise; both briefs flag those as in-house and unreviewed, and where one coincided with a standard result I relied on the standard result instead. I used the crossed-product entry only for its COMMUNITY-DERIVED content and its published anchors. I did not use the TO-VERIFY Everpresent-Lambda entry at all. Everything else is from outside the briefs: Price's law, Goroff-Sagnotti, 't Hooft-Veltman, the 41/10 pi coefficient, Appelquist-Carazzone, 't Hooft anomaly matching, the a-theorem, Chern-Gauss-Bonnet, ADM/Regge-Teitelboim, the positive mass theorem, Hawking's area and topology theorems, Israel/Carter-Robinson uniqueness, Krauss-Wilczek, BMS/memory/soft hair, Love numbers and effacement, CEMZ, Bisognano-Wichmann and Kay-Wald.  VERIFICATION PERFORMED (web, this session). Confirmed: the Goroff-Sagnotti coefficient 209/2880 (4 pi)^{-4} epsilon^{-1} on Riemann-cubed, and its equivalent MS-bar form -209/1440; 't Hooft-Veltman one-loop on-shell finiteness via field redefinition reducing the counterterm to Gauss-Bonnet, a total derivative in 4D; the leading quantum correction coefficient 41/10 pi (the corrected Bjerrum-Bohr-Donoghue-Holstein value, PRD 67 084033 with 2005 erratum, not the 1994 number); Price's law exponent t^{-(2l+3)} for compactly supported data with the known t^{-(2l+5)} log t corruption at higher order; vanishing of 4D black-hole static Love numbers at all orders in the tidal field, and the fact that scalar and electromagnetic responses vanish ONLY in four dimensions; the Kerr-uniqueness analyticity assumption and the Alexakis-Ionescu-Klainerman result being perturbative (small Mars-Simon tensor) rather than general -- which is why I graded the attractor-label element STANDARD, not THEOREM; the CEMZ infinite-higher-spin-tower requirement; Krauss-Wilczek discrete gauge hair and its Aharonov-Bohm detection; and the t-channel graviton pole obstruction to naive forward gravitational positivity bounds, with smeared/non-forward dispersion relations as the current rigorous route and the formulation still technically active -- which is why that kernel element carries an explicit scope caveat rather than a clean grade.  GRADING DISCIPLINE. THEOREM is reserved for statements with a proof under stated hypotheses, and I named the hypotheses where they bite (area theorem: null energy condition plus global hyperbolicity/predictability; topology theorem: dominant energy condition; BDF universality: nuclearity-type assumptions; a-theorem: unitary flows between 4D CFTs). Where the geometric half of a claim is proved and the dynamical half is conjectural I split them explicitly rather than averaging: the extremality bound |J| <= GM^2 is graded THEOREM as a regularity condition on the metric, while the claim that evolution can never exit the cone is weak cosmic censorship and is left ungraded. Two elements I deliberately stated in weaker form than the literature sometimes does: soft hair is asserted only as conserved non-erased charge with an observable memory signature, NOT as a resolution of the information problem; and microstate erasure is scoped to the semiclassical description, with the full-theory question left open.

contractions.name: C1. Cosmic no-hair: the expansion-normalized omega-limit map (Wald contraction)
contractions.mathematical_form: Let x = (H, sigma_ij, {}^3R_ij, rho_A) be homogeneous data with Lambda > 0 and non-Lambda matter obeying the dominant and strong energy conditions. Define expansion-normalized variables Sigma_ij = sigma_ij/H, Omega_A = rho_A/(3H^2), Omega_k = -{}^3R/(6H^2). The contraction is the LIMIT map Psi = lim_{t->inf} Phi_t composed with normalization:  Psi: (Sigma_ij, Omega_k, Omega_A) |-> (0, 0, 0),  H -> H_inf = sqrt(Lambda/3).  Rates: sigma_ij ~ a^{-3} ~ e^{-3H_inf t}, {}^3R ~ a^{-2}, rho_m ~ a^{-3}, rho_r ~ a^{-4}, rho_Lambda ~ a^0; Wald (PRD 28, 2118 (1983)) gives H - H_inf <= O(e^{-H_inf t}) for all initially expanding Bianchi I-VIII, and for IX only if the Lambda term initially exceeds the maximum 3-curvature. In the inflationary version the same map reads |Omega - 1| = |K|/(aH)^2 -> e^{-2N}|Omega_0 - 1|.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: It is forced by the dilution hierarchy under accelerated expansion, not chosen: every source of inhomogeneity, anisotropy and curvature redshifts strictly faster than the one source that does not redshift at all. Raychaudhuri with SEC-respecting matter plus Lambda makes H monotone-decreasing and bounded below by sqrt(Lambda/3), so the shear-to-expansion ratio is squeezed by a factor with a strictly negative Lyapunov exponent. Each finite-time flow map Phi_t is a diffeomorphism (Einstein evolution is deterministic and reversible); the non-invertibility lives entirely in the t -> inf limit and in the restriction to a single comoving observer's causal diamond, where data that has been pushed super-Hubble is causally unavailable. That is the operative physics: the expansion does not destroy the data, it removes it from every local observer's reach while exponentially compressing what remains.
contractions.what_it_erases: Initial shear magnitude and principal axes; initial 3-curvature magnitude; the initial matter/radiation density and the epoch-by-epoch composition ratio Omega_m/Omega_Lambda; all sub-Hubble inhomogeneity present at the start (pushed out); after ~60 e-folds these are suppressed by factors e^{-180} (shear) and e^{-120} (curvature), far below any conceivable measurement.

contractions.name: C2. Inflationary slow-roll attractor: centre-manifold / Hamilton-Jacobi reduction of inflaton phase space
contractions.mathematical_form: Flow on (phi, phidot) with phiddot + 3H phidot + V'(phi) = 0, 3 M_p^2 H^2 = phidot^2/2 + V. Contraction: the 2-dimensional phase space collapses onto the 1-dimensional slow-roll (centre/slow) manifold phidot = -V'/(3H) + O(epsilon^2). In Hamilton-Jacobi form (Salopek-Bond 1990) phidot = -2 M_p^2 H'(phi), and the general solution is H(phi) = H_SR(phi)[1 + c exp(-3 int (H/H') dphi / M_p^2)], so transverse deviations decay as delta(phidot) ~ a^{-3}, i.e. e^{-3N}. Map: (phi_0, phidot_0) |-> the single attractor point labelled by N_rem(phi) ~= M_p^{-2} int V/V' dphi. Kinetic-dominated initial data redshifts even faster, rho_kin ~ a^{-6}.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The contracting agent is the Hubble friction term 3H phidot, which is the same H that appears in Friedmann/Raychaudhuri — the reduction is powered by the expansion itself, not by a perturbative truncation. Because the transverse direction is damped at rate 3H while motion along the manifold proceeds at rate ~ epsilon H, the ratio of timescales is 1/epsilon and the slow manifold is a genuine attracting invariant manifold, not an approximation. This is why inflationary predictions are quoted as functions of N alone: one of the two phase-space functions is physically annihilated before the observable window opens.
contractions.what_it_erases: The initial kinetic energy phidot_0 and, with it, the entire transverse coordinate of the pre-inflationary state (erased within about one e-fold for kination-like data); the memory of how inflation was entered; the shape of V away from the ~7-10 e-fold observable window; the total number of e-folds N_total as distinct from N-since-pivot-exit.

contractions.name: C3. Horizon exit: the gradient-expansion projection k/(aH) -> 0 onto the frozen adiabatic mode (separate-universe contraction)
contractions.mathematical_form: Mukhanov-Sasaki: v_k'' + (c_s^2 k^2 - z''/z) v_k = 0 with z^2 = 2 a^2 epsilon / c_s^2. For c_s k << aH the two exact solutions are v ~ z (zeta_k = const) and v ~ z int dtau/z^2 (zeta_k ~ int dt/(a^3 epsilon)). The contraction is the rank-2 -> rank-1 projection P: (zeta_k, zetadot_k) |-> zeta_k^{const}, i.e. the annihilation of the decaying direction. Equivalently, the gradient expansion: zetadot = -(H/(rho+p)) delta p_nad + O(k^2/(aH)^2), and dropping the O(k^2) term is the contraction. Separate-universe/deltaN form: zeta(x) = deltaN(x), with the long mode acting as the dilatation x -> e^{zeta} x.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Causality is the operative physics. Once c_s k < aH, no local process can act across the mode; each Hubble patch is an independent FLRW universe with shifted parameters, and the only residual action of the long mode on local physics is a rescaling of comoving coordinates — a large gauge transformation. So the dynamics cannot do anything to the long mode except leave it alone, and the second (decaying) solution is exactly the one that the expansion damps as a^{-3}. The k^2 term being dropped is not a convenience truncation: it is the statement that there is no causal agent to supply it.
contractions.what_it_erases: Per mode and per polarization, one of the two functions of initial data: the decaying amplitude, equivalently zetadot_k, equivalently the mode's 'initial velocity'. This is precisely why the primordial condition is specifiable by one function of k (a power spectrum) rather than two, and why the brief can record 'nearly scale-invariant adiabatic initial perturbations' as a single declared input. Operationally it also erases the quantum/classical distinction for the mode (see kernel: not erased unitarily).

contractions.name: C4. Growing-mode projection in post-inflationary linear evolution
contractions.mathematical_form: delta'' + 2H delta' - 4 pi G rhobar_m delta = 0 (conformal time) for pressureless matter. Exact solutions with Lambda: D_-(a) ~ H(a) and D_+(a) ~ H(a) int_0^a da'/(a' H(a'))^3. EdS limit: D_+ ~ a ~ t^{2/3}, D_- ~ a^{-3/2} ~ t^{-1}. Contraction: (delta_k, theta_k)|_early |-> D_+(a) A_k(zeta) at late times, with the decaying part suppressed by D_-/D_+ ~ a^{-5/2}. A second stage acts in Lambda domination, where D_+(a) -> const: growth itself freezes.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Gravitational instability in an expanding background is a damped-unstable linear system: the same 2H friction that drives C2 splits the solution space into one exponentially-preferred and one exponentially-suppressed direction. The physics that makes it operative is that the universe is matter-dominated for ~5 decades of scale factor, so a^{-5/2} suppression amounts to >12 decades of contraction on the decaying direction — no realistic decaying-mode admixture survives to be measured. Then Lambda domination freezes D_+, which is a second, genuinely different contraction: it stops the flow from writing any new information into the growing mode.
contractions.what_it_erases: The decaying-mode amplitude — equivalently, any initial peculiar-velocity field not slaved to the density field. After the growing-mode projection, velocity and density are locked by theta = -a H f delta (f = dlnD_+/dlna), so one of the two initial fields is gone.

contractions.name: C5. Late-time attractors of the Friedmann system (de Sitter fixed point; scaling/tracker fixed points)
contractions.mathematical_form: In Omega-variables for flat FLRW with Lambda and a fluid of equation of state w_m: dOmega_Lambda/dlna = 3(1+w_m) Omega_Lambda (1 - Omega_Lambda). Fixed points Omega_Lambda = 0 (repeller) and Omega_Lambda = 1 (global attractor for Lambda > 0, w_m > -1), reached with Omega_m/Omega_Lambda ~ a^{-3(1+w_m)}. For exponential quintessence V = V_0 exp(-lambda phi/M_p), the scaling fixed point has Omega_phi = 3(1+w_m)/lambda^2 (for lambda^2 > 3(1+w_m)), independent of initial conditions — the tracker property.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: It is the same dilution hierarchy as C1 read on the background alone, but it is a distinct map because its endpoint's coordinates are set by the theory (Lambda, or lambda) rather than being a universal zero. It is operative in this domain because it is what makes the present epoch unreconstructible from a single-time local measurement: the attractor erases the matter/dark-energy ratio, so 'why now?' cannot be answered by the flow. The fact that we can measure Omega_m ~ 0.3 at all is not because the contraction failed, but because we observe along a past light cone rather than at a single late time.
contractions.what_it_erases: The initial Omega ratios; any memory of pre-Lambda-domination composition in the asymptotic state; for tracker models, the initial field value and velocity over many decades of basin. Asymptotically, the entire state is one number.

contractions.name: C6. Thermal and kinetic freeze-out: the Boltzmann relic attractor (BBN, WIMP freeze-out, recombination, blackbody thermalization)
contractions.mathematical_form: dY/dx = -(lambda/x^2)(Y^2 - Y_eq^2) with Y = n/s, x = m/T. For x < x_f the equilibrium branch Y -> Y_eq is an attractor: dY/dx has a strongly restoring sign, so any initial Y is pulled to Y_eq within a few Hubble times. At x_f (Gamma ~ H) the comoving abundance freezes: Y_inf ~= x_f/lambda, i.e. Omega h^2 ~ 3e-27 cm^3 s^-1 / <sigma v>. Contraction: (Y_0, arbitrary) |-> Y_inf depending only on <sigma v>, g_*, m. BBN version: the whole nuclear-network trajectory |-> (Y_p, D/H, ...) depending only on eta, N_eff and measured cross-sections. Blackbody version: Compton + double-Compton/bremsstrahlung drive any spectrum to a Planck spectrum for z > 2e6.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: The Boltzmann collision term is dissipative and its equilibrium is an attractor with a finite relaxation time; the expansion then switches the attraction off at a sharp epoch. That two-step structure (attract, then freeze) is the operative mechanism for essentially every cosmological relic, and is exactly what makes the domain predictive: the brief's own framing — 'light-element abundances follow from measured nuclear cross-sections plus one cosmological input' — is a statement that the contraction has reduced the entire pre-BBN history to a single number.
contractions.what_it_erases: All pre-freeze-out abundance information: the initial dark-matter abundance, the pre-BBN nuclear composition, the initial photon spectrum above z ~ 2e6, the symmetric (particle-antiparticle) component of any annihilating species. More broadly, essentially everything about the pre-BBN universe not stored in a conserved charge, a frozen abundance, a spectral distortion, or a super-horizon mode.

contractions.name: C7. Dissipative mode destruction: Silk (photon-diffusion) damping and neutrino/warm free-streaming
contractions.mathematical_form: Delta_k -> Delta_k exp(-k^2/k_D^2), with k_D^{-2}(eta) = int_0^eta (d eta' / (6 (1+R) a n_e sigma_T)) [R^2/(1+R) + 16/15]. Free-streaming analogue: suppression of growth above the free-streaming scale, with the small-scale matter power reduced by Delta P/P ~= -8 f_nu for massive neutrinos. Both are genuinely irreversible: the erased acoustic energy is thermalized and shows up as entropy.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Unlike C1-C5, this is not a limit map or a causal projection: it is real, entropy-producing dissipation in the photon-baryon fluid. Photon mean free path grows, photons random-walk across a wavelength, and the perturbation is mixed into the monopole. It is operative in this domain because it sets the hard small-scale boundary of the linear observable window — no reconstruction, no matter how good, recovers a mode damped by e^{-(k/k_D)^2} with k >> k_D.
contractions.what_it_erases: Acoustic power at k >> k_D (exponentially, hence completely for k/k_D of a few); in the mu-era window (roughly 50 Mpc^-1 < k < 1e4 Mpc^-1) the mode-by-mode phase and amplitude information is destroyed outright, leaving only an integrated residue; free streaming likewise destroys small-scale power above the free-streaming scale.

contractions.name: C8. Nonlinear phase mixing and violent relaxation: coarse-graining of the Vlasov-Poisson flow
contractions.mathematical_form: Fine-grained: df/dt = 0 (Liouville along characteristics). Coarse-grained: fbar = <f>_W over a phase-space window W, and the map f |-> fbar is many-to-one and irreversible in practice because the fine-grained f develops filamentation on scales -> 0. Lynden-Bell violent relaxation: rapidly varying Phi during collapse randomizes energies on a crossing time. In Lagrangian terms, delta = 1/J - 1 with J = det(partial x / partial q) ceases to be single-valued at shell crossing: the Zel'dovich map becomes non-injective.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Shell crossing is the precise point where the map from Lagrangian to Eulerian coordinates stops being invertible; after it, multiple fluid elements occupy the same position with different velocities and only the coarse-grained distribution is accessible. This is the operative contraction in the nonlinear regime the brief hands off to N-body simulation, and it is the reason that regime is characterized by summary statistics rather than by initial-condition reconstruction.
contractions.what_it_erases: At the coarse-grained level: the fine-grained phase-space filamentation, the identity of which Lagrangian patch ended where inside a virialized halo, the initial phases of modes that have gone nonlinear (k > ~0.1-0.5 h/Mpc at z=0), and the one-to-one correspondence between initial and final density fields on those scales.

contractions.name: C9. Model-space contraction on inflationary Lagrangians: V |-> (n_s, r, alpha_s) at fixed N
contractions.mathematical_form: The observational map M: {V(phi), or (V, K(phi), c_s, field content)} -> (n_s, r, ...) with n_s - 1 = -6 epsilon + 2 eta, r = 16 epsilon evaluated N e-folds before the end. Universality classes collapse the fiber: for alpha-attractors (a second-order pole in the kinetic term, Kahler curvature -2/(3 alpha)), every member of the class maps to n_s = 1 - 2/N, r = 12 alpha / N^2 in the small-alpha limit, irrespective of the detailed shape of V. So M has an infinite-dimensional fiber over each image point, and the image is coordinatized by (class label, alpha, N).
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: This one is a contraction on THEORIES, not on states, and it is what the task's phrase 'distinct theories become identical' names in this domain. It is operative because the dynamical attractor C2 has already reduced each theory's prediction to functions of N alone, and because only a ~7-10 e-fold window of any potential is observationally sampled; the rest of the Lagrangian is unprobed by construction. The brief's own entries make the image tiny: n_s = 0.965 +/- 0.004 and r < 0.036 are almost the whole of what the map returns.
contractions.what_it_erases: The individual potential within a universality class; the shape of V outside the observable window; the distinction between models differing only by higher-order slow-roll structure below current sensitivity; the field-space geometry beyond the single curvature parameter alpha.

contractions.name: C10. Background and parameter degeneracies: (Lambda_bare, rho_vac) |-> Lambda_eff, and (Omega_k, Omega_Lambda, H_0) |-> theta_*
contractions.mathematical_form: (i) Lambda_eff = Lambda_bare + 8 pi G rho_vac. This is a LINEAR map R^2 -> R with a literal one-dimensional kernel, the direction (delta Lambda_bare, delta rho_vac) = (-8 pi G c, c). No background or linear-perturbation observable separates points along it. (ii) The CMB geometric degeneracy: the primary TT/TE/EE spectra depend on (omega_b, omega_c, A_s, n_s, tau) and on the single angle theta_* = r_s(z_*)/D_A(z_*); any one-parameter family of (Omega_k, Omega_Lambda, H_0) holding theta_* and the physical densities fixed produces a nearly identical primary spectrum.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Both are exact or near-exact degeneracies of the observable map, independent of any dynamical flow, and both are recorded in the brief: 'Lambda as a geometric constant ... and Lambda as constant vacuum energy density are indistinguishable at the background-cosmology level', and 'the CMB value is model-dependent (LCDM-conditional)'. The operative physics of (i) is that a constant-w = -1 source and a constant in the action enter the Einstein equations in exactly the same place; of (ii) that recombination physics fixes a comoving ruler and the CMB measures only the angle it subtends, not the ruler and distance separately.
contractions.what_it_erases: (i) The entire split of the measured Lambda_eff into geometric and vacuum-energy contributions — which is what turns the ~120-order-of-magnitude vacuum-energy mismatch into a problem of interpretation and not only of magnitude. (ii) The individual values of H_0, Omega_Lambda and Omega_k from primary CMB alone, prior to ISW, lensing, or external data.

contractions.name: C11. Observational contraction: one realization, one past light cone, statistical isotropy
contractions.mathematical_form: The full stochastic 4-volume field |-> (a) its restriction to our past light cone; (b) for the CMB, its restriction to the 2-sphere of last scattering, entering later only through ISW, lensing and polarization; (c) reduction of the realization to rotational invariants, Chat_l = (2l+1)^{-1} sum_m |a_lm|^2. Irreducible floor: Var(Chat_l)/C_l^2 = 2/(2l+1), and no observation reaches k < H_0 or outside the light cone.
contractions.why_this_is_the_contraction: Unlike C1-C8 this is not a dynamical map but the measurement map, and in cosmology it is not removable in principle: there is exactly one sky and exactly one light cone, so the ensemble over which the theory makes statements is never sampled more than once. It belongs in this list because it, not the dynamics, is what fixes the final resolution at which all the other contractions' kernels can be read.
contractions.what_it_erases: The unmeasured realization: modes with k < H_0, the spacetime outside our past light cone, and the radial structure of the last-scattering surface beyond what projection integrals retain; and it caps the recoverable information at low l irreversibly at the cosmic-variance floor.

kernel_elements.element: Lambda itself (equivalently H_inf = sqrt(Lambda/3), and the endpoint's de Sitter entropy S = 3 pi/(G Lambda)).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Lambda is a parameter of the action, not a coordinate on state space; the flow acts on solutions at fixed Lagrangian, so dLambda/dt = 0 identically. The attractor's LOCATION is theory data and is therefore logically upstream of the contraction. This is the precise sense in which no-hair cannot explain the value of Lambda — the brief's 'input everywhere, derived nowhere' is a structural consequence, not an accident of current ignorance.
kernel_elements.contraction: C1. Cosmic no-hair: the expansion-normalized omega-limit map (Wald contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The free asymptotic data at the spacelike conformal boundary I^+: the conformal class of g^(0)_ij and the transverse-traceless tensor g^(3)_ij in the Starobinsky/Fefferman-Graham expansion ds^2 = -dt^2 + e^{2Ht}[g^(0) + e^{-2Ht} g^(2) + e^{-3Ht} g^(3) + ...].
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: g^(2) is determined locally by g^(0); the free data are (conformal class of g^(0), g^(3)) subject to trace-free and divergence-free constraints — 2 + 2 transverse-traceless functions, exactly the graviton's phase-space count. Friedrich's asymptotic characterization shows the data determine a unique development, and Friedrich (1986) shows de Sitter data are nonlinearly stable, so for data in the stability basin the bulk-to-boundary map is a bijection. Cosmic no-hair therefore destroys no information at all: it relocates it to I^+ and out of every comoving observer's causal diamond. This is the single most important correction to the naive reading of no-hair.
kernel_elements.contraction: C1. Cosmic no-hair: the expansion-normalized omega-limit map (Wald contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Discrete/topological data: the Bianchi type (the isomorphism class of the homogeneity Lie algebra), the spatial topology, and the sign of the curvature index K.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: By uniqueness of the maximal Cauchy development, the isometry group of initial data is an isometry group of the development — evolution cannot change the symmetry type. K enters the Friedmann equation as a constant of integration multiplying a^{-2}, so sign(K) is a flow invariant even as Omega_k -> 0. The contraction drives the curvature CONTRIBUTION to zero while leaving the curvature LABEL untouched; this is a clean instance of the flow erasing a magnitude but not a superselection-type datum.
kernel_elements.contraction: C1. Cosmic no-hair: the expansion-normalized omega-limit map (Wald contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The choice of basin: whether the de Sitter endpoint is reached at all. Bianchi IX with insufficient Lambda recollapses instead.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Wald's theorem explicitly excludes type IX unless the initial ratio of vacuum energy to maximum 3-curvature exceeds a threshold with positive initial time derivative. So the discrete selection among competing endpoints (de Sitter vs. recollapse to a singularity) is fixed by initial data and is exactly the thing the attractor cannot determine. Every attractor theorem carries this: the basin boundary is undetermined-by-the-flow data.
kernel_elements.contraction: C1. Cosmic no-hair: the expansion-normalized omega-limit map (Wald contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Comoving conserved charges and their ratios: baryon number, B-L below sphaleron decoupling, comoving entropy, and eta = n_b/n_gamma ~= 6e-10 after e+e- annihilation.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Dilution rescales all comoving-conserved densities by the same a^{-3}, so ratios of conserved charges are flow invariants of the expansion. A conserved charge has no decay channel that the expansion could open; the expansion changes only the volume in which it is counted.
kernel_elements.contraction: C1. Cosmic no-hair: the expansion-normalized omega-limit map (Wald contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Super-Hubble inhomogeneity: modes with k/a << H are frozen, not destroyed.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: No-hair is a statement about expansion-normalized local curvature invariants. A super-Hubble curvature perturbation is, in the local frame, a shift of the background, not a gradient; there is no local agent that can damp it (see the C3 kernel). No-hair therefore means 'smooth within the horizon', and the structure it appears to remove is precisely the structure that later re-enters the horizon as the observed CMB and LSS.
kernel_elements.contraction: C1. Cosmic no-hair: the expansion-normalized omega-limit map (Wald contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The potential V(phi) (more generally the whole Lagrangian and field content).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Same argument as for Lambda: the attractor is a flow on states at fixed theory. This is worth stating explicitly because it is the load-bearing limit on what 'inflationary attractor behavior' can be claimed to explain: the attractor makes predictions insensitive to initial conditions, and for exactly that reason it makes them maximally sensitive to (and never derivative of) the choice of V.
kernel_elements.contraction: C2. Inflationary slow-roll attractor: centre-manifold / Hamilton-Jacobi reduction of inflaton phase space

kernel_elements.element: The marginal/slow direction: position along the attractor manifold, i.e. the reparametrization-invariant function epsilon(N) (equivalently the Hamilton-Jacobi function H(phi)) over the ~7-10 e-fold observable window.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The reduction annihilates one of two phase-space functions, not both. The flow is transitive along the slow manifold, so absolute position along it is pure time-translation; what survives is the relation between the attractor's local slope and the e-fold clock. This is the kernel that is actually measured: n_s - 1 = -6 epsilon + 2 eta and r = 16 epsilon are readings of the slow direction, not of the erased fast one.
kernel_elements.contraction: C2. Inflationary slow-roll attractor: centre-manifold / Hamilton-Jacobi reduction of inflaton phase space

kernel_elements.element: The DEVIATION from the fixed point is itself the observable: n_s - 1 = -0.035 +/- 0.004 measures the rate at which the contraction is proceeding, and r < 0.036 bounds it further.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Exact de Sitter is the fully contracted case and yields exactly scale-invariant, unmeasurably-tilted spectra. A contraction cannot erase its own approach rate, because the approach rate is what converts the transient into permanent frozen data at horizon exit: P_zeta(k) inherits its k-dependence from the fact that H and epsilon are still running when mode k exits. The brief records near-but-not-exact scale invariance as OBSERVED; structurally this is the measured distance from the fixed point.
kernel_elements.contraction: C2. Inflationary slow-roll attractor: centre-manifold / Hamilton-Jacobi reduction of inflaton phase space

kernel_elements.element: The basin boundary: ultra-slow-roll / non-attractor phases. On a plateau or inflection where V' -> 0, the solution phidot ~ a^{-3} is the ONLY solution, the would-be decaying mode becomes the growing one, zeta grows outside the horizon, and the single-field consistency relation is violated (f_NL^sq = 5/2 instead of 5(1-n_s)/12).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The contraction has a basin, and on the basin boundary it does not act. This is not a pathological corner: it is the regime used for primordial-black-hole production and it is exactly where the data the attractor would have erased is retained and becomes observable through a large, qualitatively different squeezed-limit bispectrum. The existence and location of the boundary is determined by V, not by the flow.
kernel_elements.contraction: C2. Inflationary slow-roll attractor: centre-manifold / Hamilton-Jacobi reduction of inflaton phase space

kernel_elements.element: The quantum-diffusion floor: the classical attractor cannot compress the field distribution below the de Sitter fluctuation scale. The stochastic (Fokker-Planck) flow has a stationary distribution P_eq(phi) ~ exp(-8 pi^2 V(phi)/(3 H^4)) = exp(-V * V_horizon / T_dS) with T_dS = H/2pi, giving <phi^2> = 3H^4/(8 pi^2 m^2) for a free field with m << H.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The omega-limit of the stochastic flow is a DISTRIBUTION of finite width, not a point: deterministic drift toward the attractor is balanced by the H/2pi per e-fold noise from modes crossing the coarse-graining scale. Where drift is weaker than diffusion (the eternal-inflation regime) the contraction fails to act at all. So the attractor's compression is bounded below by a scale set by H, which is itself theory/state data.
kernel_elements.contraction: C2. Inflationary slow-roll attractor: centre-manifold / Hamilton-Jacobi reduction of inflaton phase space

kernel_elements.element: Light orthogonal (isocurvature) field directions in multi-field models: the number of fields with effective mass below ~(3/2)H is not reduced by the attractor.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The centre-manifold reduction damps only directions whose effective mass exceeds the Hubble friction scale; a direction with m_eff << H is itself slow and is not transverse to the attractor. The reduction to a 1-dimensional manifold is a single-field statement, and the multi-field count survives as genuinely undetermined-by-the-flow data, later re-expressed as isocurvature and as super-horizon evolution of zeta.
kernel_elements.contraction: C2. Inflationary slow-roll attractor: centre-manifold / Hamilton-Jacobi reduction of inflaton phase space

kernel_elements.element: Whether the basin is entered at all: sufficient initial homogeneity over a Hubble patch, and sufficient field-space room, are preconditions the attractor does not supply.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: An attractor theorem is conditional on initial data lying in the basin; it cannot be used to argue that the basin is generic without an independent measure. Combined with the fact that all of C1-C8 act only toward the future, this is why the brief's open problem 'origin of the low-entropy initial condition' is not addressed by any contraction in this domain: a many-to-one forward map makes postdiction of the initial state strictly impossible, which is the opposite of an explanation.
kernel_elements.contraction: C2. Inflationary slow-roll attractor: centre-manifold / Hamilton-Jacobi reduction of inflaton phase space

kernel_elements.element: zeta_k, the curvature perturbation on uniform-density slices, is conserved on super-horizon scales whenever the non-adiabatic pressure perturbation is negligible — and this follows from local energy-momentum conservation ALONE, independent of the gravitational field equations.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Wands, Malik, Lyth & Liddle (PRD 62, 043527, 2000) derive zetadot = -(H/(rho+p)) delta p_nad + O(k^2) from nabla_mu T^{mu nu} = 0 without using Einstein's equations. So the kernel of the freezing contraction is robust not only against changes of initial data but against changes of the gravity theory — an unusually strong protection. The stated condition (adiabaticity) is exactly the condition the brief records as observationally consistent but not derived, so the theorem's hypothesis is the empirical question.
kernel_elements.contraction: C3. Horizon exit: the gradient-expansion projection k/(aH) -> 0 onto the frozen adiabatic mode (separate-universe contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The residual large gauge symmetry of which zeta is the Goldstone mode: in the k -> 0 limit, constant zeta is the spatial dilatation x -> e^{zeta} x.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A gauge parameter has no dynamics to erase. This is the symmetry-based reason behind the energy-conservation proof above: the long-wavelength adiabatic mode is locally indistinguishable from a coordinate rescaling of the background, and Weinberg's adiabatic-mode argument guarantees that such a solution exists for k -> 0 in any theory obeying the relevant conditions, whatever the matter content. The brief's phrase 'the dilatation bridge' names exactly this structure.
kernel_elements.contraction: C3. Horizon exit: the gradient-expansion projection k/(aH) -> 0 onto the frozen adiabatic mode (separate-universe contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Maldacena's squeezed-limit consistency relation: lim_{k_L -> 0} <zeta_{k_L} zeta_{k1} zeta_{k2}>' = -(n_s - 1) P(k_L) P(k_1), i.e. f_NL^sq = 5(1 - n_s)/12.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: It is a Ward identity for the nonlinearly realized dilatation, not a perturbative result: it holds to all orders in slow roll for any single-field attractor model, so it is protected in the same way a non-renormalization theorem is. The freezing contraction cannot erase it because the contraction is the very thing that makes the long mode a pure rescaling. Its one failure mode is the failure of the attractor assumption (the ultra-slow-roll kernel element above) — so the relation is simultaneously a kernel element and a sharp test of which regime obtains.
kernel_elements.contraction: C3. Horizon exit: the gradient-expansion projection k/(aH) -> 0 onto the frozen adiabatic mode (separate-universe contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Non-adiabatic (entropy/isocurvature) perturbations are not annihilated by the projection: they source zetadot on super-horizon scales.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The same exact equation that gives the conservation theorem, zetadot = -(H/(rho+p)) delta p_nad + O(k^2), shows that the O(k^2) term is what the contraction kills and the delta p_nad term is what it leaves untouched. The projection is therefore kernel-preserving precisely on the isocurvature sector, which is why multi-field information can survive horizon exit and keep evolving for many e-folds.
kernel_elements.contraction: C3. Horizon exit: the gradient-expansion projection k/(aH) -> 0 onto the frozen adiabatic mode (separate-universe contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Tensor modes h^TT_ij freeze identically and record the inflationary energy scale directly: P_T = 2H^2/(pi^2 M_p^2), V^{1/4} ~= 1.06e16 GeV (r/0.01)^{1/4}, with the single-field relation n_t = -r/8.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The transverse-traceless sector has no source at linear order and no local process outside the horizon that can act on it; it is the cleanest possible frozen boundary datum. Its protection is the same causal argument as for zeta plus the fact that TT is a representation-theoretic (spin-2, parity-odd-and-even) sector that scalar dynamics cannot mix into at linear order. The brief's r_0.05 < 0.036 is a bound on this kernel element, and it is the sharpest surviving handle on the epoch the brief records as 'not established'.
kernel_elements.contraction: C3. Horizon exit: the gradient-expansion projection k/(aH) -> 0 onto the frozen adiabatic mode (separate-universe contraction)

kernel_elements.element: Unitarity/symplectic invariance: the freezing is a Bogoliubov squeezing transformation, and the phase-space area of the Wigner function (equivalently the symplectic eigenvalues of the covariance matrix, equivalently the purity) is exactly conserved. The squeezing parameter r_k and squeezing angle retain the full information.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Linear evolution of a Gaussian state is a symplectic map on phase space; Liouville's theorem forbids any change in the invariant area. The decaying direction is exponentially squeezed, not destroyed. So the 'classicalization' of primordial perturbations is an ACCESSIBILITY statement (decoherence without decoherence), not an erasure: the information is stored in an exponentially thin, exponentially long phase-space ellipse that no realistic measurement resolves. Naming this precisely matters, because it separates what the mathematics erases (nothing) from what observation erases (everything about the decaying direction).
kernel_elements.contraction: C3. Horizon exit: the gradient-expansion projection k/(aH) -> 0 onto the frozen adiabatic mode (separate-universe contraction)

kernel_elements.element: The growing-mode amplitude, i.e. the transfer-function image T(k) zeta_k of the primordial datum.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The projection annihilates one direction and is exactly the identity on the other. Above the damping scale the linear transfer map is deterministic and invertible, which is why reconstruction of the primordial field from late-time data is possible in practice (BAO reconstruction is this inversion applied to displacements). The contraction moves information within the two-dimensional solution space; it does not act on the surviving direction at all.
kernel_elements.contraction: C4. Growing-mode projection in post-inflationary linear evolution

kernel_elements.element: The shape of P(k): in matter domination the growth factor D_+(a) is scale-independent, so the flow can change the amplitude of the power spectrum but not its k-dependence.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: delta_k(a) = D_+(a) T(k) zeta_k with D_+ independent of k for pressureless matter on sub-horizon, super-damping scales. A k-independent multiplicative map cannot alter a shape. The shape is therefore a kernel of the growth contraction, and it is what carries the k_eq feature, the tilt, and the baryon wiggles into the late universe.
kernel_elements.contraction: C4. Growing-mode projection in post-inflationary linear evolution

kernel_elements.element: The decaying mode is not independent data: D_-(a) ~ H(a) EXACTLY for pressureless matter (with D_+ = H int da/(aH)^3, and in LCDM D_- ~ a^{-3/2} sqrt(1 + (Omega_L/Omega_m) a^3)).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The second solution of the growth equation is fixed by the background expansion history, so the contraction erases only a single amplitude, never a functional form. This sharpens what 'decaying mode erasure' costs: one number per mode, not one function per mode. It also means the decaying mode carries no information not already in H(a), so its loss is genuinely one-dimensional.
kernel_elements.contraction: C4. Growing-mode projection in post-inflationary linear evolution

kernel_elements.element: The BAO standard ruler r_s(z_drag): a comoving length imprinted once, thereafter only advected.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A fixed comoving scale is invariant under a scale-independent growth factor (previous element) and is shifted by nonlinear evolution only at the sub-percent level, calculably and reversibly by reconstruction. It is thus a length-scale kernel that survives both the linear growing-mode projection and the nonlinear phase-mixing contraction — which is precisely why the brief can list BAO as a derived object measured across 0.1 < z < 4.2 and still treat it as a clean ruler.
kernel_elements.contraction: C4. Growing-mode projection in post-inflationary linear evolution

kernel_elements.element: Compensated isocurvature and baryon-CDM relative modes: directions the growing-mode projection barely touches.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A compensated mode carries no net density perturbation and hence sources no gravitational potential at leading order, so gravitational instability neither grows nor damps it; it is a nearly frozen, nearly unconstrained direction in the initial-data space. It is a clean example of a mode that is undetermined by the flow in both directions: the contraction cannot erase it, and it also cannot amplify it into visibility.
kernel_elements.contraction: C4. Growing-mode projection in post-inflationary linear evolution

kernel_elements.element: The fixed point's coordinates are theory data: Lambda for the de Sitter attractor, and Omega_phi = 3(1+w_m)/lambda^2 for the exponential scaling/tracker attractor.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A tracker attractor makes the late-time state independent of initial conditions precisely by making it a function of the potential's slope. The contraction's whole content is to trade state information for theory information; it cannot then also determine the theory information. This is the structural reason the brief's 'why is Lambda small, nonzero, and comparable to rho_m now' cannot be answered by any late-time attractor argument.
kernel_elements.contraction: C5. Late-time attractors of the Friedmann system (de Sitter fixed point; scaling/tracker fixed points)

kernel_elements.element: The sign of Lambda and hence which endpoint class obtains (de Sitter expansion vs. recollapse for Lambda < 0 vs. marginal coasting for Lambda = 0).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A discrete superselection among qualitatively distinct endpoints, fixed by the data and not reachable by the flow, which is continuous and preserves the sign of the constant term in the Friedmann equation. Same structure as the Bianchi-IX basin element under C1.
kernel_elements.contraction: C5. Late-time attractors of the Friedmann system (de Sitter fixed point; scaling/tracker fixed points)

kernel_elements.element: The record on the past light cone: H(z), D_A(z), D_L(z) over 0 < z < 4 and back to z ~ 1100.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The attractor acts on the state, not on the record. Because observation in cosmology is intrinsically a look backwards along a null cone, the ratio Omega_m/Omega_Lambda that the contraction erases asymptotically is directly measured at a continuum of earlier times. This is the precise sense in which the 'coincidence problem' is a problem about the state and not about our epistemic access — and also the reason the brief's evolving-w hint (DESI, 2.6-3.9 sigma within w0-wa) is testable at all.
kernel_elements.contraction: C5. Late-time attractors of the Friedmann system (de Sitter fixed point; scaling/tracker fixed points)

kernel_elements.element: One-sidedness of a single canonical scalar with respect to the phantom divide: w >= -1 strictly for a standard kinetic term, so crossing w = -1 requires extra degrees of freedom or a non-canonical/ghost-like kinetic sector.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The sign is fixed by the kinetic-term structure, w = (phidot^2/2 - V)/(phidot^2/2 + V) >= -1, independently of the trajectory; a continuous flow cannot move a solution across a boundary that the Lagrangian forbids it to reach. Vikman (PRD 71, 023515, 2005) makes this a statement about the impossibility (or instability) of the crossing for single-field dark energy. I state this in its community form only; I did not use the brief's in-house PROGRAM-RESULT version of the same claim.
kernel_elements.contraction: C5. Late-time attractors of the Friedmann system (de Sitter fixed point; scaling/tracker fixed points)

kernel_elements.element: Conserved charges survive annihilation: the asymmetric component sets a floor that no amount of annihilation can remove. eta_B ~ 6e-10 survives precisely because B (and B-L) is conserved below sphaleron decoupling, while the symmetric baryon component is annihilated away.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The collision term for annihilation is proportional to (Y^2 - Y_eq^2) in the symmetric sector and annihilates nothing in a conserved-charge sector; a conserved charge is by definition a null direction of the collision operator. This is the single sharpest 'what the contraction cannot erase' in early-universe thermal physics, and it is why the brief can record eta as a one-number cosmological input rather than as a function of unknown initial conditions.
kernel_elements.contraction: C6. Thermal and kinetic freeze-out: the Boltzmann relic attractor (BBN, WIMP freeze-out, recombination, blackbody thermalization)

kernel_elements.element: The microphysics: relic abundances depend only on cross-sections, g_*, masses, and the freeze-out condition Gamma ~ H — i.e. exactly the data the initial state does not contain.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Same trade as in C5: the attractor buys initial-condition independence by making the output a function of the Lagrangian. Structurally this is why BBN is a test rather than a fit: the brief's own framing — abundances from measured nuclear cross-sections plus ONE cosmological input — is a statement that the fiber of the contraction is enormous and its image is one-dimensional, so a hit is informative.
kernel_elements.contraction: C6. Thermal and kinetic freeze-out: the Boltzmann relic attractor (BBN, WIMP freeze-out, recombination, blackbody thermalization)

kernel_elements.element: The surviving one-dimensional image of BBN (eta, equivalently omega_b) and its independent CMB determination: (D/H)_P = (2.527 +/- 0.030)e-5 agreeing with Planck.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Because the contraction leaves exactly one number to be matched, the agreement is a genuine PREDICTION-grade coincidence that could have failed. The kernel element here is not a quantity that resists the flow but the DIMENSIONALITY of what survives — one number, measured twice by causally and physically disjoint routes. The residual lithium discrepancy is the honest caveat: the image is one-dimensional in eta but the abundance vector has more components than eta can control.
kernel_elements.contraction: C6. Thermal and kinetic freeze-out: the Boltzmann relic attractor (BBN, WIMP freeze-out, recombination, blackbody thermalization)

kernel_elements.element: N_eff, the relativistic energy density at freeze-out, is recorded in the expansion rate and thereby in both Y_p and the CMB damping tail.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Freeze-out is defined by Gamma(T) = H(T), so the freeze-out point is a direct readout of H at that epoch, hence of the total relativistic content. The contraction that erases abundances simultaneously writes the expansion rate into the frozen values. What the flow destroys in one variable it stamps into another.
kernel_elements.contraction: C6. Thermal and kinetic freeze-out: the Boltzmann relic attractor (BBN, WIMP freeze-out, recombination, blackbody thermalization)

kernel_elements.element: Spectral distortions: the energy dissipated by Silk damping is conserved and reappears in the CMB spectrum as mu and y distortions. LCDM predicts mu_ac ~= 2e-8 (2.3e-8 acoustic, with -0.3e-8 from adiabatic cooling); FIRAS bounds |mu| < 9e-5, |y| < 1.5e-5.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Energy conservation. The damping contraction destroys the mode-by-mode phase and amplitude information in 50 Mpc^-1 < k < 1e4 Mpc^-1, but it cannot destroy the energy, and after double-Compton and bremsstrahlung freeze out (z < 2e6) the photon field can no longer restore a pure blackbody. So an integrated image of the erased power is permanently stored in a DIFFERENT observable. This is the sharpest example in the domain of a contraction whose kernel lives outside the variable being contracted, and the brief's own FIRAS entry is the bound on it.
kernel_elements.contraction: C7. Dissipative mode destruction: Silk (photon-diffusion) damping and neutrino/warm free-streaming

kernel_elements.element: The damping scale k_D itself, and the low-k sector k << k_D which the contraction does not touch at all.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The map is exp(-k^2/k_D^2): it is k-graded, exactly the identity as k -> 0, and it carries its own parameter. Measuring the damping tail measures k_D, i.e. the integral over the Thomson mean free path, which is an independent constraint on omega_b and N_eff. The contraction records the measure of its own action.
