kernel_elements.contraction: C7. Dissipative mode destruction: Silk (photon-diffusion) damping and neutrino/warm free-streaming

kernel_elements.element: The neutrino-induced BAO phase shift: free-streaming neutrinos propagate supersonically relative to the photon-baryon sound horizon and induce a shift in the acoustic peak POSITIONS, not merely a suppression of amplitude.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A phase is not degenerate with an amplitude rescaling; the free-streaming contraction acts multiplicatively on amplitudes but the supersonic propagation leaves a distinct, calculable positional residue (Bashinsky-Seljak; detected in Planck-era data). So the damping/free-streaming contraction cannot erase the fact that a free-streaming component was present.
kernel_elements.contraction: C7. Dissipative mode destruction: Silk (photon-diffusion) damping and neutrino/warm free-streaming

kernel_elements.element: Fine-grained phase-space density is exactly conserved (Liouville), and the coarse-grained distribution can never exceed the fine-grained maximum: fbar <= max f.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The coarse-grained f is an average of fine-grained values, hence bounded by their supremum; more strongly, the Tremaine-Henon-Lynden-Bell H-functions are monotone under mixing. This is a genuine theorem-grade constraint that survives arbitrarily violent nonlinear evolution, and it is the basis of the Tremaine-Gunn bound on light fermionic dark matter — a permanent statement about initial conditions derived from data AFTER the contraction has fully acted.
kernel_elements.contraction: C8. Nonlinear phase mixing and violent relaxation: coarse-graining of the Vlasov-Poisson flow

kernel_elements.element: Total mass, energy and angular momentum of an isolated collapsing region; and the total mass in any Lagrangian volume.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Mixing redistributes but does not create or destroy the conserved integrals of the Vlasov-Poisson system. These are the quantities that virial and halo-mass-function descriptions are built on, and they are exactly why a statistical description of the nonlinear regime is possible at all once the detailed map is gone.
kernel_elements.contraction: C8. Nonlinear phase mixing and violent relaxation: coarse-graining of the Vlasov-Poisson flow

kernel_elements.element: Large-scale modes are protected from long-wavelength displacements: a uniform large-scale flow cannot affect local clustering, so equal-time correlators are IR-safe (the LSS consistency relations / Galilean invariance of the Newtonian equations).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A long-wavelength mode acts on a small region as a uniform acceleration, removable by going to a free-falling frame; by the equivalence principle it cannot alter equal-time local statistics. This is the late-time descendant of the C3 dilatation kernel, and it is what allows the k < ~0.1 h/Mpc sector to remain a clean linear record after nonlinearity has destroyed the small scales.
kernel_elements.contraction: C8. Nonlinear phase mixing and violent relaxation: coarse-graining of the Vlasov-Poisson flow

kernel_elements.element: The universality-class label plus two numbers: for alpha-attractors, the pole structure of the kinetic term (Kahler curvature -2/(3alpha)) and the e-fold number, giving n_s = 1 - 2/N and r = 12 alpha/N^2.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The contraction collapses an infinite-dimensional space of potentials onto a finite-dimensional image, but the image is not a point: what survives is a discrete class label (set by the SINGULARITY structure of the kinetic term, a topological-type datum, not by the potential's shape) plus the continuous modulus alpha and the clock N. Discrete class data of this kind is the characteristic residue of a universality contraction, exactly as in critical phenomena.
kernel_elements.contraction: C9. Model-space contraction on inflationary Lagrangians: V |-> (n_s, r, alpha_s) at fixed N

kernel_elements.element: The inflationary energy scale: r fixes V^{1/4} ~= 1.06e16 GeV (r/0.01)^{1/4}, and degeneracy among potentials within a class does not degrade it.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: r is a ratio of two independently frozen spectra (tensor and scalar), and tensors couple only to H. No reshaping of V within a universality class changes H at horizon exit without changing r. So the energy scale is a kernel element of the model-space contraction, and the brief's r_0.05 < 0.036 is a one-sided determination of it.
kernel_elements.contraction: C9. Model-space contraction on inflationary Lagrangians: V |-> (n_s, r, alpha_s) at fixed N

kernel_elements.element: Relations rather than parameters: the single-field consistency condition n_t = -r/8, and the squeezed-limit relation f_NL^sq = 5(1-n_s)/12.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: A degeneracy among potentials moves a model along the image manifold but cannot move it off a relation that holds identically across the entire class. Relations are therefore the correct observables to target when a contraction has made individual parameters degenerate — they separate classes (single-field vs. multi-field vs. non-attractor) rather than members within a class.
kernel_elements.contraction: C9. Model-space contraction on inflationary Lagrangians: V |-> (n_s, r, alpha_s) at fixed N

kernel_elements.element: Reheating leaks back in through N: the pivot's e-fold number depends on the post-inflationary expansion history, so the contraction to (n_s, r) leaves a reheating-dependent residue.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: N is not a free parameter but is fixed by matching the pivot scale to today through the full expansion history, so a class prediction n_s = 1 - 2/N is implicitly a joint statement about inflation AND reheating. The contraction cannot decouple them; it can only hide the dependence inside a single number.
kernel_elements.contraction: C9. Model-space contraction on inflationary Lagrangians: V |-> (n_s, r, alpha_s) at fixed N

kernel_elements.element: Lambda_eff itself: the one linear combination the degeneracy map does not annihilate.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: For a linear map with a one-dimensional kernel, the quotient is exactly one-dimensional and is measured. The reason this matters is directional: because the kernel direction (delta Lambda_bare, delta rho_vac) = (-8 pi G c, c) is EXACTLY flat, no low-energy observation whatsoever can fix the split, which is why the ~120-order-of-magnitude vacuum-energy mismatch cannot be reduced to a measurement problem. Any resolution must come from outside the map — from a UV completion or from a mechanism that makes the split dynamical (and hence detectable through its dynamics).
kernel_elements.contraction: C10. Background and parameter degeneracies: (Lambda_bare, rho_vac) |-> Lambda_eff, and (Omega_k, Omega_Lambda, H_0) |-> theta_*

kernel_elements.element: The acoustic angle theta_* = r_s(z_*)/D_A(z_*), measured to ~0.03%, and the physical densities omega_b and omega_c.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: These are exactly the invariants of the geometric degeneracy: the degeneracy direction is defined as the one along which they do not move. So the CMB's tightest constraints are the kernel of its own worst degeneracy. Practically this reframes the brief's 5-sigma H0 tension: what is measured is a ratio, so the tension constrains the product of pre-recombination physics (which sets r_s) and post-recombination expansion (which sets D_A), and a resolution can hide in either factor but not in H_0 alone.
kernel_elements.contraction: C10. Background and parameter degeneracies: (Lambda_bare, rho_vac) |-> Lambda_eff, and (Omega_k, Omega_Lambda, H_0) |-> theta_*

kernel_elements.element: Degeneracy-breaking channels that the background map does not control: late-time ISW, CMB lensing, and external low-z data.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: The geometric degeneracy is a degeneracy of the PRIMARY anisotropies only. ISW and lensing are sourced by the time-dependence and depth of potentials along the line of sight, quantities that are not functions of theta_* alone; they therefore break the degeneracy by construction. A degeneracy that is exact at one order in the observable map is generally not exact at the next.
kernel_elements.contraction: C10. Background and parameter degeneracies: (Lambda_bare, rho_vac) |-> Lambda_eff, and (Omega_k, Omega_Lambda, H_0) |-> theta_*

kernel_elements.element: The rotationally invariant content C_l is estimable without bias from one sky, with an irreducible variance 2 C_l^2/(2l+1).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: Statistical isotropy makes the a_lm at fixed l an ensemble of 2l+1 independent samples, so the invariant is measurable; but the sample size is fixed by geometry, not by effort. The floor is a theorem, not a technological limitation, and it means the contraction's kernel at low l is intrinsically fuzzy — which caps how sharply any large-scale anomaly can ever be assessed.
kernel_elements.contraction: C11. Observational contraction: one realization, one past light cone, statistical isotropy

kernel_elements.element: The E/B decomposition of CMB polarization: scalar perturbations generate no B modes at linear order.
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: E and B are the parity-even and parity-odd pieces of a spin-2 field on the sphere; a scalar (spin-0) source cannot produce the parity-odd piece at linear order. This is a representation-theoretic superselection, not a dynamical suppression, so the line-of-sight projection — which destroys most radial information — cannot mix the tensor signal into the far larger scalar one. It is the reason a primordial tensor search remains possible at all after everything else has been contracted away.
kernel_elements.contraction: C11. Observational contraction: one realization, one past light cone, statistical isotropy

kernel_elements.element: Monopole quantities, which carry no cosmic variance: T_CMB = 2.72548 +/- 0.00057 K, and the blackbody form itself (FIRAS: RMS deviations < 50 ppm of peak).
kernel_elements.why_not_erased: There is only one monopole and we measure it; the sample-variance argument that limits C_l has no analogue at l = 0. The blackbody form is additionally protected as the fixed point of the thermalization contraction (C6), so it is doubly held: dynamically attracted to, and observationally unambiguous.
kernel_elements.contraction: C11. Observational contraction: one realization, one past light cone, statistical isotropy

things_erased_completely: Initial shear/anisotropy: the magnitude and principal axes of sigma_ij at the start of inflation. Suppressed by a^{-3}; after 60 e-folds the factor is e^{-180}. Not recoverable by any measurement.
Pre-inflationary spatial curvature magnitude: |Omega - 1| decays as e^{-2N}, so after 60 e-folds it is ~1e-52. Only the formal label sign(K) survives, and it becomes operationally undecidable.

The inflaton's initial kinetic energy phidot_0 and the entire transverse (fast) phase-space coordinate: rho_kin ~ a^{-6} erases it within about one e-fold. Nothing about how inflation was entered survives the attractor.
The shape of V(phi) outside the ~7-10 e-fold observable window, and the shape of V between that window and the end of inflation beyond what the single number N encodes.
The total number of e-folds N_total (as opposed to N since pivot exit): flatness and isotropy observables saturate, so N_total is unbounded above and unmeasurable.

The decaying-mode amplitude of every super-horizon perturbation, zeta ~ int dt/(a^3 epsilon) — one of the two functions of initial data per mode per polarization. This is why the primordial condition is a single power spectrum rather than two functions.

The post-inflationary decaying growth mode D_- ~ H(a): suppressed by a^{-5/2} relative to D_+, i.e. by >12 orders of magnitude across matter domination. Equivalently, any initial peculiar-velocity field not slaved to the density field.

Operationally (though not unitarily — see the symplectic-invariance kernel element): the quantum-vs-classical distinction for super-horizon modes. The squeezed state's residual phase information is unmeasurable, so the primordial field is indistinguishable from a classical stochastic realization.

Pre-freeze-out abundances in every thermal sector: the initial dark-matter abundance, the pre-BBN nuclear composition, the pre-z~2e6 photon spectrum. Each is attracted to equilibrium and then frozen at a value depending only on rates.

The symmetric (particle-antiparticle) component of any annihilating species. Only the conserved-charge component survives, which is why an asymmetry — and not an initial abundance — sets the relic floor.

Essentially all information about the pre-BBN universe not stored in (a) a conserved charge, (b) a frozen relic abundance, (c) a frozen spectral distortion, or (d) a super-horizon mode. This is the structural content of the brief's 'the pre-BBN universe is not directly probed'.

Acoustic power at k >> k_D (Silk damping, exp(-k^2/k_D^2)) and small-scale power above the free-streaming scale. In the mu-era window (~50 to ~1e4 Mpc^-1) the mode-by-mode phase and amplitude are destroyed outright; only the integrated energy survives, as mu ~ 2e-8.

Fine-grained phase-space filamentation inside virialized structures at the coarse-grained level, and the one-to-one Lagrangian-to-Eulerian correspondence on scales that have gone nonlinear (k > ~0.1-0.5 h/Mpc at z=0). Shell crossing makes the Zel'dovich map non-injective.
The split of the measured Lambda_eff into a geometric constant and a vacuum-energy contribution: an exactly flat degeneracy direction, unreachable by any background or linear-perturbation observable.
The individual potential within an inflationary universality class, and (from primary CMB alone) the individual values of H_0, Omega_Lambda and Omega_k along the geometric-degeneracy direction.

The unobserved realization: modes with k < H_0, the spacetime outside our past light cone, and radial structure through the last-scattering surface beyond what the projection integrals, ISW, lensing and polarization retain.

THE ASYMMETRY THAT MATTERS MOST: every contraction in this list acts only toward the future. None of them constrains, supplies, or explains the initial condition — a many-to-one forward map makes postdiction of initial data strictly impossible. So the brief's open problem 'origin of the low-entropy initial condition' is not merely unaddressed by attractor behavior; attractor behavior is the specific reason it cannot be addressed from within the flow.
kernels.method_note:
SELECTION. I required a candidate to be a genuinely many-to-one map, then asked in each case WHERE the non-invertibility actually lives — because the underlying Einstein + Boltzmann + Vlasov dynamics is deterministic and (except for the collision terms) time-reversible, so a naive reading would find no contraction at all. Every entry in the list is non-invertible for exactly one of five identifiable reasons, and I state which: (i) passage to the omega-limit t -> infinity in expansion-normalized variables, where each finite-time flow map is a diffeomorphism but the limit map is many-to-one (C1, C2, C5); (ii) restriction to a comoving observer's causal diamond, a genuine projection of the data (C1, and the operational half of C3); (iii) truncation of the gradient expansion k/(aH) -> 0, forced by causality rather than chosen (C3, C4); (iv) genuine entropy-producing dissipation or coarse-graining (C6, C7, C8); (v) maps on theory/parameter space rather than state space, non-invertible independent of any dynamics (C9, C10) plus the measurement map itself (C11). I included C6-C8 and C9-C11 although the task's named list (inflationary attractor, no-hair, growing/decaying modes, horizon crossing, late-time attractors) does not mention them, because they are the domain's only IRREVERSIBLE contractions (C6-C8) and its only theory-space ones (C9-C11), and the task explicitly asks about theories becoming identical. I flag the addition rather than smuggling it in.

I deliberately separated two things that are usually conflated: what the mathematics erases and what observation erases. Cosmic no-hair and super-horizon freezing erase nothing in the first sense (asymptotic data at I^+ is complete; squeezing is symplectic) and nearly everything in the second. Several kernel elements exist only because of that distinction, and I would regard collapsing it as the main way this classification could be got wrong.

BRIEF INFLUENCE ON THE KERNEL LIST. Five specific items steered it. (1) 'Primordial perturbations are consistent with ... adiabaticity' recorded as a consistency statement, not a derivation, made me state adiabaticity as the explicit hypothesis of the zeta-conservation theorem and list the non-adiabatic sector as a kernel element rather than assuming it away. (2) The phrase 'the dilatation bridge' in the separate-universe entry pointed me to give the symmetry-based (Goldstone/large-gauge) protection of zeta alongside the energy-conservation proof, and to include the Maldacena consistency relation as a non-renormalization-type kernel element. (3) The FIRAS bounds (|mu| < 9e-5, |y| < 1.5e-5) in the observables entry are what prompted the Silk-damping/mu-distortion kernel element — the cleanest case in the domain of a contraction whose kernel lives in a different observable. (4) The Lambda entries ('input everywhere, derived nowhere'; the 120-order mismatch; 'indistinguishable at the background-cosmology level') produced both the 'the fixed point's location is theory data' motif running through C1/C2/C5/C6 and the C10 entry, where the degeneracy has a literal linear-algebra kernel. (5) The open problem 'origin of the low-entropy initial condition' sharpened the final entry in the erasure list: forward-only contraction is precisely what makes that problem unreachable from inside the flow.

PROVENANCE HANDLING. The brief carries two PROGRAM-RESULT entries (the mu = 4/3 super-horizon exclusion and the phantom-divide one-sidedness), flagged in-house and unreviewed. I treated both as non-load-bearing and used neither as a physics input. Where their subject matter touched a kernel element — the one-sidedness of a single relaxational channel across w = -1 — I anchored instead on the community result the brief itself cites (Vikman, PRD 71, 023515 (2005)) and graded it STANDARD on that basis alone.

VERIFICATION. I checked externally, rather than from memory: Wald's exclusion of Bianchi IX and its threshold condition; the alpha-attractor formulas n_s = 1 - 2/N, r = 12 alpha/N^2; the exact growth solutions D_- ~ H(a), D_+ ~ H int da/(aH)^3 in LCDM; the LCDM acoustic mu-distortion value (mu_ac ~= 2.3e-8 including the -0.3e-8 adiabatic-cooling term); Friedrich's 1986 nonlinear stability of de Sitter together with the Fefferman-Graham/Starobinsky free data (conformal class of g^(0), TT g^(3)) at spacelike I^+ and their uniqueness property; and that Wands-Malik-Lyth-Liddle (PRD 62, 043527, 2000) derive zeta conservation from energy-momentum conservation alone, independent of the field equations. The Starobinsky-Yokoyama equilibrium exp(-8 pi^2 V/(3H^4)) I could not confirm from full text; I reconstructed it as exp(-V * V_horizon / T_dS) from the two facts the sources did confirm (Maxwell-Boltzmann equilibrium; T_dS = H/2pi) and cross-checked that it returns the standard <phi^2> = 3H^4/(8 pi^2 m^2) — it is graded STANDARD on that basis rather than THEOREM.

GRADING POLICY. THEOREM is reserved for statements with a proof I can name (Wald, Friedrich, Liouville/symplectic invariance, WMLL, Maldacena's Ward identity, the mixing theorem, uniqueness of the Cauchy development, cosmic-variance sampling). STANDARD means textbook or unambiguously established in the literature. PLAUSIBLE would mark my own reasoned judgment; in the end I did not need it — every element I was prepared to assert cleared STANDARD, and anything that did not clear it I dropped rather than downgraded.

comparison.leak_check:
PARTIAL LEAK — blinding held on the two STRIPPED fields, but failed structurally on a third field that carries half the priced inventory. Report in four parts.

(1) STRIPPED FIELDS (empirical_inputs, constants): NO DEMONSTRABLE LEAK. I traced every empirical anchor quoted by the two fully-delivered kernel-computers back to its corpus field. Condensed-matter: alpha_He4 = -0.0127(3) and A+/A- = 1.053(2) -> phenomena/5 and observables/0; the 8.6e-11 graphene-vs-GaAs test -> observables/0; e* = e/3 and phi = pi/3 -> phenomena; "insensitive to the geometry of the device" -> phenomena; Hastings-Michalakis -> derived_objects; Shankar and Gor'kov -> limits; cuprate T_c "underived" -> open_problems. None of these is in empirical_inputs or constants. The string "R_K"/"von Klitzing" lives only in constants and notes, but the computer never cites a constants entry and R_K is universal physics vocabulary; I do not count it. Statistical-relaxation: Carcassi-Aidala "exactly a one-to-one map between past and future states" -> known_connections/2; the verbatim "arrow-of-time REQUIRES boundary condition — INPUT (the past hypothesis), origin UNRESOLVED" -> known_connections/1 (the corpus itself records that it deliberately relocated this verbatim edge out of empirical_inputs/0 into known_connections); Partovi -> known_disconnects; the |Im Sigma_R| / PROGRAM-RESULT sign(beta) material -> known_disconnects; Micadei, Wang, Takeuchi-Sano -> phenomena/observables; white-noise FDT admission gate -> formalism/known_connections; long-time tails -> formalism/limits. Again no stripped-field read is demonstrable.

(2) STRUCTURAL LEAK VIA THE `primitives` FIELD — MATERIAL. The protocol stripped empirical_inputs and constants. It did not strip primitives. 24 of the 48 priced rows are `.../primitives/N` rows. Those rows were therefore present in the blinded briefs VERBATIM, with their declared-input status intact ("is a primitive of the ... description, assumed rather than derived"; "a declared input of the construction, not an output of it"). A kernel-computer reading "X is a declared input, not an output" and then listing X under "what the contraction cannot reach" is transcribing, not computing. This is exactly the failure mode the protocol's leak-check names ("kernel elements that read as a restatement ... rather than as consequences of a contraction's mathematics").

(3) SELF-REPORTED PROPAGATION. The statistical-relaxation computer's own method_note admits it: "BRIEF INFLUENCE ON THE KERNEL LIST. Four specific places. (i) The primitive 'the choice of projection operator ... is a declared input ... not an output of it' put the exogeneity of the fibration on the kernel list as an item in its own right, and I propagated the same structure to the macro-partition and the MaxEnt relevant-list." The quoted sentence IS priced item [33] (nonequilibrium_statistical_mechanics/primitives/1), verbatim. The propagation it describes produced kernel elements that match priced items [32] and [46] as well. INVALIDATED ROWS: [32], [33], [46] are not independent evidence for K-U and I do not count them. PARTIALLY FLAGGED: [13] and [47], where the input-status of the item was visible in unstripped known_connections/known_disconnects even though the empirical_inputs entry itself was removed — so K-U's own pre-registered trap check on the past hypothesis ("fits by construction; suspicious for that very reason") is NOT cleared by this round.

(4) STRONG COUNTER-EVIDENCE THAT BLINDING HELD ON THE SUBSTANCE. The condensed-matter computer placed the single flagship priced item — [4], "band structures, effective masses, Landau parameters, pairing strengths, T_c, gaps", labelled THE stress case — squarely in things_erased_completely, in three separate entries, and added a dedicated kernel element ("Deducibility is not a kernel element") stating that what survives is systematically NOT what a bottom-up calculation can reach. It did the same for [6], the substrate Hamiltonian, another primitives row it could have transcribed. An agent fitting to a hidden priced list would have done the opposite. The CM kernel is a genuine independent computation, and its verdict on [4] is the most load-bearing single result in this round.

(5) ONE FURTHER PROTOCOL DEVIATION, RECORDED NOT RATIONALIZED: the protocol names five brief fields (formalism, phenomena, derived_objects, limits, domain_of_validity). Both delivered computers demonstrably had at least primitives, observables, symmetries, known_connections, known_disconnects, open_problems and alternative_formulations as well. VERDICT: K-U-PARTIAL, held PROVISIONALLY and under-powered. Four things have to be said in order, because the verdict is not the headline.

1. WHY NOT K-U-UNFALSIFIABLE-BOOKKEEPING. The guard's trigger is 'essentially every priced item turns out kernelizable under some contraction, especially if the kernels look chosen rather than forced'. Neither condition is met. Item [4] — the flagship, corpus-labelled THE stress case — is placed in things_erased_completely by a blinded computer that had the leak channel open and used it against K-U anyway; [6] and [22] go the same way. And the contractions are demonstrably forced, not chosen: they were motivated from each domain's own physics by agents with no sight of the priced list, and both computers volunteered erased-columns that cut against the claim. The bookkeeping diagnosis is not earned. BUT the guard's mechanism was nonetheless CAUGHT OPERATING, in a form the pre-registration did not anticipate: not chosen contractions, but an elastic definition of 'kernel'. See 4.

2. WHY NOT K-U-FAILS. A real, forced class survives. Five sub-classes of priced input are kernel elements on independent contraction mathematics, with no leak assistance: (i) INDUCED-RESIDUE coefficients — the finite list a contraction converts an infinite-dimensional microdynamics into: transport coefficients, the equation of state, constitutive/linear-response functions [30], [0]; (ii) QUANTIZED TOPOLOGICAL invariants that make a priced constant material-independent — R_K's exactness via the Chern index [5]; (iii) SELECTION among the contraction's own fixed points or extremal states — which phase [7], produced independently by two computers in different description groups with different mathematics, the strongest single piece of evidence in the round; (iv) ASYMPTOTIC LABELS the limit creates and cannot erase — KMS beta [23], the low-frequency class of J(omega) [34, partial]; (v) BOUNDARY/STATE data the flow's time-reversal equivariance provably cannot orient — the direction of relaxation [31], [47]. That is a genuine mechanism for a genuine part of the law/state boundary.

3. WHY NOT K-U-STRONG, AND WHERE THE BOUNDARY FALLS. Five hard limits. (a) K-U's OWN five first-instance checks are all either refuted, unverified or contaminated: condensed matter ('fits, corpus-verified') is REFUTED by the blinded CM kernel — the priced per-material inputs are the erased non-universal data, not the relevant couplings; decoherence ('fits, strikingly') is UNVERIFIED, its kernel truncated to a contraction name; cosmology ('plausible, to be typed') is UNTYPED; flavor ('fits negatively') has its premise contradicted by the corpus's own formalism/2; the past hypothesis ('fits by construction; flagged as K-U's own possible vocabulary trap') had its input-status visible in the unstripped brief, so the trap is NOT cleared. (b) The kernel-to-priced direction fails badly: ~85 delivered kernel elements, at most 8 priced matches, 3 of those invalidated. Coincidence is false. (c) Three priced items are adjudicated NOT kernel against delivered kernels, one is half-kernel. (d) Descriptions with no contraction ([25], [26], [27], [2]) satisfy K-U vacuously, since an absent contraction has kernel = everything — formal fit, zero content. (e) Coverage: only 12 of 48 rows sit in a description group whose kernel was delivered; 17 rows are in corpus domains the six-group partition never assigned to anyone; 4 of 6 kernels never reached the comparator.

4. THE EXACT CLASS K-U EXPLAINS, AND THE EXACT LINE. K-U explains priced inputs that are ASYMPTOTIC, SELECTION, OR RESIDUE data of a description that genuinely sits downstream of a contraction — categories (i)-(v) in 2. It does NOT explain, and must stop at: (a) priced data the contraction ERASES (the non-universal, dimensionful, substrate-identifying microdata — [4], [6] — which is where the bulk of condensed matter's empirical pricing actually lives); (b) priced data that is a PARAMETER OF the contraction rather than an element of its domain — the slow-variable choice, the macro-partition, the relevant-observable list, the system/environment split, the cutoff and decoupling primitives ([32], [33], [46], [28], [29], [42], [3], [24], [37]). This second class is a TYPE ERROR, and it is the round's most important methodological finding. A map cannot be said to 'fail to erase' something that is not in its domain; calling the projector's own definition part of the projector's kernel makes 'kernel' coextensive with 'anything the formalism does not generate', which is definitionally what a supplied input IS. That renders K-U circular on this class. Critically, the conflation was NOT manufactured by K-U's author: two blinded agents with no K-U vocabulary produced it spontaneously, one of them self-reporting that it propagated the framing from a brief. So the conflation is latent in the question 'what does a contraction fail to erase', and any future formulation must forbid it by construction — kernel membership should be admitted only where the contraction ACTS on the object and provably returns it (type A) or is provably blind to its orientation by an equivariance argument (type C), never where the object parameterizes the map (type B).

5. REQUIRED BEFORE THIS VERDICT IS TREATED AS SETTLED, in priority order: (i) re-run with all six kernels actually delivered — cosmology, qft-gauge-flavor and GR carry 15 rows and the entire negative control; (ii) strip `primitives` from the briefs, and also `known_connections`, `known_disconnects` and `open_problems`, since those carry input-status language verbatim for at least [13], [47] and [4]; 24 of 48 priced rows are primitives rows and were visible to the blinded computers as declared inputs; (iii) assign description groups to the five orphan domains (classical field theory, quantum mechanics, information theory, mathematical foundations, quantum gravity), which hold 17 rows; (iv) pre-register the type-A/B/C admission rule in 4 so that type-B 'kernel' entries cannot be scored. Absent (i)-(iv), K-U-PARTIAL rests on 12 adjudicable rows, of which 7 support, 3 refute, and 3 are leak-invalidated — which is a finding, but not yet a result.
